Overview

Job Title: Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: General Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop new business through consistent prospecting, networking, referrals, email, phone calls and face-to-face meetings - minimum of 100 outreach per week
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, marketing leaders and decision-makers
  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand a client's business, challenges, goals and target audience
  • Create customized, multi-platform marketing solutions based on each client's needs
  • Sell across Audacy's portfolio, including broadcast, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and other marketing solutions
  • Manage the entire sales process from prospecting and presentation through closing and campaign execution and retainment 
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual sales goals
  • Maintain a strong pipeline and actively look for opportunities to grow existing accounts
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and become a trusted marketing partner to your clients
  • Stay current on industry trends, consumer behavior and new advertising opportunities
  • Work collaboratively with sales management, marketing, programming, digital and other internal teams to deliver successful campaigns
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings and events

Qualifications

Required:

We’re looking for someone who is driven to win and motivated/disciplined to build something of their own.

 

You may be a media salesperson already, or you may come from another sales environment. What matters most is your ability to prospect, build relationships, understand business needs, present solutions and close.

 

Our ideal candidate is:

 

  • A proven hunter who enjoys developing new business
  • Self-disciplined and comfortable creating their own opportunities
  • Confident communicating and presenting to business owners and decision-makers
  • Curious and willing to ask questions to uncover client needs
  • Creative and able to think beyond a traditional advertising solution
  • Persistent and resilient when faced with rejection or obstacles
  • Organized and able to manage multiple clients and opportunities
  • Competitive and motivated by achieving and exceeding goals
  • Comfortable working independently while being a strong team player
  • Someone who takes ownership of their business and their results
  • Experienced in media, advertising, sponsorship, digital or another consultative sales environment preferred

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven track record of success in sales, preferably new-business development
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage the full sales process from prospecting through close
  • Comfortable using CRM and standard Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

Reporting to: Regional Promotions Director

 

Employment Type: Part Time

 

Location(s): Buffalo, NY

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site (Office and Remote Locations)

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Buffalo seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.
  • A friendly, customer service oriented attitude and a willingness to complete varied tasks in our Engineering/Programming departments.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit and use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

 

 

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

job.title: Sales Assistant
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Work Arrangement: In Office

 

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with campaign management or ad operations tools (e.g., Wide Orbit, Salesforce).
  • Radio or audio industry background a bonus.

Overview

Job Title: Digital Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Digital Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: San Francisco, CA

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

The anticipated starting salary range for California-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $$65,000/Yr. to $110,000/Yr. base salary plus uncapped commission. The Opportunity:

Are you a proven hunter who lives for winning new business? Do you have a track record of opening doors, building relationships, and closing deals in a competitive marketplace? Audacy is looking for a driven Digital Account Executive to accelerate growth and make an immediate impact. This is more than a sales job—it's an opportunity to build your own book of business, sell industry-leading digital marketing solutions, and earn without limits. If you're competitive, entrepreneurial, and motivated by uncapped income potential, we'll give you the platform, products, and support to win big.

Who We Are: Industry Digital Leader with Best In Class Technology

At Audacy, you'll have the opportunity to sell one of the most comprehensive digital marketing portfolios in the industry. Backed by strategic partnerships with Google Premier Partner, Meta Premier Partner, Amazon Advanced Partner, and other leading technology platforms, you'll help businesses accelerate growth through data-driven marketing solutions that deliver measurable results.

As a Digital Account Executive, you'll work with a powerful suite of products that spans the entire customer journey—from building brand awareness to driving conversions and customer acquisition. You'll collaborate with local businesses, regional brands, and national advertisers to create customized marketing strategies using cutting-edge digital solutions.

Our multi-platform ecosystem combines the scale of premium audio with the precision of digital targeting, giving you access to:

  • Digital Streaming Audio
  • Podcast Advertising & Host-Endorsed Content
  • Amazon DSP & Programmatic Advertising
  • Connected TV (CTV) & OTT Video / Live Sports
  • Display & Native Advertising
  • Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
  • Search Engine Optimization (SEO) / AIO (AI Optimization)
  • Social Media Advertising
  • First-Party Audience Targeting & Data Solutions
  • Attribution & Performance Measurement Tools

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Hunt New Business: Relentlessly prospect, uncover opportunities, and win new clients through strategic outreach, networking, and relationship-building.
  • Build a Pipeline That Produces: Consistently generate qualified opportunities and maintain a healthy pipeline to exceed revenue goals.
  • Own the Close: Take control of the entire sales process, from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Compete to Win: Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where results are recognized and rewarded.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS News 5, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.

Cleveland is a resilient and passionate city with a rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and a strong sense of pride. From the shores of Lake Erie and the vibrant downtown district to world-class healthcare, arts, sports, and cultural institutions, Northeast Ohio offers endless opportunities to tell meaningful stories that impact viewers' lives. WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.

  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.

  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.

  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.

  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.

  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.

  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.

  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.

  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.

  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience

  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling

  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities

  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems

  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred

  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment

  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems

  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills

  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, blending Midwest charm with big-city energy. Situated on the shores of Lake Erie, Cleveland offers stunning waterfront views, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. The city is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra, Cleveland Museum of Art, and championship sports teams including the Guardians, Browns, and Cavaliers. Food lovers will appreciate the city's diverse culinary landscape, from historic West Side Market to innovative farm-to-table restaurants and craft breweries.

Cleveland's affordable cost of living, strong sense of community, and access to outdoor recreation—including Metro Parks, lakefront trails, and nearby Cuyahoga Valley National Park—make it an ideal place to build both your career and your life. With a revitalized downtown, diverse neighborhoods like Tremont, Ohio City, and Little Italy, and a growing tech and healthcare sector, Cleveland offers the perfect balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

#LI-SM2 #LI-Onsite

Annual Salary: $85,000.00 - $90,000.00


 

Pursuant to state and local salary transparency laws, the salary range posted is specific to candidates who will perform this work in Ohio.


 

WHAT WE OFFER (ADDITIONAL BENEFITS):

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

As an equal employment opportunity employer, The E.W. Scripps Company and its affiliates do not discriminate in its employment decisions on the basis of race, sex, sexual orientation, transgender status, gender, color, religion, age, genetic information, medical condition, disability, marital status, citizenship or national origin, and military membership or veteran status, or on any other basis which would be in violation of any applicable federal, state or local law. job.title: Ad Solutions & Campaign Management Intern
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management Intern to join the team. As an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management intern, you will support the post-sale creative production, trafficking, delivery and reporting of digital campaigns across The New York Times portfolio. You will work closely with Campaign Managers and Producers to ensure that advertiser creatives align with client expectations and that campaigns are set up accurately, deliver on schedule and meet our quality standards.


About The Role

This internship is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and training in digital creative production and ad operations within a global, premium publisher environment. This is a hybrid role based in our Paris headquarters, reporting to the Director, Ad Solutions & Operations. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week. The position will start from September for a duration of 6 months, based in Paris. Candidates must have the right to work in France for the full duration of the internship.

  • This internship is intended for students or recent graduates who meet the legal requirements for an internship (stage) in France with a mandatory “Convention de stage”.
  • To apply, please submit:
    • Your CV
    • A short cover letter explaining your interest in digital advertising and this specific role

Responsibilities:

  • Support Ad Solutions in the creative production process:
    • Helping compile specs and example executions for clients based on signed media plans
    • Reviewing assets for technical specification compliancy
    • Customising units according to client guidelines using CSS3
    • Testing ads across browsers, screen sizes and devices
  • Support Campaign Managers with the end-to-end setup of digital campaigns, including:
    • Collecting and validating creative assets and tracking tags
    • Trafficking campaigns in GAM, AdSwizz and LiveIntent 
  • Assist in monitoring live campaigns:
    • Reviewing pacing and delivery reports
    • Flagging under-delivery or issues to the Campaign Manager in a timely manner
    • Supporting optimisations based on performance and client objectives
  • Contribute to campaign reporting:
    • Pulling performance data from ad servers and other platforms
    • Assisting in the preparation of client-facing reports and post-campaign summaries
  • Support day-to-day operations:
    • Collaborating with Sales, Planning and other internal stakeholders on campaign-related tasks
    • Maintaining internal dashboards and trackers as required
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Interest in digital advertising
  • Experience working with numbers and spreadsheets (e.g. basic formulas, filtering and pivot tables in Excel/Google Sheets) 
  • Experience with a detailed and structured working style
  • Experience prioritizing competing programs, responsibilities, and projects
  • Professional proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Basic understanding of digital advertising concepts (impressions, clicks, CTR, viewability, targeting, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3 and JS. 
  • Exposure to or interest in ad serving, analytics or marketing platforms (e.g. Google Ad Manager, campaign management tools, web analytics)
  • Experience working with datasets, reporting or dashboards (e.g. coursework, projects, part-time roles)
  • Previous internship or work experience in media, advertising, marketing or a related field
  • Professional proficiency in French

job.title: Coordinator Media Revenue Management
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Coordinator, Media Revenue Management 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of the Revenue team, this position for a Coordinator, Media Revenue Management on the Rogers Sports & Media (RSM) Team will provide support to the department by maintaining and updating core business data, including but not limited to audience forecasts and tracking, competitive audience tracking, rates, schedule changes and inventory management.

 

This dynamic position is ideal for candidates who can shine in a fast-paced business environment that demands constant adaptation to the media and sports landscape. The scope of the business requires a well-rounded, versatile candidate capable of excelling in a team environment.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Responsible for inputting and updating rates and audience forecasts/posts for all RSM broadcast assets into proprietary system.
  • Responsible for inputting and updating Agency Deal parameters into proprietary system.
  • Execute program changes based on the business strategy in the proprietary system.
  • Maintain source data to support the standardization of data.
  • Support the team in various functions including the development of estimates for RSM stations.
  • Tracking audience performance of RSM properties and the competitive marketplace.
  • Working with large volumes of data; identifying key insights, trends, and anomalies.
  • Processing, maintaining, and communicating schedule changes to Sales.
  • Working collaboratively with various internal departments: Sales, Revenue Operations, Programming, and Insights.
  • Participate in continuously streamlining, improving, testing, and innovating processes.
  • Be part of special projects and ad-hoc assignments as required.

 

What you'll bring: 

  • Previous experience with high volume data entry.
  • Ability to quickly pick up new computer programs in additional to already being skilled with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Knowledge of the Canadian media landscape, preferably linear television, and industry tools such as InStar.
  • Strong track record of taking initiative and managing short and long term deadlines while balancing multiple priorities at any one time.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with all levels within the team and internal departments.
  • Superb accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Embrace change and open to new ideas and approaches.

 

What's in it for you? 

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including: 

  • Competitive salary & annual bonus.
  • Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.
  • Discounts: Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
  • Paid time off for volunteering.
  • Company matching contributions to charities you support.

Growth & Development Opportunities:

  • My Path: self-driven career development program.
  • Rogers First: priority in applying to internal roles of interest.

Wellness Programs:

  • Homewood employee & family assistance program.
  • Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) & Virtual therapy sessions.
  • Low or no-cost fitness membership with access to virtual classes.

Our commitment to the environment and diversity:

  • Work for an organization committed to environmental protection.
  • Strong commitment to diversity and inclusion with employee resource groups supporting equity-deserving groups including groups representing People of Colour, 2SLGBTQIA+, Indigenous Peoples, Persons with Disabilities and Women. We all bring something different, and we know what makes us different makes us great.

 

​To protect our people, brand and assets, a pre-employment background check will be conducted. As part of our selection process, all candidates must clear a criminal background check. Additionally, a credit check and drivers abstract may be required depending on the role.

job.title: Page Six Reporter (Tues-Sat)
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.

Page Six Digital is the modern evolution of the iconic gossip column, delivering the latest in celebrity news, entertainment, and pop culture with a bold, fast-paced digital edge. As the go-to destination for breaking stories, exclusive scoops, and viral moments, Page Six has grown far beyond its print roots to become a dynamic, multi-platform brand that reaches millions of readers daily across web, social, and video.

Page Six is looking for a bold, sharp, and pop culture-obsessed Reporter (Tues-Sat) who lives and breathes celebrity news. This is your chance to join the authority in entertainment gossip and help drive the conversations that everyone will be talking about tomorrow. You’ll pitch and write buzzy, can’t-miss stories daily with speed, accuracy, and unmistakable voice. We want someone who’s always one step ahead—plugged into social media trends, fluent in fan culture, and relentless in uncovering those juicy, under-the-radar scoops that make Page Six sizzle. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom, know your way around SEO and analytics, and can spot a viral moment before it breaks, we want to hear from you. Let’s make headlines.

Note: The schedule for this role is Tuesday-Friday 1-9pm EST, Saturday 10am-6pm EST.

Responsibilities: 

  • Pitch and write 5-6 celebrity and entertainment-based stories quickly and with clean copy daily

  • Proactively seek out and uncover under-the-radar stories that will resonate with the Page Six audience 

  • Have your finger on the pulse of what fans are talking about on social media and the ability to create content that fits their interests

  • Help expand Page Six’s nighttime news coverage by monitoring social media and using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Parse.ly, etc.) to achieve success

  • Be a self-starter and have the ability to think quickly on their feet and multitask in a fast-paced news environment

  • Have an understanding of SEO best practices and analytics and use that knowledge to help guide coverage 

Qualifications:

  • At least two years of major journalism experience

  • A deep understanding of and passion for all things celebrity and entertainment

  • Exceptional writing and reporting skills

  • Ability to write succinct, eye-catching headlines and clean, ready-to-publish content

  • Knowledge and understanding of SEO best practices 

  • Strong editorial judgment and communication skills

  • Familiarity with content management systems (Wordpress, in particular), photo editing software & web analytics tools

  • Flexibility in covering live pop culture events (i.e. Oscars, Golden Globes, etc.) and working outside traditional business hours when needed

job.title: Artist Campaign Manager
job.description:
The Artist Campaign Manager is responsible for developing and executing impactful marketing campaigns that maximise the visibility, cultural relevance, and commercial performance of Sony Music’s repertoire. Working across local and international priorities, the role partners closely with artists, management, international teams and internal departments to drive audience engagement, streaming growth and long-term value across digital, physical and emerging platforms.

 

This role plays a key part in bringing campaigns to life - balancing creative storytelling, audience development, digital innovation and commercial thinking to ensure Sony Music’s catalogue continues to connect with both existing and new generations of fans.

 

What you'll do:

  • Manage a roster of international and domestic projects, acting as the day-to-day marketing lead and key internal point of contact.
  • Develop and execute innovative marketing campaigns that drive revenue, audience growth and long-term artist value.
  • Leverage data to identify opportunities within Sony’s long-tail of repertoire and trending tracks to drive campaigns that generate growth across D2C, CRM and streaming marketshare.
  • Collaborate closely with Domestic roster artist teams, International label affiliates and global teams on campaign strategy and execution.
  • Work cross-functionally with Digital, Audience Development, Legal, Publicity & Radio, Licensing and Analytics teams and act as the evangelist for your priorities across these divisions.
  • Work in partnership with digital, audience and analytics teams to leverage data, audience insights and cultural trends to optimise digital marketing and creator campaign performance.
  • Contribute to the development of creative campaign ideas, digital activations and strategic marketing opportunities across the business.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with artists, management teams and international label affiliates, representing Sony Music Australia with passion and professionalism.
  • Create insightful campaign reporting that educates the broader departments on where collaborative opportunities lie.
  • Monitor changes in the market, with an emphasis on the industry, competitors and campaigns. Identify emerging trends and social media patterns and educate the wider team on how to infuse them into artist campaigns.
  • Bring an innovative, collaborative and solutions-focused mindset to the role, with a willingness to experiment, adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment.

 

Who you are:

  • You are a highly motivated, curious thinker with 3+ years’ experience in music, entertainment or a related marketing environment.
  • You are passionate about music, culture, audience behaviour and digital marketing; immersed in internet culture and aware of how culture intersects with life online.
  • You have a strong understanding of how fans engage with artists, songs, and content across platforms from digital to physical.
  • You are a committed project manager who can organise a varied and full workload, prioritise, work under pressure and problem solve to see an idea through to completion.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills across artists, management and internal stakeholders, locally or internationally.
  • Creative thinker with an instinct for storytelling, audience engagement and culturally relevant marketing.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively across departments and contributing to a team-first environment.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social platforms, audience growth and modern music marketing ecosystems.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day.
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next. We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives.
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private health benefits, life insurances, inclusive paid parental leave, emergency back-up childcare, LinkedIn Learning, Novated car leasing options plus loads of industry discounts & perks!

 

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

job.title: Senior Data Product Manager - Streaming and Social
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – Streaming & Social within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how artists are discovered, audiences are understood, and content performance is optimized; trusted consumption data becomes a strategic enterprise asset. In this role, you will ensure UMG's streaming and social data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume music consumption data at enterprise scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, documentation, prototyping, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable data-driven decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise data products and domain-specific data marts that serve as the authoritative source of truth for music consumption and streaming/social engagement across UMG. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent audience insights, artist development, repertoire strategy, marketing effectiveness, forecasting, and executive decision-making. By establishing trusted, governed, and semantically rich data products, you will help create the enterprise data foundation that enables AI-driven insights and intelligent decision-support across UMG.

You will partner closely with Global Insights, Commercial Strategy, Digital Business, Marketing, Label Analytics, Data Engineering, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring consumption & social data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role reports to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Champion AI-ready data products by ensuring trusted business definitions, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, observability, documentation, and governance are embedded into every streaming and social data product.
  • Ensure data products are designed to support emerging AI capabilities—including semantic retrieval, recommendation systems, intelligent agents, and LLM-powered experiences—through high-quality, well-governed enterprise data
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Global Insights, Label Analytics, Marketing, Finance, and Digital Business teams to define trusted business metrics, KPIs, and standardized consumption definitions.
  • Manage the lifecycle of external consumption data sources, ensuring licensed datasets are consistently ingested, governed, documented, monitored, and integrated into trusted enterprise data products.
  • Define scalable dimensional models and semantic layers supporting streaming activity, audience engagement, artists, releases, tracks, playlists, social engagement, territories, and commercial performance.
  • Establish authoritative data products that serve as the source of truth for music consumption performance across labels, artists, releases, and markets.
  • Standardize business definitions for metrics, including streams, listeners, followers, saves, playlist reach, engagement, audience growth, chart performance, market share, and consumption trends.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with internal and external consumption data providers to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of consumption data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve business outcomes by applying AI to music consumption, audience behavior, and content performance while maintaining strong governance and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of product management experience supporting digital music, streaming, audience analytics, media, entertainment, or digital content organizations.
  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of the digital music ecosystem, including streaming platforms, social media platforms, audience measurement, and music consumption trends.
  • Experience working with music consumption datasets, including streaming activity, artist performance, release performance, audience engagement, playlists, social signals, and chart data.
  • Familiarity with industry data providers and platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, TikTok, Meta, Luminate, Chartmetric, SoundCloud, Pandora, or similar consumption and audience analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of artist lifecycle analytics, audience development, catalog performance, playlisting, fan engagement, and commercial music performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.
  • Experience in defining and managing data quality frameworks, governance standards, and operational reliability practices.
  • Experience in establishing and managing data contracts and cross-functional data ownership models.
  • Strong SQL proficiency preferred, with the ability to independently validate requirements and investigate data issues.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and stakeholder value.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills.
  • Strong systems thinker with a customer-centric product mindset.

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

A little bit about our team:

The People Team sits at the heart of Warner Music Group and is focused on attracting, retaining and developing exceptional people. As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you will drive our end-to-end talent acquisition strategy, identifying and engaging high-caliber, diverse talent across the business. - Own the full lifecycle recruitment for assigned roles, delivering an outstanding candidate experience from initial briefing to negotiation and onboarding.   Although the role is west-coast based, you will recruit for positions in other locations and time zones, as well.

- Serve as a strategic talent advisor to business leaders, using labor market insights, industry trends, and data to build hiring strategies and influence talent decisions.

- Design and execute innovative sourcing strategies to build robust, diverse talent pipelines for immediate hires and long-term organizational growth.

- Lead key talent acquisition projects aimed at enhancing candidate experience, optimizing recruitment processes, and embedding best practices across the organization.

- Manage agency partner relationships, evaluating vendor performance and ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and SLAs.

- Represent the Warner Music organization as an employer brand ambassador at industry panels, networking events, and campus programs.

- Partner seamlessly with the broader People team (People Partners, Total Rewards, etc.) to deliver cohesive, business-aligned talent solutions.

- Drive recruitment initiatives, establishing strategic partnerships and talent channels to continually diversify our pipeline.

- Mentor and guide hiring managers on interview guidelines, candidate assessment, and competitive market dynamics.
 

About you:

- 5-7 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally combining agency and in-house environments, with a proven track record of filling complex and senior-level positions.

- Proven talent strategist with expert-level knowledge of proactive sourcing methods (LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, niche networks, and competitive intelligence).

- Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using modern ATS platforms (Workday preferred) and sourcing technologies.

- Consultative approach with the confidence and executive presence to challenge, advise, and influence collaborators at all levels.

- Strong business insight, with the ability to quickly grasp industry dynamics and translate strategic objectives into effective talent strategies.

- Demonstrated project management capability, with experience leading TA initiatives, process improvements, or early-career programs.

- Ability to be flexible and nimble in an ever-evolving business environment.

- Data-informed approach, comfortable applying recruitment metrics to evaluate pipeline health and sourcing efficiency.

- Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, capable of fostering collaboration across global and cross-functional teams.

- Outstanding organizational skills and process driven orientation.

And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Location: OH-Dayton

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - WHIO TV

 

Position Overview

WHIO-TV is looking for an inspiring sales leader to join our nationally renowned team. As the longtime top CBS affiliate in the country, WHIO-TV requires a strategist to maximize the monetization of our highly successful brands. Our TV, digital and radio station collaboration is well established and comes with unique cross-platform marketing opportunity.

 

At Cox Media Group (CMG), our team comprises top talent and high performers. We are united in our approach to competing with our products and winning with our people.

 

The successful candidate for the General Sales Manager position (GSM) will have exemplary skills to inspire, coach, and influence others. The GSM will lead the advertising sales department and support other sales leaders. Together, they will develop creative advertising campaigns that can be executed seamlessly across multiple media platforms, in turn creating success for our customers and business results.

 

The GSM will place significant focus on consumer insights, market research, trends, and specific client challenges. Ensure advertising campaigns are custom-designed and deliver a sufficient return on investment for clients.

 

The GSM will lead client and sales meetings and market events, including developing advertising seminars and B2B marketing strategies. While most of their attention will be to work with the advertising sales team and advertisers, the GSM will partner with the Local Programming team. Together, they are developing effective marketing campaigns for our top-rated radio stations.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading integrated campaign development, strong collaboration skills, a strong work ethic, a proven management background, and experience with multiple media platforms. A successful background in recruiting and managing talented account executives is preferred.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coaches, leads, and inspires the sales team to exceed business goals
  • Integrated Marketing and Sales Advocate
  • Establishes and executes a revenue strategy to maximize our assets and revenue potential
  • Achieves revenue goals by developing and supervising the CMG sales team
  • Develops advertising campaigns tailored to advertiser needs and objectives and executes across multiple media platforms
  • Develops strategy, designs, and activation plan for advertiser events and promotions
  • Responsible for leading seamless collaboration between the sales and programming teams to ensure the market achieves optimal audience engagement and delivers strong advertiser results
  • Exercises independent judgment in allocating resources to programs is likely to yield the best results
  • Partners with Program Directors to develop and implement external and internal marketing strategies, communications, and public relations activities
  • Leads the creative process, including brainstorming and designing campaigns
  • Develops insights and strategies from consumer research
  • Drives critical thinking about brand and product strategy
  • Drives new-business development across all platforms

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years leading a team in at least one of the following areas: marketing, advertising agency, digital media, or media sales
  • Proven track record of developing unique advertising campaigns and promotions for advertisers across radio formats and across multiple media, including digital and social media platforms
  • Strong track record of developing strategic priorities and action plans, and of achieving results
  • Proven understanding of the competitive media landscape
  • Highly successful at leading collaboration and cross-departmental processes
  • Proven success in developing integrated marketing concepts and campaigns across multiple media platforms
  • Experienced problem solver; brainstorming and marketing strategy facilitation
  • Strong relationships and networking skills are essential
  • Must have a valid driver's license and a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, equivalent work experience, and abilities considered

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Internal Auditor
job.description:
Department Finance Location Montreal

At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and cutting-edge technology are the pillars of our DNA. Keen on joining a team of tech-savvy music lovers in a stimulating and fun work environment?    

Within the Finance team, the Internal Auditor plays a key role in strengthening our control environment, continuously improving our processes, and proactively managing risks.

In parallel, this position has a strong technological component: evaluating IT General Controls (ITGC) and collaborating with IT teams to ensure the integrity and security of our financial data.

Your day-to-day

  • Act as the primary point of contact for the 52-109 compliance program
  • Lead the design, implementation, and rigorous maintenance of Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
  • Assess the effectiveness of internal controls as well as IT General Controls (ITGC)
  • Analyze, document, and recommend improvements to business and technological processes
  • Identify risks, formulate pragmatic recommendations, and support teams (Finance, IT, Operations) in implementing action plans to address gaps
  • Participate in the assessment of control risks during the implementation of new systems, applications, or technology partnerships
  • Prepare clear and structured audit reports to present findings to stakeholders
  • Support the annual financial statement audit: coordination, information gathering, document preparation, and responding to external auditors’ requests
  • Collaborate with various teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement and implement best control practices

 

Your qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in auditing (internal and/or external), with significant experience in 52-109 or SOX compliance
  • Proven, hands-on experience in evaluating IT General Controls (ITGC)
  • High level of rigor, attention to detail, and ability to structure information in a manner that is audit-ready for external auditors
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and ability to simplify technical concepts for financial and operational audiences
  • Bilingual (French/English)

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Relevant professional designation (e.g., CISA, CIA, or CPA with strong IT experience)
  • Knowledge of IT governance and security frameworks
  • Experience in process improvement (Lean, control optimization, automation)

Key Skills

  • Analytical mindset, professional judgment, and strong prioritization skills
  • Autonomy, cross-team collaboration, and a business partner mindset
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously

 

Life at Stingray

  • A cool office in Montreal with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays
  • Stingray café with breakfasts, lunches and snacks offered every day
  • A subsidy for your OPUS card to make your commutes easier
  • Shares purchase plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
  • Full access to the Dialogue virtual healthcare platform (including an EAP)
  • Free fitness classes offered weekly
  • Access to private consultations on nutrition and wellness
  • Free language classes, training and access to the latest AI technologies and platforms to boost your productivity and creativity
  • Summer hours
  • Milestones celebrated with our loyalty program
  • 5@7 and vibrant social events
  • And much more!

We leverage AI‑supported tools to assist with the initial review of applications. These tools do not replace human judgment—final decisions are made by our recruitment teams.

Montreal-based Stingray Group is a leading music, media and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. Our offices are located in the Old Port of Montreal just minutes from the Lachine Canal bike path, a prime location for picnics or a jog at lunch time.

Stingray supports the principles of Employment Equity and is committed to ensuring our workforce is representative of the communities we serve and in which we operate. job.title: Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy, to lead and scale the NFL’s international managed model as part of a transformative enterprise initiative. In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 6 - 8+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6 - 8+ years of progressive experience in data strategy, product management, data governance, or technology leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale initiatives.
  • Proven track record leading complex data and analytics programs, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, governance frameworks, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, consent management, and responsible data practices.
  • Experience supporting fan, customer, or consumer-centric organizations, with knowledge of engagement strategies, audience development, and lifecycle marketing preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging enterprise data and marketing technology platforms, including AWS Redshift, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, drive alignment across business and technology teams, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, drive organizational change, and scale processes, capabilities, and teams to support evolving business needs.
  • Strong strategic and operational mindset, with experience establishing governance models, prioritizing competing demands, managing risks, and delivering results in fast-paced environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Master’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, computer science, or other data related fields preferred

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Limited Travel

job.title: Senior Account Manager, US Retail
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

The US  Retail & Licensing team service the merchandise interests of WMX artists, as well as ‘Third Party’ artists and licenses. We live at the crossroads of music and fashion. The team is commercially focused, and you will be working with teams in creative, production and brand management on a daily basis, as well as with the Global Head of Retail & Licensing and the Senior Director of Retail to grow and manage the business, coach and mentor the broader team, and take the business to the next level.

Your role:

No day is the same on this team as we serve a diverse roster of artists and coordinate with a multitude and varied list of retail partners. Due to the small nature of the team, everyone has a voice and the ability to contribute ideas. In a changing landscape, this is an opportunity to be a leader and a key voice in the LA office; an opportunity to touch and feel an artist’s vision; an opportunity to see ideas come to life and the fans appreciation in real time.

Here you’ll get to:

  • You will work closely with internal stakeholders across creative, production, brand management and finance to resolve issues and queries
  • You will be requesting product set ups and communicating regularly with the production team to ensure orders are successfully fulfilled
  • You will be responsible for sending product set ups to retailers in a timely manner
  • You will be liaising with the creative and brand management teams regarding the creative decks needed to service our retailers
  • You will lead real time communication with 10+ accounts/vendors to maintain VIP customer service
  • You will be responsible for keeping track of all buyer requests and preferences
  • You will be responsible for driving a large portion of the departments sales and ensure we deliver on our margin expectations 
  • You will manage order approval requests; which includes receiving order requests from buyers and requesting approval from product managers for each order, by retailer, monitoring/communicating approval completion as well as escalating pending approval requests on a weekly basis
  • You will periodically submit art requests to the creative team, which will include receiving design requests from buyers, entering design/art requests and revisions, making sure art requests are completed per buyer direction/call outs and communicating/confirming design revisions with buyers
  • You will tackle additional sales/administrative support as needed

About you:

  • You have a demonstrable track record in a similar role
  • You have 5+ years of experience in sales / account management
  • You can work independently as well as within a large varied team
  • You have previous experience managing high volume buyer requests
  • You have previous experience in music merchandising or fashion/apparel industry
  • You can demonstrate in depth knowledge of retail math and sales
  • You have a positive attitude and can demonstrate strong attention to detail, excellent organization, and strong communication skills
  • You have an extremely proactive work ethic and the ability to multi task
  • You enjoy problem solving and do not shy away from getting to the bottom of situations in order to reach your goals
  • You are a self-starter with a ton of ideas who is excited to share your vision and creativity
  • You have a high proficiency in Google Workspace

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You have previous experience working in music or entertainment
  • You have previous experience working with project management tools
  • You have previous experience working with EDI


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

  • Source, develop and maintain vendor relationships among an array of suppliers

  • Maintain vendor report card and create semi annual report

  • Train and mentor procurement Coordinators

  • Product Sourcing and development with our overseas vendors. 

About you: 

  • You have 3 years of Procurement/Purchasing and/or Project management experience

  • You have excellent organizational, time management and attention to detail skills

  • You are customer focused and results driven

  • You enjoy training, managing and supporting team members

  • You enjoy a fast paced environment, can prioritize and provide swift direction to solve problems

We’d love it if you also had:
