job.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 

Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. 

You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy. 

Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.

  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps. 

  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. 

  • Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers. 

  • Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data. 

  • Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications. 

  • Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.

  • Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. 

  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.

  • Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Organize architecture discussions. 

  • Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. 

Qualifications:

Must-Haves 

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field. 

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. 

  • 5+ years experience leading engineering teams. 

  • Agile best practices. 

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.

  • Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services . 

  • Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices. 

  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.

  • Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks. 

  • Strong troubleshooting skills 

  • Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch. 

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries. 

  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.

  • Personalization and recommendation systems. 

  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)

  • Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc. 

  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.) 

  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)

  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus) 

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change). 

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

Base Pay Range: $160,000 - $175,000 + Bonus

We’re committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation to attract top talent. This pay range reflects our good faith estimate for the role and may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors.

For bonus-eligible roles, targets are determined based on multiple considerations, including market benchmarks and individual contributions.

For benefits-eligible roles, we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package covering health, retirement, wellbeing, and more, along with optional benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees.

job.title: General Sales Manager - Athens Radio
job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) Athens Radio is seeking a General Manager, Sales to lead the market’s advertising sales organization and own revenue growth across broadcast and digital platforms. This strategic sales leadership role requires significant digital advertising expertise, disciplined revenue management, and the ability to build accountable sales teams that deliver integrated marketing solutions for clients. Candidates without a strong foundation in digital advertising strategy, products, analytics, and sales leadership will not be successful in this role.

 

The successful candidate will be an accomplished sales leader with extensive knowledge of digital marketing solutions, including search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display advertising, audience targeting, and campaign analytics. The GSM will be responsible for coaching and developing the sales team to confidently identify client challenges, recommend integrated solutions, and communicate measurable business outcomes across both traditional and digital platforms.

 

This leader owns total market sales performance, including local and digital revenue, new business development, forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and account growth. The General Manager, Sales, will serve as the market’s primary sales leader on integrated marketing strategy, helping sellers connect client objectives with effective multi-platform solutions while ensuring campaigns are measured, analyzed, and optimized to deliver results.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading successful sales teams, growing digital revenue, building integrated marketing strategies, holding teams accountable to performance standards, and developing high-performing sales professionals in a digitally focused media environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers consistent growth across total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business revenue, and account expansion.
  • Builds a sales culture defined by accountability, proactive prospecting, strong coaching, forecast discipline, and high client-service standards.
  • Increases seller confidence and adoption of integrated broadcast and digital solutions, supported by clear needs assessments, strong client strategy, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains healthy pipeline visibility, accurate forecasting, and timely use of CRM and reporting tools to guide decisions and performance conversations.
  • Improves client retention and growth by using campaign performance data, market insights, and optimization recommendations to demonstrate value.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and inspire the sales organization to achieve and surpass total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business, and account-growth goals.
  • Establish and execute a market revenue strategy that maximizes radio, digital, event, promotional, and other available assets.
  • Drive new-business development and maintain accountability for prospecting, discovery, pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, and closing activity.
  • Develop the sales team’s ability to lead effective client needs assessments and create insight-driven, integrated advertising recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on leadership in digital sales strategy, helping sellers connect products and tactics to client objectives, audiences, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of priority digital advertising solutions and ensure sellers understand how to position them within integrated client strategies.
  • Guide customized campaigns across multiple platforms and use reporting, analytics, key performance indicators, and client feedback to evaluate results and recommend optimization.
  • Coach sellers to communicate campaign performance clearly, set realistic expectations, and strengthen client retention and growth.
  • Lead sales meetings, one-on-one coaching, account strategy sessions, client presentations, and market sales initiatives.
  • Collaborate with digital strategy, account management, operations, programming, and other internal partners to support accurate execution and a positive client experience.
  • Develop advertising events, promotions, seminars, and B2B marketing strategies that support revenue and community relationships.
  • Use consumer insights, market research, competitive information, and performance data to strengthen sales strategy and client recommendations.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain talented sales professionals while setting clear performance expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasts, pipeline visibility, and sales activity through company-approved CRM and reporting processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated expertise in digital advertising strategy, campaign analytics, and performance measurement, with the ability to coach sellers and clients on solutions that support measurable business outcomes.
  • Minimum of three years of leadership experience in media sales, digital media, marketing, advertising, or a related field.
  • Proven success developing sales strategy, coaching and managing sales professionals, driving revenue growth, and achieving business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display, and audience-targeting strategies, with the ability to connect these solutions to client goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and present integrated marketing strategies that combine broadcast, digital, and promotional assets to solve client business challenges.
  • Experience using campaign analytics, consumer insights, market research, and performance metrics to guide decision-making and optimize advertising strategies.
  • Strong communication, presentation, relationship-building, coaching, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Demonstrated success in new-business development, pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, revenue accountability, and sales performance management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, sales reporting tools, and digital campaign performance reporting.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience leading digital revenue growth within a local media, advertising, or agency environment, including coaching sellers on integrated solutions and campaign performance conversations.
  • Successful background recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing sales professionals.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

The Merch Collective is an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talent—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

 

As an Account Coordinator, you will support the execution of artist commerce initiatives across touring, e-commerce, retail, VIP, licensing, events, and pop-up activations. Working closely with Account Managers and cross-functional teams, you will help coordinate merchandising projects from concept through fulfillment by tracking deliverables, facilitating communication, and ensuring projects remain organized and on schedule. You will assist with product development, client requests, and day-to-day project execution while collaborating with creative, production, operations, finance, and fulfillment teams to deliver a seamless experience for artists and their teams. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to supporting multiple projects simultaneously.

What you'll do:

Support Client Relationships & Day-to-Day Account Management

  • Partner closely with Account Managers to deliver exceptional service to artists, management, and internal teams. Support Account Managers through proactive communication, meeting coordination, follow-up, and execution across touring, e-commerce, retail, VIP, and licensing initiatives.

Coordinate Merchandise & Commerce Execution

  • Support the planning and execution of merchandising and commerce initiatives by tracking deliverables, coordinating product launches, and ensuring projects move efficiently from concept through completion while contributing ideas that enhance the fan experience.

Support Project Coordination & Product Development

  • Coordinate the day-to-day workflow of merchandise projects, including product setup, approvals, artwork routing, placing orders, sample tracking, inventory coordination, and launch readiness. Maintain accurate documentation and ensure all project details are organized and executed on schedule.

Coordinate Cross-Functional Communication & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a key point of coordination between creative, production, finance, touring, e-commerce, retail, and external partners. Ensure information is communicated clearly, action items are tracked, new clients onboarded, and processes are followed to keep projects moving efficiently and accurately.

Who you are:

  • 1+ years of experience in merchandising, e-commerce, retail, marketing, project coordination, entertainment, or a related field, with an interest in artist commerce.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with teammates and cross-functional partners and is comfortable following up, asking questions, and keeping projects on track.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn, with a solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to work in ambiguity while being adaptable to ever changing shifts, changes and seasonal ebbs and flows of the business
  • Passionate about music, merchandising, and fan experiences, with a collaborative attitude and a desire to contribute to outstanding client service and the successful execution of artist commerce initiatives.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Manager, Inventory Operations
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

Distribution Operations is responsible for all physical supply chain processes across the entirety of product lines under WEA Distribution.  The department’s core focus is to work cohesively with all WMG divisions and departments globally, as well as outside vendors, carriers, and label partners, to ensure that the highest quality of products are distributed to customers in a timely manner. Key functions shared by the Distribution Operations team include inventory management, manufacturing, order fulfillment, compliance, and logistics.

Your role:

The Manager of Inventory Operations, plays a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of   physical product distribution at Warner Music Canada across both Retail and D2C platforms ensuring that artists’ music and products reach fans efficiently, on time, and across all platforms.  This role oversees the end-to-end workflows of inventory management to freight invoice processing.  You will collaborate cross-functionally with Warner Music Canada’s internal teams (A&R, Marketing, Sales, and Finance) to streamline operations, optimize processes, and drive overall efficiency across the label’s business lines. Under supervision of the Sr. Director of Global Traffic, you will work with external partners (3PL and logistics vendors) to ensure timely product delivery and quality control.

  

Here you’ll get to:

●       Oversee the management of all physical product inventory configurations

●       Monitor and forecast product demand, coordinating with supply chain partners to minimize overstock or shortages

●       Manage warehouse KPIs ensuring accurate inventory tracking, fulfillment, distribution performance and logistics coordination.

●       Review product pricing and negotiations from suppliers pertaining to physical product

●       Serve as the main point of contact between the label and distribution partners for physical releases. Coordinating new product launches and catalog replenishment with internal teams and third-party vendors.

●       Maintain release schedules and ensure all operational deliverables are met on time.

●       Approve invoices and provide accounting info for freight and Distribution Accruals

●       Provide returns forecast for Accounting

●       Track and report on sales trends.

About you:

●    Possess 5+ years’ Management experience across Inventory, logistics and Physical Supply Chain Operations.

●  Demonstrate knowledge of carrier rating levels, services, and processes (LTL, TL, Small Parcel, Airfreight, International/ Customs).

●    You are proficient with common data analysis tools (MS Excel, Access, and SQL).

●    You have excellent organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to initiate and drive improvements.

●    You have a proven ability to motivate, support, and collaborate with various teams. 

●    You have a history of excelling in fast-paced, high-energy environments.

●     Can execute and manage multiple projects simultaneously with tight deadlines.

●    Have a keen sense of urgency and strong follow-up skills.

●    You look beyond the obvious, ask thought-provoking questions, and provide valid solutions.

 

We’d love it if you also:

●       Possess a bachelor’s degree related to Supply Chain Management, or equivalent years of experience.

●       Possess SAP Purchasing and Invoicing experience.

 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

job.title: Deputy Director, Photo
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

T Magazine is looking for a temporary deputy photo director with experience in print and digital storytelling.

You will assign photography covering a wide array of subject matter and photographic genres including fashion, portraits, interiors, travel and still lifes. You have experience producing editorial photoshoots involving studios, set builds, hair and makeup, location scouting, casting, and wardrobe. You have strong knowledge of photographers around the world.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • In partnership with the Director of Photography, produce photo shoots for all sections of the magazine and website including fashion, interiors, travel and still lifes.
  • Source freelance photographers, producers, stylists, hair and makeup artists, set builders, prop designers, location scouts, casting agents, animal handlers, and fabricators for photo shoots.
  • Handle several projects simultaneously that span the areas of fashion, travel, still life, interiors, portraits, and special packages.
  • Manage photo editors working in photo research, art commissions and digital shoots.
  • Maintain budgets and contracts for photo shoots; process and approve invoices for photo shoots in a timely manner.
  • Partner with the Director of Photography to negotiate fees with vendors such as studios, photo labs and photo agencies.
  • Work with the editorial and design teams to produce multimedia features.
  • Meet with photographers, gallerists, photography agents and book publishers to find new photographers and keep up with trends in the art world.
  • Do portfolio reviews and mentoring to find new photographers.
  • Mentor junior members of the photo department.

  • You will report to the Photo Director.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years producing creative photography including fashion, interiors, travel, and still lifes for print and digital.
  • Experience liaising well with top editors, writers, designers, and photo editors while producing shoots.
  • Knowledge of journalistic ethics, standards, and practices.
  • Knowledge of the top creatives working in the fields of art, photography, and video.

  • Willingness to work nights and weekends as needed.

job.title: Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Program Manager to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all. 
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.
  • Deliver strategic and creative deliverables directly to day to day clients. Own contact reports, internally and back to the client.
  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.
  • Stellar time management and organizational skills, able to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Thick-skinned, persistent, and diplomatic—you handle challenges with optimism and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable navigating across multiple internal disciplines (creative, production, strategy) and external partners to keep projects moving forward.
  • An understanding of when to escalate challenges and opportunities to the appropriate leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a creative agency or similar communications environment, with a strong understanding of advertising, marketing, media, production, and agency finance.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns across broadcast, digital, experiential and/or social.
  • Experience supporting or leading calls with cross-functional agency teams and interfacing directly with clients.
  • Fluent in Google Suite (especially Sheets and Slides); experience with resource management or workforce planning, as well as project planning tools.
  • Strong curiosity with a strong desire to learn and engage AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience directly managing timelines and deliverables for creative and production workstreams.
  • Exposure to or direct experience with production processes.
  • Acted as a producer or account executive in an agency environment with client facing
  • A passion for culture, innovation, and helping brands show up meaningfully in the world.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $70,000 - $90,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

job.title: Sr. Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Sr. Business Director to join Translation and lead one of our most visible and consequential client partnerships. The Sr. Business Director is a senior client and business leader responsible for the success, growth, and health of a significant, complex account. This person has already demonstrated success at the Business Director level and brings greater executive influence, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership. They will serve as a strategic advisor to senior clients, lead integrated teams, and remain close to the work while actively shaping and pushing clients forward in culture.

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the overall health, performance, growth, and senior client relationships for a flagship national account.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Director-level stakeholders, shaping agendas, influencing decisions, and constructively challenging clients with a clear point of view.
  • Translate complex business, consumer, category, and cultural dynamics into clear strategic direction and stronger creative work.
  • Lead integrated teams across Business Leadership, Strategy, Context, Creative, Program Management, Production, Analytics, and Partner Agencies, creating clarity around objectives, priorities, roles, and decisions.
  • Ensure work meets Translation’s standards for strategic rigor, creative ambition, cultural excellence, and client readiness before presentation.
  • Develop and drive the organic growth strategy, identifying and converting opportunities across stakeholders, business units, audiences, and workstreams.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, including revenue, profitability, staffing, forecasting, scope performance, and investment recommendations.
  • Anticipate relationship, delivery, and commercial risks, intervening before they affect the client partnership, the quality of the work, team health, or profitability.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, performance reviews, and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Contribute to agency leadership through new business, recruiting, shaping departmental standards, cross-functional improvements, and the development of future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional business judgment and the ability to connect marketing decisions to broader client goals, organizational dynamics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to read complex rooms, tailor counsel to different stakeholders, and navigate sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Strong strategic fluency and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear, actionable direction without prescribing the creative solution.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing models, forecasting, profitability, and investment decisions.
  • Ability to lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams, resolve tension constructively, and create accountability without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • A growth mindset, with the curiosity and proactivity to identify unmet client needs and translate them into meaningful opportunities.

Job Title

GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization

Job Description

About The Position :

The GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization is a mid-to-senior execution leader responsible for the day-to-day coordination, commercial readiness, and field adoption of our enterprise ad product portfolio. Based in our New York City office, this role serves as the critical, high-touch bridge between our product capabilities and sales execution.

As the ultimate "keeper of the Ad Product Catalog," you will ensure that our New York-based revenue teams—including Sellers, Account Strategists, and Brand Marketers—fully understand our ad products, their operational nuances, and how to position them for maximum yield. Additionally, you will act as the on-the-ground project manager ushering new products through the formal GTM process, ensuring cross-functional alignment and gathering real-time field feedback to optimize our commercial engine.

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team:

The Ad Product Commercialization team partners across Product, Sales, Brand Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, and Commercial organizations to successfully bring advertising products to market. The team enables revenue growth by ensuring product launches are well coordinated, sales teams are equipped for success, and customer feedback continuously informs product evolution.

About The Position’s Contributions:

35% Ad Product Catalog Governance & Advisory

  • Single Source of Truth: Own and maintain the comprehensive Ad Product Catalog. Ensure all product specifications, packaging rules, pricing guidelines, and operational constraints are meticulously updated, accurate, and accessible.

  • Technical & Operational Advisory: Act as the primary, local "help desk" and subject matter expert for NYC-based Sellers and Account Strategists. Provide rapid, clear answers to complex, nuanced questions regarding ad product capabilities and custom configuration rules.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Brand Marketing team to ensure that their client-facing narratives match the exact technical and operational realities housed in the product catalog.

35% GTM Program Management & Training

  • Launch Traffic Control: Act as the dedicated project manager ushering individual products and packages through the formal GTM pipeline. Coordinate timelines, keep cross-functional stakeholders on schedule, and prevent rollout bottlenecks.

  • Operational Readiness & Briefings: Translate dense, technical ad product mechanics into clear, digestible operational instructions. Lead internal briefings and training sessions for revenue teams detailing what a product is, who it is for, and how to book it.

30% Field Adoption & Commercial Yield Analysis

  • Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly analyze internal sales data and product adoption metrics. Identify which packages are driving the highest yield and surface trends regarding what is selling well versus what isn't.

  • On-the-Ground Feedback Loops: Leverage your physical presence in the NYC office to build deep trust with sellers and CROs. Proactively capture field feedback, understand seller pain points, and investigate the "why" behind product adoption data to inform future iterations.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

  • 4–7 years of experience in ad product operations, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, digital media project management, product marketing, commercial operations, or a related field.

  • Experience managing cross-functional product launches and commercialization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting revenue organizations within digital advertising, media, ad tech, or SaaS environments.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams in a fast-paced organization.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Relationship Building & Empathy: High emotional intelligence with a proven track record of earning trust across diverse commercial teams. Exceptional ability to act as a supportive, empathetic partner to quota-carrying sellers.

  • Program & Project Management: Highly organized with the disciplined capability to manage multiple moving parts of a launch simultaneously, enforce deadlines, and keep diverse stakeholders communicating effectively.

  • Product Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, ad tech, and sales lifecycles. Ability to quickly master technical ad product configurations and explain them simply to non-technical teams.

  • Data Curiosity: A natural inclination to look at sales spreadsheets, ask probing questions about revenue performance, and translate numbers into actionable insights for catalog optimization.

% Travel Required (Approximate): < 5%

job.title: SVP, Product
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.

Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.

Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.

The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.

As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. This leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
  • Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
  • Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
  • Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.

Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.

Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.

What we’re looking for:

  • A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
  • A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
  • Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.
  • Technical fluency across product strategy, workflows, tooling, data, and production tradeoffs.
  • Experience with prioritization and portfolio management across multiple stakeholders.
  • A track record of turning prototypes and experiments into durable, supported products.
  • The judgment to create useful governance without becoming a bottleneck.
  • The ability to distinguish a meaningful product opportunity from an interesting AI demo.

Worth your time: This is an opportunity to help define what modern product leadership looks like inside an AI-native media company. You’ll help shape not only what Axios builds, but how Axios operates.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $285,000 - $315,000, plus a 25% bonus, and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage

  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays

  • Annual learning and development stipend

  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. We are looking for a great storyteller with a strong point of view, quick wit, and passion for Country music, local culture, and audience engagement. The ideal candidate understands how to maintain forward momentum through effective teasing, pacing, and content execution while connecting naturally with listeners on-air, online, and in person.

  • Co-host a live, personality-driven morning show that delivers compelling storytelling, listener interaction, local content, interviews, and engaging entertainment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated on-air radio experience with strong storytelling, audience engagement, and personality-driven content skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.
  • Experience with audio editing software, such as Adobe Audition, and radio automation systems, such as WideOrbit.

job.title: Manager, Global Partnerships Strategy
job.description:
The Manager of Global Partnerships Strategy plays a central role in supporting the NFL’s Global Partnerships organization through conducting strategic analysis, preparing business plans, and managing detail-oriented communication materials (e.g. presentations, briefs, models). The role partners closely with leaders across Sponsorship, Consumer Products, Gaming, International, and Finance organizations to support the League’s Commercial businesses by analyzing data, developing compelling communications, and improving decision-making through comprehensive research.

This individual will leverage core analytical skills and strategic thinking to bring together data, market intelligence, financial analysis, and structured problem-solving to influence decision-making across the Global Partnerships portfolio. The role offers exposure to senior leadership while providing opportunities to influence the future direction of the NFL’s commercial revenue.

Example initiatives might include:

  • Supporting forecasting and analysis to inform the long-term and annual strategic planning across Global Partnerships
  • Summarizing and analyzing deal terms for new partnership and licensing opportunities
  • Building business cases for international and category expansion through detailed research
  • Developing executive-level analyses and presentations to inform strategic negotiations for commercial partnerships
  • Creating market assessment presentations across key industries, prospective partners, and international markets
  • Helping identify new revenue opportunities across Sponsorship, Consumer Products, Gaming, and Licensing

Success in this role requires the ability to quickly shift between business areas while maintaining a deep understanding of the NFL’s Commercial ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Planning & Business Analysis
    • Support annual business planning and long-range forecasting across core revenue-driving departments
    • Conduct market research, category assessments, and competitive analysis across the Sports and Entertainment landscape including clubs, leagues, and top entertainment IP
    • Create business cases (e.g., models, presentations) to build support for new commercial opportunities across new channels, categories, and international markets
    • Build data-based and well-researched financial models and scenario analyses to help contextualize and influence decision-making across the business
    • Translate complex data into insights and actionable recommendations leveraging Excel and other data visualization programs (e.g., Tableau, R)
  • Insights Support
    • Own modeling and scenario analyses around annual business planning and long-range planning in collaboration with NFL Finance
    • Partner with Consumer Insights to create materials (e.g., presentations, briefs) to communicate key insights/trends from focus groups, surveys, and market intelligence affecting the NFL Commercial businesses
    • Leverage derived insights to build compelling data-backed storylines to help influence Strategic Leadership’s decision-making
    • Maintain category intelligence across priority industries for the NFL and its partners, including financial market research and trends impacting NFL partner investment decisions
  • Growth Initiatives:
    • Support strategic projects by building key materials to communicate the opportunity for new revenue growth opportunities for NFL Sponsorship business globally
    • Attend cross-departmental working groups focused on League-wide strategic initiatives (e.g. International Expansion, Innovation, Flag Football Development) to aggregate insights, opportunities, and considerations that will shape the League’s Commercial Strategy
    • Support International commercial teams in interpreting market data, dynamics, and feedback to problem-solve and develop new and relevant selling stories
  • Executive Communications
    • Develop executive presentations for League leadership, ownership meetings, and commercial reviews
    • Prepare briefing materials to inform and influence NFL leadership’s strategic recommendations and approach
    • Present findings to Senior Leaders across the Global Partnerships team as needed
    • Support Leadership decision-making through concise storytelling and data visualization leveraging the complete Microsoft Suite including PowerPoint

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in strategy, consulting, or internal strategy/operations function
  • Experience working autonomously with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and collaborative environment
  • Experience supporting executive-level projects and priorities, including working with C-level executives and cross-functional leadership
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including advanced PowerPoint skills and ability to create compelling written communications for executive audiences
  • Business case modeling experience with solid understanding of financial concepts
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to deliver accurate work on tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA preferred
  • Solid understanding of the marketing, media, technology, and sports industries
  • Extensive background in strategy, banking, private equity, or management consulting working across various sectors
  • Management experience leading a team of direct reports
  • Experience with long-range planning and annual business planning processes
  • Superior PowerPoint and Excel modeling
  • Excellent attention-to-detail

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proactive
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Superior problem-solving abilities and resilient nature
  • Must be highly resourceful and adaptable, with an intuitive understanding of how / where to get information and apply to project work
  • Ability to tell a meaningful story through data
  • Experience negotiating deals and/or managing strategic partnerships
  • Effective collaboration, interpersonal, communication and influencing skills
  • Diligent, persistent, and enthusiastic

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Role Summary

The Facilities Coordinator performs hands-on maintenance and supports day-to-day facilities operations at WWE's corporate headquarters in Stamford, CT. Reporting to the Facilities Senior Director, this role keeps building systems, office spaces, and on-site amenities running safely and to a high standard, and delivers responsive, white-glove support to staff and executives. This is an on-site, hourly position that requires 24x7 on-call availability and occasional after-hours and weekend work.

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on corporate headquarters building systems—including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and life-safety equipment—troubleshooting and repairing MEP systems to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.

  • Conduct routine inspections of offices, conference rooms, common areas, and building equipment to identify maintenance needs and safety concerns.

  • Maintain and upkeep the on-site state-of-the-art gym.

  • Assist the Facilities Director and team with building projects, furniture installations, and space-planning projects (employee adds, moves, and changes), including updating floor and seating charts in AutoCAD.

  • Maintain general supply orders and support inventory management by monitoring maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment—including medical, cleaning, and special-request items—to ensure operational readiness.

  • Strong customer-service orientation, with the ability to deliver an outstanding client experience.

The San Francisco Chronicle is seeking to create a pipeline for the next generation of arts journalists. The position will be based with Datebook, our guide to arts, entertainment and culture in the Bay Area covering film, music, theater and more. Sports Reporting Intern, Summer 2027

Would you like to work with world-class journalists at a digital media company seeking to reinvent the way it covers news and reaches readers? 

The San Francisco Chronicle is looking for a reporting intern to join us for an exciting summer of covering Bay Area sports teams and the issues that surround them. job.title: Digital Design/Development Intern, Summer 2027
job.description:
San Francisco Chronicle Summer Digital Design/Development Internship

The San Francisco Chronicle is seeking motivated students and recent graduates interested in pursuing careers in visual, product and UI/UX design, visual storytelling and coding/development for journalism. 

The Chronicle’s design team is a multidisciplinary group responsible for elevating the newsroom’s most ambitious journalism. We are a diverse group of designers, illustrators, graphics/data reporters and developers of varied backgrounds. Our projects range from crafting design systems for lines of coverage to piecing together immersive storytelling approaches for longform narratives and investigative reports. Recent successes include an Online Journalism Award-winning project on the impact of the World War II incarceration of Japanese Americans on San Francisco’s Japantown and the extremely successful relaunch of our list of Top 100 Restaurants in the San Francisco Bay Area that we rebranded and redesigned with new product features and audience strategies. We also contributed to two investigations — “The Right to Remain Secret” and “Fast and Fatal” — that were finalists for the Pulitzer Prize in 2025.

Our interns have worked on a variety of projects depending on their interests and emerging skillsets. A more coding-focused intern helped create tools to make it easier for other members of the team to produce bespoke, custom-coded projects. Another designed unique visualizations for a story on how winter storms impacted areas around Northern California’s Feather River. You may find yourself creating motion graphics, static and/or interactive information graphics, page designs or new components, such as a better video player over the course of your internship.

Prior interns have gone on to internships or full-time jobs at the Chronicle (and its sister publications or groups in Hearst Newspapers), The Pudding, the Seattle Times, the Texas Tribune, the New York Times and the Washington Post.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Participate in brainstorming and design sprints for newsroom projects
  • Execute assignments via reporting, writing, designing and/or coding as needed
  • Communicate effectively with collaborators within the newsroom
  • Manage the production process for your projects

 

Requirements

  • Must be a college junior, senior or recent graduate at time of application
  • Must have an interest in journalism and/or design demonstrated by coursework or practical experience at student publications or professional internships
  • Must be able to work in the Chronicle’s San Francisco office at least three days a week.
  • You should have a basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

 

Skills that we like

This is a list of skills that we would put to use on the design team. It’s impossible to be skilled at everything. We only expect you to do a couple of these. 

  • Basic reporting and writing for accuracy, brevity and clarity
  • News design techniques
  • Visual, UI/UX and/or product design, including typography, color and grid
  • Ability to use the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Development experience with HTML, CSS, Javascript and React, with version management via Git and GitHub
  • News tools such as ArchieML and AI2HTML
  • Data reporting and analysis via Python (preferred) or R
  • Data visualization via DataWrapper or D3
  • Three.js
  • Illustration
  • Animation/motion
  • Video
  • Social media design

 

Internship details

  • Interns are paid $20.50 per hour.
  • Interns work 40 hours a week from Monday through Friday. We generally work from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Depending on news coverage needs, you may be occasionally asked to work nights or weekends.
  • The summer internship is 12 weeks long. The exact start and end dates are slightly flexible, but, for the best experience, we want the majority of your time with us to sync up with the rest of the summer internship class. It typically begins in June and ends in August or September.
  • In addition to feedback on your assignments, you will have a weekly check-in with your supervisor to talk through your work, your internship and your career goals.
  • Based on your interests, we will match you with a mentor in the newsroom who will augment the feedback you receive from your supervisor. 

 

Application details

  • Please send a resume, a cover letter explaining why you’re interested in this role and links to your portfolio and/or GitHub profile if applicable
  • Also, in your cover letter or in a second document, please direct us to three projects that showcase what you consider to be your best or more interesting work. If the project is not immediately related to journalism or design, please explain what is special about the piece.
  • If you have any questions, please contact Chronicle Creative Director Alex K. Fong at alex.fong@sfchronicle.com
  • Application Deadline is October 10, 2026

job.title: VP International Marketing GSA (m/f/d)
job.description:
(Full-time, permanent, starting as soon as possible, based in Berlin)

Releases of global artists shape culture far beyond borders — but their success in each market depends on how deeply they connect locally. In this role, you will help define how global artists and international repertoire become relevant, visible and successful across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, working closely with European Marketing teams across the region. Leading the GSA International Marketing team and cooperating closely with Marketing leads across the Continental Europe & Africa region, you will bring together strategic direction, local market insight, creativity and data-informed decision-making to turn global priorities into powerful local campaigns. If you combine strong leadership with global thinking, cultural understanding and a clear sense of what makes music resonate in the GSA market, we are looking for you! 

 

What you do

  • You are responsible for International Marketing across the GSA region, setting the strategic direction for how global artists and international repertoire are marketed in Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • You develop the overall marketing strategy for international artists and global releases in GSA, translating international campaign guidelines into tailored, culturally relevant GSA strategies
  • You lead and develop the GSA International Marketing team, setting clear priorities, roles and responsibilities while fostering close collaboration within the team and across local, regional and international interfaces
  • You steer local marketing campaigns for global superstars and international newcomers — from positioning and release planning to performance analysis — making international strategies effective in the GSA market
  • You prioritize artists, releases and marketing investments based on market potential, audience insights, streaming and social data, as well as cultural relevance in the respective markets
  • You work closely with international repertoire owners, labels and European Marketing teams across the region, representing GSA market needs and opportunities within the international network and ensuring strong local execution of global priorities
  • Together with Commercial Sales, Data, Digital, Media Relations, Promotion and other partners, you develop integrated campaigns that make international strategies locally relevant, visible and commercially successful in the GSA market
  • You build strong relationships with artists, managements, platforms and international partners, translating international priorities and campaign pushes into clear, locally relevant marketing and activation plans for the GSA market
  • You are responsible for budgets, resources and relevant KPIs, creating transparency around campaign progress, impact and learnings. 

 

Who you are

  • You bring proven leadership and international marketing experience in the music or media industry, with a focus on international repertoire in a local market environment
  • You have successfully positioned international artists and global releases in local markets and understand how international campaigns become culturally relevant and effective in the GSA market
  • You understand the specific dynamics of the German, Austrian and Swiss markets and can translate global strategies convincingly into local market logic, audiences and activation measures
  • You have a broad, genre-spanning understanding of repertoire and a strong instinct for artist, audience, platform and cultural trends
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong executional drive, are highly confident in the digital landscape and can clearly prioritize and effectively steer different releases and market opportunities
  • You bring a deep understanding of the digital marketing landscape and the ability to translate emerging trends, platform dynamics and audience behavior into impactful innovative artist campaigns
  • You are a convincing and appreciative leader who provides direction, empowers others, brings different perspectives together and enables teams to succeed
  • You are a clear and confident communicator who knows how to adapt tone, message and level of detail to different audiences and stakeholder groups
  • You bring a strong business mindset and manage budgets, resources and partners with a clear focus on reach, relevance and commercial impact
  • You work in a data-informed way while maintaining a strong creative instinct for artists, music and cultural dynamics
  • You are business-fluent in written and spoken German and English and can communicate confidently in both languages

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic, international environment at one of the leading companies in music and entertainment
  • Opportunities to shape and grow artists on a global scale
  • A collaborative culture with passionate teams across markets
  • Flexible working models and a modern workplace setup (depending on location)
  • Competitive compensation and a range of local benefits tailored to your region
  • Access to a strong global network and development opportunities within Sony Music
  How to Apply

Skip the formalities. We don’t need photos, personal background details or perfectly formatted applications.

Show us who you are.
What you’ve built.
What you hear that others don’t.

Send us something that represents you — CV, playlist, projects, ideas — whatever tells your story best.

Sony Music sounds better with you
