job.title: Lead Software Engineer - Roku
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 


LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the technical direction of the Paramount+ Roku application — the platform, the patterns, the architecture. This is a hands-on leadership role where you write and review code and set the standard for a team of engineers shipping features to millions of viewers.

Roku's constraints — tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, hardware spanning five years of device generations — are the environment you thrive in, not just tolerate. You know these constraints well enough to teach them, and you'll lead a team through them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set technical direction for the Paramount+ Roku application — choose the patterns, own the architecture, defend the decisions
• Build and maintain core framework components and features — this is a hands-on role where you ship code
• Lead a team of Roku engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and feedback that helps people grow• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements• Ship real-time personalization features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, and ad engagement experiences — within Roku's memory and threading constraints
• Drive adoption of RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing across the team
• Scope projects, identify risks before they become blockers, and keep the team shipping
• Coordinate with Product, Design, Backend Engineering, and DevOps/SRE to translate requirements into plans your team can execute
• Write architecture docs, RFCs, and component guides so decisions are visible and durable
• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, testing infrastructure, and build tooling
• Design and run A/B tests, then act on the results
• Use AI development tools to move faster, and help the team adopt them


WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

• Your team ships on time because you scoped the work correctly — not because anyone worked weekends
• Engineers on your team grow quarter over quarter. They take on harder problems this quarter than last. You can name what changed
• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day — and you've given your team the docs and context to do the same• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it, write up what happened, and turn it into a pattern the team follows• You write architecture decisions down. Six months later, a new engineer reads one and understands why you chose what you chose
• You push back when a plan has gaps and suggest a better one — without making people feel small
• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
• You make the people around you better at their jobs. They'd say so if asked


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years writing software
• 4+ years building Roku applications
• 2+ years leading a team or serving as a technical lead• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience• Strong foundation in OOP, data structures, and algorithms — able to design systems and evaluate others' designs
• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3 — you can explain the tradeoffs between MoveIntoField, PostMessage, and CopyMessage without looking them up
• Deep command of the Roku threading model and where performance falls apart on low-end devices
• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay
• Unit and integration testing on Roku — you've built test infrastructure, not just written tests
• RESTful API design, HTTP caching behavior, and CDN interaction
• Git and GitHub
• Strong technical writing — architecture docs and plans that people actually read and act on
• Active use of AI development tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) with concrete examples of how they've changed how you work


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)
• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS
• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns• Experience integrating personalization or recommendation systems into connected-device applications
• Experience with real-time or event-driven architectures on client platforms
• E2E testing for connected-device applications
• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)
• GraphQL
• Track record of introducing AI tools to a team — actual adoption, not just a demo
• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right
• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock yourself

job.title: Associate Director, Global Priorities
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Your role:

The Global Priorities Associate Director at Warner Music Group plays a central role in developing and driving marketing strategy for the company’s highest-priority global artists. This position works cross-functionally to coordinate campaign planning and execution, ensuring alignment across label affiliates, commercial partners, and creative teams worldwide. The ideal candidate brings strategic marketing expertise, a global mindset, and a passion for helping artists break on the world stage.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the creation of comprehensive, multi-market marketing plans for WMG’s top global priority artists in collaboration with label teams and regional collaborators.

  • Partner with WMG affiliates around the world to localize campaign strategies, share resources, and ensure consistent execution of global priorities

  • Be responsible for global rollout timelines, deliverables, and go-to-market activities, ensuring campaigns launch on time and meet performance benchmarks.

  • Track key campaign and artist benchmarks globally, and work with analytics and marketing intelligence teams to identify insights and optimize efforts

  • Identify and apply emerging global marketing trends, platform innovations, and fan engagement strategies to enhance the visibility and growth of global artists

About you:

  • 5-7 years demonstrated ability in music marketing, global brand management, or international campaign strategy—preferably within a record label, artist management, or entertainment company

  • Proven ability to work across international markets and cultures, with a strong understanding of how to adapt strategy for local audiences while maintaining global cohesion

  • Exceptional organizational abilities with experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder campaigns on tight timelines

  • Strong interpersonal and written communication skills; comfortable working cross-functionally with senior executives, creatives, and regional teams

  • Deep passion for music and a strong grasp of global pop culture, digital trends, and fan behaviors across platforms and territories


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

job.title: Automotive Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Automotive Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Automotive Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

The Content Stylist supports QVC and HSN, and you will be reporting to the Stylist Supervisor. You will be is responsible for the preparation and styling of all soft- and hard-good products during multi-channel platform productions. You will collaborate with a team of creative photographers, videographers and Art Directors, and you ensure that they execute QVC brand stylistically and appropriately during still photography and video shoots.

Where You'll Work

This role is onsite and will require you to work from our West Chester, PA headquarters daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role. This is a full-time role. We release the schedule one to two weeks in advance. You will primarily work from Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm.

What You'll Do

Responsible for styling soft- and hard-goods for multi-channel platforms. This includes:

  • Acquisition and prepping of all products.
  • Create proper look, feel and environment to make sure products are represented based on style direction and style guides.
  • Using Branding information from several sources including category and creative to ensure styling is brand-right.
  • Gather and coordinate props to enhance and romance product.
  • Design and realize tabletop and set builds.
  • Research and coordinate model outfits and accessories, ensuring proper fit and product accuracy.
  • Partner with Product Central to ensure product is available for production; restore Model Area, return products, care for model prop closet clothes, etc.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor of Arts/Science in a related field or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience with apparel and prop styling for print, web, and retail and/or TV production/photo shoots.
  • In-depth knowledge of current style and fashion trends; understanding of fashion styling elements based on brand, silhouette, etc.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of on-figure styling and layflats.
  • Ability to coordinate outfits and accessories, and interpret style guides and creative decks to style to the QVC brand

job.title: Weekend Meteorologist, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN 9, we help Southern Arizona stay informed, prepared, and connected every day. As our Weekend Meteorologist, you'll deliver accurate, compelling forecasts that matter to viewers across Tucson and the surrounding communities. From monsoon storms and extreme heat to clear desert skies, you'll help audiences understand how weather impacts their daily lives. You'll be a trusted on-air presence while contributing weather and news content across multiple platforms. This is an opportunity to combine forecasting expertise, storytelling, and community engagement in one of the country's most unique weather markets.WHAT YOU'LL DO:
  • Prepare and deliver engaging weekend weathercasts using the latest meteorological data, radar systems, and graphics technology.
  • Analyze weather information from satellites, radar, models, and other forecasting tools to create accurate forecasts.
  • Provide urgent weather updates and breaking severe weather coverage when conditions warrant.
  • Produce and distribute weather content across television, digital, social, streaming, and other media platforms.
  • Develop weather-related story ideas and enterprise content that informs and serves the community.
  • Report live from community events, weather-related locations, or field assignments as needed.
  • Drive station vehicles to remote broadcast locations and live reporting assignments throughout the viewing area.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership and technical teams to evaluate emerging weather technologies and presentation tools.
  • Research, gather, and verify information through observation, interviews, and reliable sources.
  • Support newsroom operations and perform additional duties that contribute to overall station success.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:
  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology or a related field preferred.
  • Three or more years of forecasting and on-air meteorology experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company requirements required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
  • Strong understanding of meteorological forecasting tools, weather systems, and broadcast presentation techniques.
  • Proficiency with weather graphics systems, newsroom technology, and digital publishing platforms.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and field production workflows.
  • Experience with video editing systems and multimedia storytelling.
  • Excellent broadcast writing and AP style writing skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex weather information clearly and confidently across multiple platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across departments to serve viewers and communities.
  • Ability to travel locally for live shots, community events, and field reporting assignments.

OUR TEAM:KGUN 9 is a passionate and community-focused newsroom dedicated to serving Southern Arizona. Our team includes experienced journalists, storytellers, meteorologists, and digital innovators who value collaboration, creativity, and public service. We support one another, celebrate diverse perspectives, and work together to deliver trusted local content that makes a difference in the communities we serve.WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:Tucson offers an exceptional quality of life with over 300 days of sunshine each year, stunning mountain views, and a vibrant cultural scene. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore Saguaro National Park, world-class hiking and cycling trails, and nearby destinations throughout the Sonoran Desert.The city blends rich Southwestern heritage with modern amenities, outstanding food, arts, and entertainment. Whether you're enjoying a local festival, exploring historic neighborhoods, or taking in spectacular desert sunsets, Tucson provides an inspiring backdrop for both your career and your lifestyle.#LI-SM2

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
|Current USA TODAY Co. Employees- Please ensure you are using our abbreviated process on the internal Careers site by logging into Dayforce through MyApps|

USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

Account Executive – Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Erie, PA area | Hybrid (home office with client/prospect visits as needed)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Are you looking to launch or grow your career in sales and marketing? Our Account Executive role is an excellent opportunity for motivated early-career professionals who are eager to learn consultative selling, develop business relationships, and make a direct impact on local businesses.

In this role, you'll identify new business opportunities, engage with prospective clients, and recommend marketing solutions that help businesses grow. You'll partner with local businesses to understand their goals, present tailored marketing recommendations, and support their growth through a combination of digital and traditional advertising solutions. You'll also collaborate closely with our post-sale support teams, who manage campaign performance, reporting, and optimization.

During your first 90 days, you'll participate in structured onboarding, learn LocaliQ's products and sales process, and begin building your prospecting and client engagement skills. Our goal is to provide the coaching and resources needed to help you ramp successfully and build a long-term career in sales.

Why This Role Stands Out

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission potential

• Comprehensive training and structured onboarding program

• Hands-on experience in consultative sales and digital marketing

• Mentorship and ongoing coaching from experienced sales leaders

• Clear career path into senior sales and leadership opportunities

• President's Club, contests, and recognition programs

• Hybrid flexibility and autonomy in managing your territory

• Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and technology

• Strong support from marketing specialists, strategists, and post-sales teams

What You Will Do

• Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

• Build relationships with prospective clients and identify business growth opportunities.

• Conduct discovery conversations to understand client needs and business goals.

• Partner with experienced team members to develop and present marketing recommendations.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and develop strong pipeline management habits.

• Collaborate with internal teams to support positive client experiences.

• Participate in ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development.

• Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

• Motivated self-starter with a desire to learn and grow in a sales career.

• Comfortable speaking with new people and building professional relationships.

• Organized with strong time-management skills and attention to detail.

• Experience using Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM systems

• Interest in digital marketing, advertising, or business growth solutions.

• Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Executives are curious, coachable, resilient, and motivated to learn. They enjoy connecting with people, are comfortable stepping outside their comfort zone, and view challenges as opportunities for growth. Whether you're coming from sales, customer service, hospitality, athletics, recruiting, or are an upcoming graduate, this role offers the training and support needed to build a rewarding career in consultative sales.

This version should resonate strongly with new graduates, recent graduates, athletes, retail/customer-service talent, recruiting backgrounds, and early-career professionals while still supporting LocaliQ's consultative sales model.

#LI-Remote

As such, we will consider all qualified applicants for employment and do not discriminate in connection with employment decisions on the basis of an applicant or employee’s race, color, national origin, ethnicity, ancestry, citizenship status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, marital status, personal appearance (including height and weight), sexual orientation, family responsibilities, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), education, genetic characteristics or information, political affiliation, military or veteran status or other classifications protected by applicable federal, state and local laws in the jurisdictions where USA TODAY Co. employs employees. In addition, USA TODAY Co., Inc. will provide applicants who require a reasonable accommodation, as a result of an applicant’s disability or religion, to complete this employment application and/or any other process in connection with an individuals’ application for employment with USA TODAY Co., Inc. Applicants who require such accommodation should contact USA TODAY Co., Inc.’s Recruitment Department at Recruit@usatodayco.com. Applicants must be authorized to work in the applicable location. job.title: Deputy Editor, Breaking News and Live
job.description:
Deputy Editor, Breaking News and Live


The San Francisco Chronicle seeks an editor to help expand the way we cover news in real time and oversee our live news operation.


This editor will have two central responsibilities: monitoring, assigning and editing daily breaking news; and helping the Chronicle uplevel and expand our “live” coverage. The role is ideal for an editor with strong news judgment and an appetite for audience strategy and emerging forms of digital storytelling.


They will help determine what matters right now, how quickly we need to respond and the best way to serve readers as a story develops. They will also help build a stronger, more consistent live-journalism operation under the direction of senior leadership. This could include launching and editing live blogs, coming up with new ways to publish rolling updates on developing news stories, real-time explainers, event coverage, alerts and other emerging formats that help readers understand what is happening.


In particular, this editor must be interested in using artificial intelligence tools and automated systems to help drive breaking news discovery and content delivery to readers. This position reports to the Breaking News Editor and will work especially closely with the audience team on live coverage.


Responsibilities

 

  • Monitor for, assign and edit stories on breaking news and emerging developments.

  • Launch and edit live blogs and other rolling coverage.

  • Help develop an evolving editorial approach to live journalism.

  • Increase the volume and range of the Chronicle’s live journalism by identifying opportunities across major coverage arenas: breaking news, elections, severe weather, major public events, sports and other high-interest moments.

  • Use audience data to evaluate live coverage and improve its format, cadence, reach and usefulness.

  • Help test live storytelling formats, tools and workflows across web, app, alerts, newsletters and social platforms.

  • Participate in an editing rotation that may include nights, weekends and holidays.

     

Qualifications

 

  • At least two years’ experience at a daily newspaper, magazine or web publication or the equivalent as a reporter and/or editor

  • Strong news judgment and instinct for what matters to Bay Area readers.

  • Experience with live blogs, rolling coverage, real-time updates or another form of continuous digital journalism.

  • Excellent editing, headline-writing and digital-production skills.

  • An understanding of how to use real-time data and audience signals to inform editorial decisions.

     

This is a full-time position based in San Francisco. The role requires flexibility to work nights, weekends and holidays as part of a rotating breaking-news and live-coverage schedule.

 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in California. The reasonable estimate is between $80,000 and $100,000. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

 

About SF Chronicle:

The San Francisco Chronicle (www.sfchronicle.com) is the largest newspaper in Northern California and the second largest on the West Coast. Acquired by the Hearst Corporation in 2000, The San Francisco Chronicle was founded in 1865 by Charles and Michael de Young and has been awarded six Pulitzer Prizes for journalistic excellence.

 

HNP Overview: 

With 2,500 employees across the nation, Hearst Newspapers (HNP) represents a network of 28 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the Austin American-Statesman, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, San Francisco Chronicle and Times Union (Albany). Our portfolio also includes several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites such as Chron., CT Insider, MySA and SFGATE, along with marketing services businesses like Medium Giant and entertainment brands such as King Features Syndicate. 

 

At HNP, we’re investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories — growing newsrooms, diversifying tools and evolving platforms — to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. 

 

Be part of something bigger — Your Headline Awaits

It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

This is a hybrid role based in our Norfolk, VA office. You can typically expect to come into the office 2+ days/week.

job.title: Creative Operations Lead
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Creative Operations Lead to join Translation!

What You'll Do

The Creative Operations Lead is a critical operational leader at Translation, responsible for ensuring the right people are on the right work at the right time across every active account and initiative. This role sits at the center of the agency's capacity ecosystem, partnering closely with the Program Management team to keep delivery on track, talent balanced, and the business protected.

As Translation scales its resource planning capabilities — including the rollout of a new, intuitive staffing and capacity platform, this lead will serve as both the operational owner of that tool and the strategic steward of how people are planned, protected, and prioritized across billable and non-billable work.

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Own and manage staffing allocations across all active client accounts, ensuring people are planned accurately and updated in real time.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing adoption of Translation's new resource management platform, serving as the primary administrator and internal champion.
  • Surface capacity conflicts, volume pressure points, and over-allocation risks proactively — before they become delivery problems.
  • Partner daily with the PM team to align headcount plans with project timelines, scope changes, and shifting client demands.
  • Develop and maintain clear visibility into who is available, who is over-committed, and where gaps exist across all functions.
  • Track talent skills and passions.

Workload Balancing & Prioritization

  • Balance competing demands across billable client work, proactive creative opportunities, new business pitches, and internal initiatives.
  • Make and communicate clear recommendations on when and how to pull staff from non-billable work in service of billable priorities.
  • Establish and enforce workload thresholds that protect talent from burnout while maintaining agency output and quality.
  • Build frameworks for how to triage competing requests, ensuring leadership has the right information to make fast, informed staffing calls.

Freelancer Management

  • Proactively source and pipeline freelance talent in advance of high-volume periods, ensuring the agency is never caught flat-footed when capacity spikes.
  • Manage first holds on preferred freelancers across disciplines, maintaining relationships so Translation has priority access when demand peaks.
  • Negotiate freelance rates with an eye toward engagement length securing better terms for longer commitments while staying within agency margin thresholds.
  • Vet new freelancers in partnership with relevant discipline leads and key creative, strategy, and production leaders before adding them to the approved roster.
  • Own and maintain a current, organized freelancer database including rates, availability windows, past project history, and performance notes  so the agency can move quickly when a need arises.

Awards & Case Study Management

  • Own the end-to-end process for awards submissions tracking eligible work, managing timelines, coordinating materials, and submitting entries across relevant shows.
  • Build and maintain a living library of agency case studies, ensuring work is documented accurately and kept current across accounts.
  • Partner with Business Development, Business Leadership, Strategy, and Creative to capture the story behind Translation's best work in a format ready for new business, press, and agency promotion.
  • Develop a calendar and workflow for proactive awards planning to avoid last-minute scrambles.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the PM team, creating tight alignment between resource plans and delivery commitments.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Business Leadership and Client Engagement teams on capacity and staffing strategy, translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with People Operations on headcount planning, open role identification, and freelance needs driven by capacity gaps.
  • Represent resource management in agency planning conversations, including scoping, new business, and organizational design discussions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account staffing in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • Strong command of resource management tools and platforms; experience leading a tool rollout or system migration is a plus.
  • Experience managing or willing to learn managing awards submissions and/or case study development, with a clear understanding of how agency recognition supports business development.
  • A systems thinker who is equally comfortable in the weeds of a staffing grid and in a strategic conversation about organizational design.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can translate operational complexity into simple, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  • A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly and maintains it under pressure.
  • High integrity around people data: this role has visibility into utilization and performance-adjacent information and must handle it with discretion.                                                                             

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in resource management, project management, creative operations, or a related function within a creative agency or marketing organization.
  • Deep understanding of how creative agencies work, the rhythms of production, the difference between billable and non-billable time, and how to protect both.
  • Freelance recruiting experience and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing and enhancing a product or platform.
  • A strong network of freelance talent relationships.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

  • Investigate suspicious activity, incidents, and safety violations; document findings thoroughly.

job.title: Associate Corporate Counsel
job.description:
Title: Associate Corporate Counsel - Construction and Commercial Contracts

Reports to: General Counsel, Meruelo Enterprises

About the Role:

The Associate Corporate Counsel - Construction and Commercial Contracts is a parent-company legal role responsible for supporting contract review, negotiation, risk management, and contract governance across Meruelo Enterprises and its subsidiaries. The position partners with subsidiary contract coordinators, business leaders, project teams, and corporate functions to promote consistent contracting practices, identify and mitigate risk, and support timely business decisions. The role provides legal guidance and functional oversight while each subsidiary contract coordinator remains responsible for local contract intake, administration, tracking, and execution support.

Key Responsibilities:

² Serve as the centralized legal resource for contracts submitted by Meruelo Enterprises subsidiaries and corporate departments.

² Review, draft, analyze, and negotiate construction contracts, subcontracts, master service agreements, professional services agreements, vendor and supplier agreements, purchase orders, nondisclosure agreements, leases, and other commercial agreements.

² Identify and communicate legal, operational, financial, insurance, and compliance risks in clear, practical business terms.

² Review and provide guidance on various union labor agreements.

² Reference utilizing Document Crunch.

² Prepare contract redlines and alternative language addressing indemnification, defense obligations, limitations of liability, consequential damages, insurance, bonding, payment, change orders, warranties, delays, liquidated damages, termination, dispute resolution, and other risk-allocation provisions.

² Advise executive leadership and subsidiary stakeholders regarding contractual obligations, exceptions, and recommended risk-mitigation strategies.

² Provide legal guidance and functional oversight to contract coordinators located within each subsidiary, including review of escalated issues and nonstandard terms.

² Establish consistent enterprise contract intake, legal review, approval, execution, retention, and escalation practices in partnership with subsidiary contract coordinators and business leaders.

² Develop and maintain approved templates, clause libraries, contract playbooks, review checklists, approval matrices, and negotiation guidelines.

² Support project teams during contract performance, including interpretation of notice requirements, change-order provisions, payment rights, claims procedures, and closeout obligations.

² Assist with construction and commercial disputes involving change orders, delays, payment, defaults, mechanics liens, stop notices, bond claims, collections, and other contract matters.

² Coordinate with outside counsel on specialized legal issues, disputes, litigation, arbitration, mediation, and other matters as directed by the General Counsel.

² Partner with Risk Management and insurance professionals to evaluate contractual insurance and indemnity requirements.

² Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Estimating, Procurement, Project Management, Human Resources, and executive leadership on contract-related matters.

² Provide training to contract coordinators and business stakeholders regarding contract risk, company standards, and escalation requirements.

² Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting construction and commercial contracting and recommend updates to templates, processes, and guidance.

² Maintain organized legal records and support reporting on contract volume, risk themes, cycle times, escalations, and other relevant metrics.

² Perform other legal duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

² Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.

² Active membership in good standing with the State Bar of California.

² Two to three years of legal experience in commercial contracts, construction law, corporate transactions, procurement, real estate, or a related practice area.

² Demonstrated experience reviewing, drafting, or negotiating contracts through employment, a clerkship, internship, or law firm practice.

² Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and contract-drafting skills.

² Ability to explain legal issues and recommendations to nonlegal stakeholders in practical, business-focused terms.

² Ability to manage multiple matters, prioritize deadlines, and work across several subsidiaries in a fast-paced environment.

² Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn contract management and document-management systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

² Experience with construction, engineering, utilities, infrastructure, telecommunications, public works, or related industries.

² Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.

² Active membership in good standing with the State Bar of California.

² Familiarity with California construction law, public contracting, mechanics lien and stop-notice requirements, insurance, bonding, and construction claims.

² Experience supporting multiple business units, subsidiaries, or decentralized contract-administration teams.

² Prior in-house legal department experience or law firm experience representing construction or commercial clients.

² Experience developing contract templates, clause libraries, playbooks, or standardized review procedures.

² Bilingual English and Spanish skills are a plus.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements:

² Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment, with regular use of a computer and other standard office equipment.

² Ability to review detailed documents and remain seated for extended periods.

² Occasional travel to subsidiary offices, project locations, or legal proceedings may be required.

² Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Product Growth Manager
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Overview

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PlutoTV pod. You will focus on Channel, Guide, and Schedule personalization. Your goal is to make the FAST (Free Ad-supported Streaming TV) experience feel as dynamic as a premium on-demand service. You will help build the models that select which channels appear in the guide and how content is scheduled to maximize viewer session length.   This role requires deep knowledge of FAST systems and the unique constraints of linear programming. You will implement features within our GCP stack, leveraging Qdrant for content similarity and Post-training RL to optimize the "Lean-back" viewing experience.   Why This Role Matters
  • Modernizing Linear TV: You are part of the team transforming the static EPG (Electronic Programming Guide) into a personalized, data-driven discovery engine.
  • Optimizing the "Lean-Back": Your models help users find something to watch immediately, reducing the friction inherent in "channel surfing."
  • Global Scale: PlutoTV is a leader in the FAST space; your code will impact the viewing habits of millions of users worldwide.
  Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development: Design and deploy ML components for channel ranking and guide personalization.
  • FAST Metadata Integration: Work with linear scheduling data to create features that account for "Current" vs "Next" program relevance.
  • Vector-Based Similarity: Use Qdrantto group similar channels and content to improve the "More Like This" experience within the guide.
  • Model Refinement: Train and iterate on models using TensorFlow/PyTorch, focusing on session-start and watch-time metrics.
  • Independent Execution: Own the delivery of defined tasks within the PlutoTV roadmap, from data exploration to production deployment.
  Basic Qualifications
  • Minimum: 3+ years in MLE; proficiency in Python/SQL; experience with TensorFlow/PyTorch and GCP.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Preferred: Knowledge with FAST or Broadcast TV data structures; experience with Qdrant or similar vector databases.

To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

Integrated Media Specialist – Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Knoxville, TN | Hybrid (Mix of Remote/ In-Office + In-territory)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

• Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

• Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

• Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

•  Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp

• Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

• Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles

• Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

What You Will Do

• Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

• Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

• Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

• Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

• Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

• Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

• Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

• 3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles (experience level may vary by market and role level; Recruiter to update).

  • Build and maintain reusable templates, tools, and documentation for recurring editorial workflows
  • Onboard and guide designers on front-end systems to streamline asset handoffs and workflow integration
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • You will report to the Deputy Editor, Design

  • Strong grasp of visual design fundamentals, including typography, layout, motion, and interaction.

  • Experience with motion design, data visualization, video and audio work
  • Strong understanding of design details regarding layout hierarchy, visual consistency, motion timing, and typography

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• 6+ years writing software

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• RESTful API design and data serialization

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV

Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

job.title: Director, Financial Reporting - SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a a Director, Financial Reporting to join our team in Nashville. As the Director, Financial Reporting you will own the Group’s consolidated financial reporting under US GAAP and will assist foreign subsidiary teams in relevant technical accounting areas, as necessary. In this role you will lead technical accounting research and conclusions, reviews contracts for the appropriate accounting treatment, supports M&A transactions from an accounting and general-ledger perspective, and work hands-on with the subsidiary finance teams on consolidation, intercompany eliminations and equity movements. As it relates to accurate and timely financial reporting, a key part of the role is leading the finance team’s adoption of AI to create efficiencies across the financial reporting process.

As the successful candidate, you will be comfortable working independently and shows initiative in identifying problems, leading solutions and ensuring appropriate resolution and recording in the general ledger. You will also be comfortable and confident in leading and presenting your work to both the finance team and company leadership, and bring exceptional analytical and critical-thinking skills, strong attention to detail, and clear, collaborative communication, together with a thorough, technical-level understanding of US GAAP.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Technical accounting research and interpretation of accounting guidance in areas such as business combinations, stock-based compensation, debt, software capitalization etc. and document conclusions in accounting memos on an as-needed basis.
  • Assessing accounting implications for complex transactions and guide the accounting team in accurately reflecting the accounting and financial reporting impact in the Company’s financial statements (both through journal entries and financial statements presentation).
  • Leading and guiding the team on AI implementation to create efficiencies in the financial reporting process. This would entail running process deep dives to identify where AI can improve operational and reporting efficiency and delivering those improvements.
  • Supporting M&A transactions from an accounting and general-ledger perspective, including purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, GL recording and integration of acquired entities to help implement standardized processes related to financial reporting.
  • Reviewing nonstandard contracts, including revenue, debt, investment etc. to determine the appropriate accounting treatment and document the conclusions.
  • Implementing and evaluating new accounting standards.
  • Reviewing monthly and quarterly consolidation and primary statements at the group level.
  • Taking a hands-on approach with the subsidiary finance teams on consolidation, US GAAP and local GAAP differences, intercompany eliminations, settlements, and equity movements etc., ensuring group figures are complete, accurate and well-supported.
  • Preparing annual US GAAP consolidated financial statements including drafting of disclosures.
  • Serving as the primary liaison for the external auditors for overall audit management, including presenting and defending accounting positions taken by the Company.
  • Working cross-functionally with other departments to increase financial reporting accuracy.
  • Assisting and overseeing special projects as assigned.
  • Other duties as needed and assigned by supervisor.

What Makes You Qualified:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related field, or equivalent combination of education & experience.
  • 5+ years high-quality experience in a technical accounting and/or financial reporting role.
  • 2+ years public account experience preferred.
  • Active CPA license required.
  • Big 4 public accounting firm experience strongly preferred.
  • A confident self-starter — comfortable working independently, taking initiative to solve problems, work collaboratively with the finance team to lead solutions through to completion, and presenting work to both the finance team and leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations and settlements, and equity movements.
  • Experience supporting M&A transactions — purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, and GL recording and integration of acquired entities.
  • Experience reporting under both US GAAP and foreign GAAP (IFRS or local) preferred.
  • Comfortable adopting and working with new technology, with a curiosity for emerging tools — including AI — and how they can improve financial reporting.
  • Have exceptional attention to detail and an ability to effectively prioritize work to meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS Office products (especially Excel).

This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

Our programming is distinctive, intelligent, innovative, and entertaining, much like the people we're looking to hire.

Job Summary

CBC Sports is looking for an Executive Producer for the 2028 Summer Olympic Games. Reporting to the Executive Director, the successful candidate will be a key member of the leadership team of CBC Olympics.  This position will work closely with two other Executive producers who oversee different aspects of the production.  

We are looking for an experienced producer who will push the boundaries of traditional broadcasting. As an editorial leader for the LA28 Games, you will champion unconventional narratives, bold visual formats, and fresh ways to capture the human drama of the Olympics—actively seeking to expand our range and impact across all screens.

The Executive Producer is instrumental in assigning stories to be chased, monitoring development, creating a coverage plan for the Games, and contributing to the overall planning function of the Games. The successful candidate will also be expected to mentor, direct, and develop programming talent, producers, on-air talent, and hosts, as well as take an active role in department-wide and CBC initiatives.

Function

Plans, conceives, organizes, and/or develops the production and realization of a program segment, program, or series. Work must adhere to CBC journalistic and/or program policies, standards, and practices, and the Executive Producer is ultimately responsible for ensuring that this occurs. Nevertheless, there is wide latitude for initiative, independent judgment, and creativity. There is a regular and ongoing requirement to co-ordinate the work of others.


 

Key Tasks

  • Conceives, develops, and champions ground-breaking program concepts that challenge conventional sports production. You will use your creative latitude to design distinctive, non-traditional formats that seamlessly bridge live television and digital platforms, turning complex technical setups into canvas elements for immersive, high-impact storytelling.

  • Review the style, pace, tempo, and format of the broadcast. Rather than relying on standard sports templates, you will bring a fresh aesthetic and creative choreography to live multi-sport events, tailoring content dynamically for different audiences and platforms.

  • Develops the program content including assigning, researching, gathering, writing, and/or editing; as required, commissions writing/research and prepares scripts.

  • Plans, organizes, and co-ordinates the program or its various components and segments.

  • Plans, selects, and requests, in collaboration with the Unit or Business Manager, the financial and production/resource requirements including creative contributors, participants, materials, and facilities. Responsible and accountable for exercising budget authority during program preparation, production, and post-production.

  • Exercises editorial responsibility as delegated by Management.

  • Evaluates all facets of a production, including the performance of program and production personnel and freelance contributors.

  • As required, performs the following tasks:

    • Directs talent, sound, and/or image.

    • Selects, re-writes, and/or edits copy or text written by others.

    • Ensures, in collaboration with Copyright Clearance Officers or others, the proper and accurate clearance of all material used in the program.

    • Determines the order and importance of various elements of a program.

    • Assigns, co-ordinates, and supervises the work of personnel who contribute to the program or segment for which the Producer is responsible.

    • Identifies, develops, and maintains contacts appropriate to the area of assignment.

    • Oversees internet site design and structure and organizes/co-ordinates on-line content.

    • Oversees the shooting, editing, encoding, digitizing, and packaging of digital audio and video for the internet.

    • Prepares programs for the internet, including coding, and manipulating images and graphics.

    • Edits and mixes, or directs the editing and mixing of audio and/or visual elements.

    • Assures the maintenance of a level of communication or rapport with members of the audience which is both feasible and appropriate to the style and nature of the program

.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent and ten years' experience, of which five must involve work in broadcasting or a closely related industry.

  • Significant experience producing live international multi-sports event programming.

  • Experience writing, editing, and conceptualizing the content and flow of distinctive programming.

  • Desirable experience in sports journalism; must demonstrate solid editorial knowledge of national and international sports news and issues.

  • Extensive knowledge of international professional and amateur sports (with special emphasis on Olympic sports).

  • Proven ability and experience working with a sales/revenue department developing programming to meet client needs, programming objectives, and financial goals.

  • Experience meeting and presenting programming concepts to clients, sponsors, and agencies.

  • Strong leadership skills to motivate a programming team, on-air talent, and hosts.

  • Ability to forward-plan while remaining topical and current.

  • Highly developed interpersonal skills, able to communicate effectively and cooperatively (established relationships with Canadian Sports Federations are an asset).

  • A proven understanding of the CBC and the relationship between Sports, the network, and regional programming.

  • An understanding and appreciation of complex production and technical needs.

  • An innovator in digital storytelling. You possess a deep curiosity for emerging digital media trends and know how to leverage social, interactive, and on-line content to build creative, narrative-driven experiences that extend far beyond the linear television screen.

  • Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure and stressful environment.

  • Ability to travel as required and to work long and flexible hours.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

The Board Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and organizational support to the Board of Directors and Executive Leadership. As a trusted partner, this role ensures the smooth and efficient operation of Board activities, executive schedules, meetings, travel, and confidential communications.

The successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced public company environment and brings exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion when working with sensitive information and senior stakeholders.

• Managing directors’ expenses, invoices, and other administrative activities.

• Coordinating confidential communications and handling sensitive matters with professionalism and discretion.

• Supporting other board and executive activities and initiatives as required.

Skills & Experience You Will Bring

• Demonstrated experience supporting boards of directors, board committees, C-suite executives, or senior leadership teams.

• Experience in Board administration and a strong understanding of corporate governance practices.

• Experience working in a public company, publicly traded organization, or highly regulated environment is preferred.

• Experience in media, telecommunications, broadcasting, or a similarly complex corporate environment is an asset.

• Experience coordinating board or executive-level meetings, events, travel, and governance processes.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams.

• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with executives, Board members, and colleagues at all levels of the organization.
