job.title: Fleet Manager
job.description:
Title: Fleet Manager

Reports to: VP of Operations

 

Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power), a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises, is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction.

But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Fleet Manager to oversee the vehicles and specialized equipment supporting our underground civil and electric utility construction operations.

This position is responsible for fleet safety, availability, maintenance, compliance, utilization, and cost control. The Fleet Manager will work closely with operations, safety, accounting, purchasing, and field leadership to ensure equipment is properly assigned, maintained, inspected, documented, and ready to support daily production.

Our fleet includes service and foreman trucks, pickups, dump trucks, trailers, backhoes, excavators, skid steers, vacuum excavators, bucket trucks, digger derricks, and other utility-construction equipment.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Manage the daily operation, maintenance, assignment, and utilization of company vehicles, trailers, and construction equipment.

²  Maintain accurate fleet records, including unit numbers, registrations, insurance, inspections, warranties, service histories, mileage, and operating hours.

²  Develop and manage preventive-maintenance and inspection schedules.

²  Ensure compliance with DOT, DMV, BIT, CHP, OSHA, and applicable state and federal requirements.

²  Coordinate equipment repairs, breakdown response, towing, rentals, and replacement units to minimize field downtime.

²  Review repair estimates and approve work within established authorization limits.

²  Track fleet expenses, including maintenance, repairs, fuel, tires, rentals, registrations, and insurance.

²  Monitor fuel-card activity, identify unusual usage, and ensure transactions are assigned to the correct vehicle, employee, and project.

²  Manage rental equipment and vehicles, including approvals, extensions, off-rent dates, damage documentation, and invoice reconciliation.

²  Coordinate the assignment, transfer, and return of vehicles and equipment between projects, yards, and employees.

²  Ensure all company units are properly numbered, branded, equipped, and documented before deployment.

²  Manage GPS, telematics, dash-camera, and driver-performance systems.

²  Monitor equipment utilization and recommend when to purchase, lease, transfer, replace, or dispose of assets.

²  Conduct regular fleet audits and yard inspections.

²  Maintain vendor relationships and negotiate pricing for repairs, parts, tires, fuel, rentals, and fleet services.

²  Support incident investigations involving company vehicles or equipment.

²  Verify that operators and drivers are properly licensed, qualified, and authorized for assigned equipment.

²  Develop and enforce fleet policies, inspection procedures, and accountability standards.

²  Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering fleet availability, downtime, utilization, repair costs, fuel consumption, rentals, and compliance.

²  Support project planning by confirming that the correct equipment is available, compliant, and job-ready.

 

Qualifications:

²  Five or more years of fleet-management experience, preferably within underground utilities, electrical construction, heavy civil construction, or a related field.

²  Strong working knowledge of construction vehicles and specialized utility equipment.

²  Experience managing preventive maintenance, repairs, inspections, registrations, rentals, and fleet records.

²  Knowledge of DOT, DMV, BIT, CHP, OSHA, and commercial-vehicle compliance requirements.

²  Experience with GPS, telematics, fleet-management, fuel-card, and asset-tracking systems.

²  Ability to review repair estimates, identify unnecessary costs, and make sound repair-versus-replacement decisions.

²  Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

²  Ability to work effectively with field employees, foremen, superintendents, project managers, mechanics, vendors, and executive leadership.

²  Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and fleet-reporting systems.

²  Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

²  Ability to visit project locations and respond to urgent fleet issues when necessary.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

²  Experience supporting underground civil and electric transmission and distribution operations.

²  Familiarity with bucket trucks, digger derricks, vacuum excavators, backhoes, excavators, skid steers, dump trucks, and commercial trailers.

²  Experience managing a multi-location fleet.

²  Commercial Driver’s License is a plus.

²  Experience with Samsara, ToolWatch, Fleetio, or similar platforms.

²  Technical or mechanical background is highly desirable.

²  Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

 

Performance Expectations:

²  The successful candidate will be measured on:

²  Fleet availability and equipment uptime

²  Preventive-maintenance completion

²  Regulatory and inspection compliance

²  Repair and maintenance costs

²  Fuel and rental cost control

²  Accurate fleet records and asset accountability

²  Reduction in preventable breakdowns and vehicle incidents

²  Timely support of field operations

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Director, AI Execution & Operations
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by sharing AI best practices, lessons learned, and recommendations that help scale successful outcomes.
  • Partner with AI champions, business stakeholders, and cross-functional AI leaders to build, support, and expand CMG's AI Champion Network.
  • Coordinate communications, awareness campaigns, webinars, and employee engagement activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to support adoption and embed AI into day-to-day workflows.
  • Coordinate AI training, workshops, office hours, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Create adoption playbooks, implementation guidance, best practices, FAQs, and success stories.
  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and apply AI capabilities to solve practical business challenges and improve business outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across teams pursuing AI initiatives to encourage knowledge sharing, consistency, and reuse of successful practices and solutions.
  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify AI deployment and support processes.
  • Help business leaders successfully integrate AI into existing workflows and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

  • Manage AI intake, evaluation, prioritization support, and execution tracking processes.
  • Support and coordinate governance reviews, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making activities in partnership with established governance bodies, business leaders, and AI stakeholders.
  • Support implementation of AI policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Partner with Technology, Security, Legal, and HR stakeholders to ensure compliance with established governance frameworks.
  • Maintain AI operational documentation, reporting, and decision records.
  • Develop scalable operational processes that support long-term AI growth and enterprise adoption.
  • Ensure governance decisions are implemented consistently across AI initiatives

job.title: Digital Traffic Specialist
job.description:
Hearst Television is seeking a Digital Traffic Specialist to own the execution and quality control of digital advertising orders across the station portfolio. This role is dedicated entirely to digital trafficking to include queue ownership, order validation, and escalation. This role reports to the Sr Manager, Digital Campaign Operations.

This role requires in-office presence at Hearst Television's Charlotte hub.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Order Trafficking & Queue Ownership

  • Own the digital trafficking queue end to end: receive, validate, and enter digital orders and copy instructions using DMI, DQC, and DAT.
  • Implement and QA digital creative, tags, and targeting across ad-serving platforms; including Google Ad Manager to ensure orders launch accurately and on schedule.
  • Manage day-to-day pacing and delivery of digital orders while flagging discrepancies and reporting issues.    

Quality Control & Escalation

  • Apply standardized intake and validation checks to catch order-input errors and copy mistakes before they're keyed into station systems.
  • Serve as the escalation point for digital order issues, coordinating directly with Station DCS and Digital Sales Managers (DSMs) to resolve discrepancies.
  • Document recurring issues and feed them back into process, training, and automation improvements.

DCS & Station Partnership

  • Partner with Station and Central DCS teams on order handoffs, coverage, and continuity for digital work.
  • Provide clear, responsive communication to stations and sales teams on order status, changes, and turnaround.

Process & Automation

  • Work within Hearst's digital order intake and copy-instruction automation tools, helping validate output and improve automated workflows (including DAT) against manual fallback processes.
  • Support the shift toward exception-based work as automation absorbs routine trafficking tasks.

Reporting

  • Track and report on turnaround time, first-pass quality, and Pushback rate for the digital queue.
  • Surface trends and recommend process changes to the Manager, Digital Traffic Operations.

 

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in broadcast traffic, digital traffic, order entry, or digital campaign operations.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort managing a high-volume, deadline-driven queue.
  • Experience with digital order-entry/trafficking systems strongly preferred; willingness to learn required for candidates without direct exposure.
  • Familiarity with digital ad-serving platforms (e.g., Google Ad Manager) a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with stations, sales, and Digital Operations.
  • Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and ticket- or queue-management tools.
  • Collaborative team player comfortable sharing workloads and backing up teammates.

job.title: Director, Special Events & Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Director of Special Events & Strategic Sourcing leads long-range strategic sourcing, procurement, and contract negotiations for hotel accommodations, meeting venues, and food and beverage programs across all premier Championships and Association initiatives. This role oversees third-party vendor relationships, manages event budgets, and ensures financial stewardship and legal protection for major events, including the PGA Championship, Ryder Cup, Board of Directors meetings, Annual Meetings, governance meetings, executive leadership events, PGA REACH functions, and other Association initiatives. Additionally, the position drives operational excellence, establishes procurement best practices, and directs the planning and execution of executive and Association special events.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

Strategic Sourcing & Long-Range Planning

Lead the multi-year planning cycle, securing hotel room blocks, meeting spaces, event venues, and key supplier relationships up to three to five in advance of Championships and Association events. 

Continually monitor hospitality industry trends, market compression cycles, and market fluctuations to identify risks and leverage negotiation opportunities early.

Lead destination research, hotel evaluations, venue assessments, and site inspections to identify facilities that best support the operational and strategic needs of the PGA of America.

Contractual Engagements & Financial Stewardship

Direct sourcing, RFP development, evaluation, negotiation, and execution of hotel agreements, all master service agreements, venue contracts, catering agreements, and other event related vendor contracts.

Negotiate contracts that protect the PGA of America from attrition, cancellation, force majeure while maximizing concessions,  rebates and value added services.

Develop and manage multi million dollar event budgets, forecasting future costs while ensuring procurement decisions maximize return on investment and operational efficiency.

Special Events Planning & Association Event Management

Serve as the strategic lead for planning and executing Association events, including Board of Directors meetings, the Annual Meeting, PGA REACH events, executive leadership and governance meetings, officer functions, awards events, VIP receptions, and internal conferences and retreats.

Develop comprehensive event plans including timelines, logistics, staffing, transportation, décor, entertainment, audiovisual production, registration, signage, and overall guest experience.

Establish operational standards and best practices to ensure consistency across all Association events regardless of location.

Food & Beverage Strategy

Develop comprehensive food & beverage strategies supporting Association meetings, executive functions, and special events.

Collaborate with hotels, venues, caterers, and culinary partners to develop menus, banquet service plans, beverage programs, and hospitality experiences that reflect the PGA of America's standards.

Oversee banquet guarantees, menu pricing, catering negotiations, service standards, and budget performance.

Identify innovative culinary experiences that enhance executive and member engagement while maintaining financial discipline.

Vendor & Strategic Partner Management

Develop and maintain long-term relationships with preferred hotel brands, convention centers, destination marketing organizations, destination management companies, transportation providers, audiovisual firms, entertainment partners, production companies, rental suppliers, registration vendors, and other strategic event partners.

Evaluate vendor performance through measurable service standards while identifying opportunities for increased efficiencies, innovation, and cost savings.

Maintain preferred supplier programs that create long-term value for the Association.

Executive & VIP Experience

Develop a thorough understanding of the expectations of PGA Officers, Board Members, Executive Leadership, PGA REACH donors, Championship leadership, players, sponsors, international guests, and member volunteers.

Serve as the Association's hospitality advisor for executive meetings and special events, ensuring every experience reflects the professionalism and brand standards of the PGA of America.

Oversee executive accommodations, VIP logistics, transportation coordination, and personalized service strategies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Championship Directors, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Communications, Player Services, Volunteer Operations, Corporate Partnerships, Ticketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure all procurement and event strategies support organizational priorities.

Provide strategic guidance during championship planning related to Association functions and executive events conducted alongside PGA Championships and Ryder Cups.

Operational Excellence & Risk Management

Develop contingency plans for lodging, transportation, food & beverage, venue operations, and other critical event services.

Lead operational response during unexpected disruptions including weather, vendor issues, hotel challenges, transportation delays, and other event-related risks.

Continuously evaluate processes and implement improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the Association event experience.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Recruit, mentor, and develop a high performing team responsible for strategic sourcing, special event planning, and Association meeting execution while  fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.

Develop a deep understanding of the diverse clientele, ranging from PGA Executives, Board Members, and PGA REACH donors to players, and various sponsors, tailoring housing strategies to meet their distinct expectations.

Manage housing bureaus, registration providers, destination management companies and other event partners to ensure seamless execution and exceptional service delivery.

INCLUSION:

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 

SHARED VALUES:

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values challenges and opportunities impacting you and your team.  Keep Leadership aware of the pulse of the workforce; recognizing, discussing, and addressing any cultural concerns.

SUPERVISION:

This is a supervisory position responsible for the performance management and hiring of employees within the department.  

FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

Responsible for preparation and oversight of the Department budget and for monitoring results.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred. 

Eight years of progressive leadership experience in strategic sourcing, hospitality management, corporate events, luxury hotel sales, meeting planning, or corporate procurement, with a focus on large-scale, citywide events and major sporting championships. Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams.

Four years team management experience.

Extensive knowledge of hotel contract law, attrition clauses, food and beverage agreements, venue contracts, and complex corporate or association negotiations.

Demonstrated experience managing multimillion-dollar event budgets, analyzing financial data, forecasting long-term costs, identifying savings opportunities, and ensuring all contractual obligations are met.

Experience in developing standard operating procedures, planning templates, and negotiation guidelines to support consistent and efficient event execution.

Travel and hospitality experience required.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:

Must have thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to work on various projects and programs as assigned.  A knowledge of the organization's functions of a business operation.  Skills in planning and organizing.  Ability to understand legal and contractual terminology as it pertains to event contracting. Ability to gather information, analyze data, and provide recommendations.  Ability to maintain the confidentiality of sensitive information with the highest level of integrity. Must have working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders.

Ability to travel up to 25%.

job.description:
The Director of Development & Production is a senior creative leader responsible for the development, production, and execution of premium digital-first content across Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment. This role oversees content from concept through delivery while driving creative innovation, production excellence, and audience growth across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is an experienced creative producer with a passion for storytelling, a proven ability to develop original franchises and recurring series, and an enthusiasm for Food, Travel, and Entertainment programming. They understand how to create compelling, platform-native content that grows audiences, attracts brand partners, and elevates an established media brand.

Working closely with executive leadership, editorial, audience development, and sales teams, the Director of Development & Production will lead creative development, oversee production operations, mentor production teams, and ensure every project meets the highest editorial and production standards.

Responsibilities

Creative Development & Strategy

  • Lead the creative development of original digital series, recurring franchises, specials, and branded content initiatives for growing digital editorial brands including @AmazingAmericaTV and @PauseRewind.
  • Identify emerging audience trends, platform opportunities, and storytelling formats that support audience growth and business objectives.
  • Generate, pitch, and develop new programming concepts while evolving existing series with fresh creative approaches.
  • Create series treatments, story outlines, mood boards, production decks, and presentation materials for internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Partner with leadership to build and maintain a robust content development pipeline aligned with editorial priorities and commercial opportunities.

Production Leadership

  • Oversee all productions from greenlight through final delivery across multiple platforms and formats.
  • Direct studio and field productions, providing clear creative vision to crews, producers, editors, and on-camera talent.
  • Manage creative execution throughout pre-production, production, post-production, and final approval.
  • Review and approve creative materials including treatments, scripts, casting recommendations, production schedules, budgets, graphics, music, rough cuts, fine cuts, and final deliverables.
  • Establish production workflows and best practices that improve efficiency while maintaining exceptional creative quality.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor producers, coordinators, freelance talent, editors, and production partners.
  • Foster a collaborative, creative culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage multiple concurrent productions while balancing priorities, deadlines, budgets, and available resources.
  • Facilitate creative brainstorms with Editorial, Audience Development, and Sales teams to maximize content performance.

Audience Growth & Optimization

  • Collaborate with Audience Development and Analytics teams to leverage performance insights and optimize future content.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of platform algorithms, viewer behavior, and evolving digital consumption habits.
  • Champion experimentation with new storytelling techniques, production technologies, creators, and distribution strategies.

Brand Partnerships & Business Development

  • Work closely with branded content and sales teams to develop premium sponsorship opportunities that seamlessly integrate advertiser objectives while maintaining editorial integrity.
  • Cultivate relationships within the tourism, hospitality, culinary, lifestyle, and entertainment industries to identify new content and partnership opportunities.
  • Represent the company during partner meetings, industry events, production shoots, and creative presentations.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Film, Television, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • 7+ years of experience developing and producing original digital content for major media brands, publishers, production companies, or digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing creative production teams and overseeing multiple concurrent productions.
  • Professional experience and genuine enthusiasm for creating Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment content.
  • Proven success developing and launching original digital video series that drive audience engagement and growth.
  • Extensive experience overseeing productions from concept through post-production across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, FAST, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Strong creative judgment with experience providing feedback across every stage of development, production, and editorial review.
  • Experience directing both studio and field productions, working with talent, creators, celebrities, and non-professional hosts.
  • Strong understanding of branded content, sponsorship integrations, and advertiser collaboration.
  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience developing creator-led programming and influencer collaborations.
  • Familiarity with production management software, digital asset management systems, and content performance analytics.
  • Experience managing production budgets, vendor negotiations, and resource planning.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Sr Editor, NFL (CBS Sports)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Overview:
CBS Sports is seeking a skilled, creative and highly organized Senior Editor to lead key aspects of its NFL coverage across CBSSports.com and CBS Sports platforms.The Senior Editor will play a central leadership role within the NFL editorial team, helping set the coverage strategy and oversee its execution across breaking news, live games, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and enterprise storytelling. This role requires more than strong editing skills: We are looking for an ambitious editorial leader who can establish a clear vision, generate distinctive coverage ideas, manage and develop writers, and bring structure and accountability to a fast-moving newsroom operation. The NFL Draft will receive special attention in this role.
The ideal candidate has exceptional news judgment, deep NFL knowledge and a proven ability to make confident editorial decisions under pressure. This person should be equally comfortable directing coverage during a major breaking-news event, developing an ambitious long-term editorial franchise and coaching an individual writer toward stronger work. The Senior Editor will directly manage a team of writers, with responsibility for setting expectations, assigning coverage, providing regular feedback and supporting each employee’s professional development. They will also help establish team priorities, evaluate performance and foster a collaborative, creative and accountable culture. This position is based in New York and requires schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as NFL games, news cycles and editorial needs warrant.


Responsibilities:
• Help define and execute the overall editorial strategy for CBS Sports’ NFL coverage across daily, seasonal and long-term priorities
• Directly manage, mentor and develop a team of writers, setting clear expectations and providing consistent editorial and performance feedback
• Lead regular one-on-one meetings, contribute to formal performance evaluations and create development plans that help employees grow
• Hold writers accountable for productivity, quality, collaboration, audience performance and established editorial standard
• Establish clear daily and long-term coverage priorities, delegate assignments appropriately and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met
• Generate and develop original coverage ideas, franchises and enterprise projects that distinguish CBS Sports in a competitive NFL media landscape
• Assign and edit breaking news, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and other stories that meet CBS Sports’ editorial, legal and ethical standards
• Lead coverage surrounding NFL games, trades, injuries, coaching changes, free agency, the NFL Draft and other major league events
• Make decisive editorial calls during breaking news, live games and other high-volume coverage periods
• Work closely with writers to strengthen reporting, sharpen analysis, improve story structure and develop more compelling headlines and presentation
• Evaluate the strengths, opportunities and workloads of individual team members and deploy staff strategically across the coverage operation
• Identify gaps in coverage or team capabilities and recommend solutions, including new assignments, developmental opportunities and potential staffing needs
• Create efficient workflows and communication systems that keep writers aligned and the broader NFL operation organized
• Use audience insights, SEO principles and performance data to evaluate coverage, identify opportunities and inform future editorial decisions
• Coordinate with leaders across fantasy, betting, social, video, newsletters, programming and other editorial teams to develop cohesive, multiplatform coverage plans
• Balance immediate audience opportunities with original work designed to build authority and long-term loyalty for CBS Sports
• Represent the NFL team in broader editorial planning conversations and communicate priorities clearly to senior newsroom leadership
• Foster an environment that values creativity, urgency, accuracy, collaboration and continuous improvement

Basic Qualifications
• At least three years of professional experience in a digital editorial or newsroom environment
• Meaningful experience directly managing writers or editors, including setting goals, delivering feedback and evaluating performance
• A demonstrated record of leading editorial coverage and making high-level decisions during major news or live-event windows
• Exceptional editorial judgment and the ability to prioritize coverage in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment
• A proven ability to generate original ideas and turn them into successful stories, franchises or multiplatform coverage plans
• Excellent editing, headline-writing and story-packaging skills
• Strong organizational and operational skills, with the ability to manage people, deadlines and multiple concurrent workstreams
• Deep knowledge of the NFL, its teams and players, and the major issues and trends shaping the league
• A comprehensive understanding of the NFL calendar and news cycle, including games, roster movement, injuries, transactions, coaching changes, free agency and the NFL Draft
• Experience using SEO, audience analytics and other acquisition and engagement tools to inform editorial strategy
• Strong leadership, communication and relationship-management skills
• An undergraduate degree, preferably in journalism, communications or a related field
• Ability to work from New York
• Schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as games, news developments and editorial shifts warrant


Additional Qualifications:
• A track record of improving employee performance and helping writers produce more ambitious, distinctive work
• Experience leading a team through organizational changes, evolving priorities or demanding coverage periods
• Experience developing major editorial franchises, special packages or enterprise projects
• Demonstrated success collaborating across editorial departments and platforms
• Familiarity with NFL Draft, fantasy football, sports betting, social media and emerging audience trends
• Experience working with content-management, analytics and editorial-planning systems
• Working knowledge of Photoshop or similar visual-editing tools


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:
Product Marketing Manager, Events 

Austin, Texas | Full-Time

Build the Events Austin Talks About.

Some people market events. Some people live them.

We're looking for someone who wants to immerse themselves in Hearst Austin Media’s event culture and help grow some of the most recognized experiential brands in Central Texas.

This role will serve as the marketing lead for our portfolio of wellness, lifestyle, food, music, and community events, with a primary focus on the Cap10K, Texas' largest 10K and one of Austin's most iconic traditions.

We're looking for someone who wants to be on the course, behind the scenes, at packet pickup, at community runs, at merchandise launches, talking to participants, interviewing runners, capturing content, trying a two-step and weighing in on which burger delights the senses. We need a builder of community and help shaping what these event brands become next.

If you've ever thought, "I wish I could get paid to be obsessed with Austin events," this might be your dream job.

 

What You'll Do

Be the Voice of the Brand

You'll help tell the story of our events year-round through social media, video, email, digital campaigns and community activations.

You'll interview participants, capture content in the field, showcase event experiences and help audiences feel connected long before race day or event day arrives.

Grow Participation

You'll develop marketing campaigns that drive registrations, ticket sales, attendance, merchandise purchases and repeat participation.

You'll understand who our audiences are, what motivates them and what inspires them to become lifelong fans.

Be Embedded in the Experience

You'll work closely with our Race Director, event producers, creative team and operations leaders. You'll attend planning meetings, community activations, training runs, sponsor events, merchandise launches and race-weekend activities.

You should expect to spend time where the action is happening.

Turn Merch into a Movement

We're investing in merchandise as part of the participant experience.

You'll help launch products, create campaigns, build anticipation and turn our merchandise program into something audiences actively seek out.

Build Community

You'll develop relationships with running clubs, fitness groups, creators, community organizations, local businesses and cultural influencers who help make Austin special.

We want our events to feel like they're built with the community, not simply marketed to it.

 

You'll Thrive Here If...

You love Austin.

You know what's happening around town before everyone else does.

You naturally take photos and videos at events.

You have opinions about race shirts, medals, event experiences and social content.

You enjoy being around people.

You can comfortably walk up to someone, hand them a microphone and get a great story.

You think community is created one interaction at a time.

You get excited about building something bigger every year.

 

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of marketing, audience development, events, experiential marketing, community engagement or related experience
  • Strong social media and content creation skills
  • Comfortable appearing on camera and interviewing participants
  • Experience building campaigns that drive registrations, attendance, purchases or subscriptions
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends as events require
  • Passion for live experiences and community-building

 

Bonus Points

  • You're a runner.
  • You've worked in sports, wellness, fitness, hospitality, festivals or live events.
  • You've helped launch merchandise programs.
  • You're already active in Austin's running, fitness or event communities.
  • You have video creation and storytelling experience.

 

What Success Looks Like

A year from now:

  • More people are participating in our events.
  • More people are wearing our merchandise.
  • Our social channels feel alive.
  • Austin sees our brands as part of the community.
  • Participants feel like they're part of something bigger than a single event.

 

Most importantly, when someone thinks about the best events in Austin, they think about the brands you've helped build.

job.title: Correspondent, Justice Department
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions

  • Application Deadline: Friday, October 2nd at 12pm ET.

  • Submission Instructions: Please submit a cover letter in addition to your resume, including related clips you are proud of.

Intro to Position

NPR’s award-winning Politics & Policy Desk delivers sophisticated, accessible coverage of the White House, Congress, the Supreme Court, the Department of Justice, national security, and the intersection of technology and political power. Our journalism is grounded in original reporting, breaking news delivered with context, and clear explanatory storytelling. Our work reaches millions of listeners and readers daily across Morning Edition, All Things Considered, NPR.org, Up First, and the NPR Politics Podcast.

The Justice Department Correspondent leads NPR’s daily and enterprise coverage of the Department of Justice, federal law enforcement, and federal immigration jurisprudence and prosecutions. Based in Washington, D.C., this reporter is responsible for breaking significant news, cultivating institutional and frontline sources, and delivering analytical enterprise reporting that reveals how DOJ decisions impact governance, the rule of law, and communities across the country.

The Politics & Policy Desk operates across audio, digital, and visual platforms. The correspondent evaluates the optimal narrative format for each story—whether an investigative data analysis, a live two-way on broadcast newsmagazines, an episode of the NPR Politics Podcast, or an explanatory digital feature.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

Reporting & Enterprise Journalism

  • Pitches, reports, and produces high-impact daily news spots, contextual enterprise pieces, and investigative stories on the Department of Justice, immigration enforcement, and federal legal policy.
  • Cultivates and maintains diverse, reliable source networks across government agencies, legal institutions, advocacy organizations, and impacted communities.
  • Analyzes complex court filings, regulatory decisions, and legislative proposals to deliver accurate, timely explanatory journalism.

Multiplatform Collaboration & Production

  • Delivers live, unscripted reporting and conversational analysis on NPR newsmagazines (Morning Edition, All Things Considered), breaking news specials, podcasts, and member station programming.
  • Partners with desk editors, audio producers, and digital editors to package reporting effectively for broadcast, digital text, and multimedia platforms.
  • Gathers audio in the field, conducts recorded interviews, and assists in the editorial editing and audio production of pieces under tight deadlines.

Editorial Standards & Administration

  • Maintains absolute adherence to the NPR Ethics Handbook, legal standards, and factual accuracy guidelines across all platforms.
  • Completes essential administrative duties accurately and punctually, including source documentation, program summaries, assignment coordination, and travel/expense filing.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • At least 5 years of professional journalism experience reporting on complex legal, governmental, or regulatory affairs at a national or regional level.
  • Demonstrated track record of reporting and writing accurate, contextual enterprise stories and breaking news on deadline.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain professional source networks across institutional, agency, and community settings.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple overlapping stories and shifting deadlines with editorial sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a fast-moving newsroom team, showing consistent respect for colleagues, diverse perspectives, and public radio member stations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven beat-reporting experience covering the U.S. Department of Justice, federal courts, or federal immigration enforcement.
  • Experience communicating complex policy, legal, or political topics clearly and conversationally for broadcast, podcast, or live audio formats.
  • Established record of enterprise scoops and investigative reporting derived from original document analysis and agency sourcing.
  • Experience producing multiplatform content, including digital written features, podcast appearances, and visual/social explainers.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office in Washington, D.C., or at an on-site reporting location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range : The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $127,500 - $142,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Personal Service Contract (PSC) Eligibility: This role is eligible for a Personal Service Contract (PSC). A PSC is an individualized agreement between NPR and a SAG-AFTRA represented employee that provides enhanced base compensation and tailored employment terms. In exchange for this higher guaranteed pay and added flexibility, employees on a PSC waive eligibility for premium pay (such as holiday or travel premiums) and compensatory time that are otherwise provided under the SAG-AFTRA collective bargaining agreement.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Licensing Senior Account Manager
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Licensing Senior Account Manager is responsible for driving new business and growing revenue by effectively communicating the need for and the benefits of an ASCAP license agreement to prospective new customers, closing deals with such customers as well as maintaining account relationships and concluding renewal deals with existing customers.

The Licensing Senior Account Manager will communicate and collaborate with the Senior and Associate Directors, SVPs and work cross-functionally with others within the Licensing Department (e.g., Operations, Reactive, Customer Service). Additionally, they will work closely with other departments such as Business and Legal Affairs, Revenue Accounting, Distribution, and Global Technology Solutions.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Identify, assess, and drive licensing efforts by generating and converting leads into both new license prospects and “click-through” licensees
  • Negotiate with select prospective new customers, answering questions, following up and remaining engaged until deal closure
  • Manage select accounts by answering customer queries, resolving issues and pursuing outstanding items
  • Develop, maintain and strengthen relationships among licensee accounts
  • Escalate matters/issues to senior team members when prescribed processes meet impediments and/or when otherwise necessary or appropriate
  • Perform as the backup to the Licensing Business Analyst, gathering and disseminating news and business intelligence to ASCAP leadership when they are not available

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; music industry studies a plus
  • Ability to work independently with guidance from senior team members
  • A minimum of three years of sales, business development and/or customer service experience, preferably in the music and/or media industry
  • Ability to effectively engage in revenue-generating activities to contribute to ASCAP’s revenue goals
  • Ability to clearly and concisely explain detailed subject matter (i.e. ASCAP and the need/benefits of an ASCAP license) to prospective customers
  • Knowledge of music/copyright, entertainment and technology industries preferred
  • Ability to foresee and stay apprised of new licensing opportunities (i.e. products, services, platforms), particularly those utilizing new/emerging technologies, and the ability to synthesize this information into high-quality formats (emails, reports, PowerPoint) for presentation to senior management
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and/or other CRMs preferred
  • Ability to work cross-functionally on multi-faceted projects
  • Ability to take direction and self-motivate; drive to master core responsibilities and to help a team maximize production and achieve goals
  • Excellent organizational, verbal and written communication skills; professional demeanor; ability to interact effectively with all levels of management and external personnel
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines under pressure
  • Proven ability to multitask, assess and shift priorities around as needed
  • Ability to work well both individually and on a team while sharing pertinent information, supporting colleagues, and encouraging participation
  • This position requires three days per week in the New York office

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance

  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The role will support the development and operation of physical sales channels for Vinyl, CDs and other physical products, working across both wholesale/distribution and D2C channels.

The role focuses on developing and operating sales channels, ensuring products are priced appropriately, inventory is forecasted and managed effectively, order are fulfilled and collected, and sales channels are maintained and optimised. This includes supporting the development of D2C infrastructure and storefronts using Shopify.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and grow physical sales channels across Southeast Asian territories, supporting the sale of Vinyl, CDs and other physical products.
  • Manage the day-to-day operational requirements of sales channels, including pricing, inventory management, forecasting, orders, delivery and collection of payments.
  • Support the development and management of wholesale/distribution channels, working with local distributors and retail partners to increase physical distribution and sales.
  • Support the development and operation of D2C sales channels, including the ongoing maintenance and optimisation of Shopify powered storefronts.
  • Act as a key operational contact for local and international stakeholders, working across labels, artist teams, merchandise companies, distributors, retail partner and platform partners.
  • Assist in the delivery of album launches, pre-orders, bundles and release activity across wholesale and D2C sales channels, working closely with artist, label and merchandise company partners.
  • Oversee the operational flow of physical products into sales channels, collaborating with fulfilment, logistics and other partners to maintain high service standards.
  • Support sales channel performance, contributing to sales targets, inventory optimisation, forecasting and commercial performance.

job.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.
 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.
 

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.

  • Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.

  • Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.

  • Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.

  • Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.

  • Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.

  • Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.

  • Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.

  • Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.

  • Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.

  • Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.

  • Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.

  • Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.

  • Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.

  • Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.

  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.

  • Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.

  • Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.

  • People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.

  • Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.

  • Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.

  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $190,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

SiriusXM’s new Dublin facility will comprise a workforce primarily focused on software development, automotive technology and engineering, AdTech, data science, and analytics. SiriusXM’s Services and Platform Engineering organization is growing in Dublin! We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Device Services team within the Growth Engineering organization.

The Device Services team owns a collection of high-throughput, low-latency services responsible for device metadata management, device authentication, and critical client bootstrap workflows. These services are among the earliest systems invoked during application startup and play a foundational role in establishing device trust, enabling access, and supporting seamless user experiences across SiriusXM products.

Our team operates services that verify the authenticity of SXM-generated chipsets, manage device lifecycle information, and publish critical device-related events used throughout the SiriusXM platform. The systems we build and operate serve tens of millions of listeners and connected devices across North America and are designed for exceptional reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

  • Drive software quality through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, testing strategies, and operational best practices.
  • Investigate production issues, perform root cause analysis, and continuously improve system reliability, observability, and performance.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help shape the future evolution of SiriusXM’s device trust and authentication platform.

job.title: Head of Legal
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Head of Legal to join UnitedMasters! This role is for a strategic, business-minded legal leader who thrives at the intersection of music, technology, and advertising. In this role, you’ll serve as a key partner to executive leadership, advising on risk, commercial transactions, corporate strategy, and high-impact partnerships across UnitedMasters LLC and Translation LLC. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the company’s legal and business direction while leading and developing the legal team. This is an opportunity for someone who can think big, move decisively, and help guide the company through its next phase of growth.

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Partner directly with the C-suite and senior leadership to provide strategic legal guidance and risk analysis on key initiatives and company direction.
  • Structure and advise on complex commercial arrangements, including distribution, licensing, partnerships, and strategic transactions.
  • Serve as a senior legal advisor across the full enterprise, including music distribution, product and technology, international expansion, sync and licensing, corporate strategy, business development, advertising, and supporting shared services (HR, Finance, IT).
  • Manage the internal legal team, setting priorities, allocating resources, and elevating overall legal function performance.
  • Partner and coordinate with outside counsel, ensuring efficient execution, cost management, and alignment with company objectives.
  • Lead development and implementation of scalable legal frameworks, policies, and best practices across the organization
  • Guide product, technology, and international teams on launches, expansion, and regulatory considerations
  • Oversee and manage enforcing rights, dispute resolution strategy, including pre-litigation, litigation, and settlement approach.
  • Ensure the company operates with a practical, business-forward legal posture that enables growth rather than restricts it

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Background in IP, media, technology, music and/or entertainment law, with strong commercial instincts.
  • Proven ability to operate at a strategic level, advising executives and influencing business outcomes while maintaining strong relationships internally and externally.
  • Experience managing or leading legal teams and partnering with outside counsel.
  • Deep understanding of commercial deal structures, rights frameworks, and global business operations.
  • Strong judgment, with the ability to balance legal risk against business objectives.
  • Effective communicator, excellent writer, and outward leader who can translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Comfortable operating cross-functionally with product, finance, HR, marketing, and business teams.
  • Proficiency with AI-powered legal tools and workflows (e.g., contract review/analysis, legal research, and document automation), with the ability to leverage emerging technologies to improve legal efficiency, scalability, and decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

  • J.D. from an accredited law school, admitted and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, preferably NY.
  • 8 to 15 years of experience, with a mix of reputable entertainment law firm and in-house experience

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)
