Digital Account Manager

(New York, NY or Atlanta, GA)

ESPN Digital and Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Digital Account Manager to join our team, based in New York or Atlanta, supporting our Dallas market. The Digital Account Manager oversees the operational execution of digital advertising campaigns and works closely with Marketing Consultants, partners, and cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns are launched accurately, delivered on time, and supported with exceptional service. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced sales environment. 

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Oversee the operational execution of digital campaigns, ensuring accuracy, quality, and timely delivery throughout the campaign lifecycle. 
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Consultant by working directly with partners to ensure campaigns are executed accurately and deliver exceptional service. 
  • Coordinate copy and creative assets for multiple partner campaigns.
  • Manage the creation of investment campaign presentations and other sales materials for multiple partnerships in collaboration with Marketing Consultants and the Creative Services team. 
  • Maintain CRM records throughout the pre-sale process, including proposal creation, billing schedules, and account updates. 
  • Interpret campaign delivery reports and communicate key performance insights to partners and internal stakeholders. 
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, troubleshooting, operational efficiency, and overall effectiveness while maintaining quality standards and appropriate human oversight.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Consultants and cross-functional teams to support campaign execution and deliver an exceptional partner experience. 
  • Traffic digital campaigns in the ad server, ensuring campaigns launch accurately and align with approved ad specifications. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to Good Karma’s core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Teamwork, and Follow Through.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Two or more years of experience in the digital advertising industry is required. 
  • Familiarity with Google Ad Manager is preferred but not required. 
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize urgent requests, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. 
  • Ability to interpret campaign reporting and communicate relevant performance insights. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently when needed. 
  • Solution-oriented approach with the ability to identify and resolve campaign-related issues.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented sales environment. 
  • Willingness to accept and provide feedback. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word. 

Pay Transparency 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000 - $74,000 annually for both the New York, NY and Atlanta, GA locations. Actual salary will be determined based on factors including experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, location, and internal and external equity.

This role is eligible for full benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, a 401(k) plan, dependent care benefits, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for salary growth based on increased skills, responsibilities, and achievement of targeted goals. 

Opportunity for Growth 

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company. 

How to Apply 

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than October 1, 2026. All are encouraged to apply. 

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5
job.description:
Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5

* This is a full-time, in-office position in Trenton that involves working closely and collaboratively with our New Jersey content teams. * 

 

Lead the Next Evolution of Digital News & Audience Growth

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

This is a digital-first, hands-on content leadership role at the intersection of journalism, content, audience, and growth. You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital News & Audience, you’ll help shape our digital content strategy while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution. You’ll serve as both a leader and a hands-on editor, helping shape the digital voice of our local brands. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading digital news and content strategy for New Jersey 101.5, helping identify, develop, and execute compelling original and breaking-news coverage across platforms
  • Creating, editing, publishing, and packaging content across websites, apps, social media, video, newsletters, and other digital channels
  • Partnering with journalists, on-air personalities, producers, and creators to turn strong ideas and existing content into platform-specific digital experiences
  • Elevating our social and video storytelling, including platform-native hooks, headlines, captions, thumbnails, pacing, formats, and creative approaches for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms
  • Coaching and collaborating with content teams on digital storytelling, SEO, audience development, social strategy, and evolving best practices
  • Using audience and content analytics to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, and make data-informed editorial decisions
  • Expanding content distribution through SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and other audience-growth channels
  • Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives
  • Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities
  • Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment
  • A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience
  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news
  • Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video
  • Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others
  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development
  • Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows
  • Curiosity about emerging platforms, creator trends, changing audience behaviors, and new technologies
  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where creativity and growth are encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

job.description:
Morning Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer – 94.5 PST

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Be the Voice, Face, Writer, Content and Community Influencer of Your Community:

Are you a creative personality with a passion for radio, digital storytelling, video content creation, and building community relationships? 

94.5 PST, one of the most successful Top 40 radio brands in the country, is looking for a dynamic, energetic, and creative Morning Show Co-Host to join our award-winning team. This is an opportunity to team up with multi-time Gracie Award winner Chris Rollins and PST Brand Manager Joe Hyer as part of a fun, fast-paced morning show serving listeners throughout Central New Jersey and Eastern Pennsylvania.

We’re searching for a true 360-degree multimedia talent with initiative—someone who thrives on radio, creates video content consistently, writes articles that demand attention, commands a room in person, and creates business opportunities with confidence. If you see yourself as a local influencer who can authentically connect, create content, endorse brands and generate revenue, this role was built for you.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Trenton stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Radio Host / Digital Content Writer, you’ll play a key role in shaping the daily sound and digital presence of 94.5 PST. You’ll engage audiences across on-air, online, social, and in the community by:

  • Hosting live, engaging on-air shows Monday through Friday
  • Preparing daily show content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Creating and publishing a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Writing and scheduling engaging posts across social platforms including Facebook and others
  • Connecting with listeners through interviews, live appearances, remotes, and community events
  • Representing the station at promotions, live broadcasts, and special programming initiatives
  • Producing commercials and assisting with market-wide programming and content needs
  • Championing the station brand “on the streets” by building authentic community relationships
  • Collaborating with on-air, digital, production, and sales teams to support integrated content initiatives
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven, active track record creating original written digital content AND video content across social platforms (show us your pages)
  • Strong on-air presence AND on-camera comfort, with the ability to connect authentically with listeners and viewers across every platform
  • Knowledge of basic FCC rules and regulations
  • Solid understanding of current events and various formats
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Comfort multitasking, meeting deadlines, and working in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to operate control boards, remote broadcast equipment, and related production tools
  • Willingness to quickly learn and become proficient in NexGen and Adobe Audition
  • Exceptional public speaking, presentation, and networking skills with the confidence to walk into a business, build a relationship, and close an endorsement deal
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize effectively
  • Active video creator with a current, maintained presence on at least one short-form video platform (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and demonstrated comfort on camera
  • Entrepreneurial, sales-minded instincts: you think about your personal brand as a business, proactively seek out partnership and endorsement opportunities, and are motivated by revenue tied to your influence
  • Experience with or strong interest in influencer marketing, brand endorsements, or sponsored content creation, including the ability to pitch yourself compellingly to local advertisers
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where talent is developed and growth is encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program + endorsement revenue opportunities (your influence = your upside)
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

job.title: Regional Market Engineering Manager
job.description:
Regional Market Engineering Manager - Laramie

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Fort Collins, Grand Junction, Montrose, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins, Grand Junction, Montrose, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facility in the Fort Collins, Grand Junction, Montrose, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. 

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations. The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

 

Essential Functions:

The following duties are essential functions of this position. The ability to perform each of these functions, with or without reasonable accommodation, is a condition of employment.

Independent Judgment and Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment to assess, prioritize, and resolve technical failures affecting station broadcast continuity, including real-time decisions during on-air emergencies where delays directly impact revenue and regulatory standing
  • Evaluate equipment performance and determine appropriate corrective action, including the authority to take systems offline, reroute signals, or authorize emergency repairs without prior approval when broadcast continuity is at risk
  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

Technical Operations

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Travel and Emergency Response

  • Maintain a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends; this role requires on-call availability reflecting the position’s independent authority over broadcast operations
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Cognitive and Communication Requirements

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports, technical documentation, and correspondence
  • Communicate effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with the Senior Vice President of Engineering, Senior Vice President of
  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

Safety and Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

Required

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible broadcast engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

Regional Market Engineering Manager - Casper

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Fort Collins, Grand Junction, Montrose, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins, Grand Junction, Montrose, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facility in the Fort Collins, Grand Junction, Montrose, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. 

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations. The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

 

Essential Functions:

The following duties are essential functions of this position. The ability to perform each of these functions, with or without reasonable accommodation, is a condition of employment.

Independent Judgment and Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment to assess, prioritize, and resolve technical failures affecting station broadcast continuity, including real-time decisions during on-air emergencies where delays directly impact revenue and regulatory standing
  • Evaluate equipment performance and determine appropriate corrective action, including the authority to take systems offline, reroute signals, or authorize emergency repairs without prior approval when broadcast continuity is at risk
  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

Technical Operations

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations

  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

job.title: Director, Event Partnerships & Development
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Event Partnerships & Development to help drive the growth, innovation, and commercial success of the League's Events & International portfolio. Working closely with senior leadership, this role will lead strategic partnership initiatives, manage critical League commercial relationships, and identify new opportunities to expand revenue, enhance fan engagement, and strengthen the NFL's event platforms. 

The Director will serve as a key connector across Events, International, Sponsorship, Media, Consumer Products, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and the 32 Clubs. The role will develop business strategies, evaluate growth opportunities, and execute high-impact initiatives across major NFL tentpole events, including the Super Bowl, NFL Draft, NFL Scouting Combine, Kickoff, NFL Flag Championships, and International Games. 

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, relationship leadership, analytical rigor, and execution excellence. This individual will be comfortable moving between long-range strategy and day-to-day partner management, translating insights into clear recommendations and measurable business results. 

Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy & Commercial Management 

  • Serve as the day-to-day business lead for select League commercial partnerships, including On Location and event retail partners, managing relationships that drive meaningful revenue, fan engagement, operational performance, and long-term strategic value. 
  • Develop and execute growth plans that maximize commercial performance and identify opportunities to expand assets, activation platforms, audience reach, and partner value. 
  • Establish clear objectives, governance, performance expectations, and issue-escalation paths with partners to ensure consistent delivery against contractual and strategic commitments. 
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives across partner organizations, serving as a strategic advisor and solution-oriented representative of the League. 
  • Support the development, negotiation, renewal, and implementation of strategic commercial agreements in partnership with Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders. 

Strategic Growth & Business Development 

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and advancement of new revenue opportunities, business models, partnership structures, and growth initiatives across the NFL's Major Events & International portfolio. 
  • Help shape the long-term business strategy for key NFL event platforms, defining future commercial opportunities, fan experiences, and growth priorities that support broader League objectives. 
  • Develop business cases, strategic frameworks, and executive recommendations to evaluate potential investments, partnerships, new platforms, and other commercial opportunities. 
  • Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, emerging technologies, and competitive activity across sports, entertainment, media, hospitality, and live events to identify opportunities that strengthen the NFL's business position. 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution 

  • Lead cross-functional teams through the end-to-end development and execution of strategic initiatives, establishing clear objectives, workplans, decision points, responsibilities, and measures of success. 
  • Collaborate across Events, International, Sponsorship, Finance, Media, Consumer Products, Legal, Club Business Development, and other League functions to develop integrated business solutions and drive alignment. 
  • Oversee concurrent workstreams from concept through implementation, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with League priorities and partner commitments. 
  • Anticipate risks, identify challenges and interdependencies, and proactively develop recommendations that support successful execution and sustainable business outcomes. 

Executive Communications & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Prepare and present business cases, strategic recommendations, partnership updates, and performance assessments for senior leadership, ownership committees, Clubs, and external partners. 
  • Develop post-event and post-initiative assessments that capture business performance, key learnings, growth opportunities, and recommendations for future improvement.  
  • Establish performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and reporting tools that provide clear visibility into commercial results, partner delivery, and areas for future growth. 
  • Translate complex business issues, research, and financial information into clear insights and actionable recommendations for senior leadership and other decision-makers. 

People & Team Leadership 

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development for assigned team members and project resources, setting clear priorities and reinforcing accountability, collaboration, and high-quality execution. 
  • Help allocate resources across partnership management, business development, analytical work, and strategic initiatives to ensure the team remains focused on the highest-impact priorities. 
  • Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive team culture that values commercial curiosity, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and shared success. 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in business, finance, strategy, or a related field is a plus. 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sports, media, entertainment, live events, hospitality, consulting, financial services, or another commercially oriented business environment. 
  • Demonstrated experience developing business cases, partnership strategies, revenue growth initiatives, or new business opportunities. 
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience evaluating revenue models, forecasts, investments, and performance metrics. 
  • Proven ability to manage complex partner relationships and influence senior internal and external stakeholders without direct authority. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional executive communication, writing, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to distill complex issues into clear recommendations. 
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including experience developing executive-level presentations and data-driven analyses. 
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and highly organized, with sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a matrixed organization.

job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets. 
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues and emerging sports properties.
  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.
  • Knowledge of adult participation and recreational sports programming.

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

Travel

  • 0 - 10%

  • On-call position working less than 40 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Audio 1
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking an experienced Audio 1 (A1) to lead audio production for live and recorded programming across NFL Media platforms. This position serves as the primary audio lead responsible for the planning, execution, mixing, and overall quality of audio elements supporting studio, remote, and special event productions. 

The ideal candidate possesses extensive live broadcast audio experience, strong technical expertise in modern IP-based audio environments, and a proven ability to perform in fast-paced, high-profile sports production settings. Production services will be based at NFL Media's state-of-the-art broadcast facility in Inglewood, California. 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead audio mixer for live and recorded productions, ensuring the highest level of audio quality and operational excellence.
  • Design, configure, and execute complex audio workflows for studio shows, remote broadcasts, special events, and digital productions.
  • Operate and mix live productions utilizing broadcast audio consoles, playback systems, communication systems, and IP-based audio infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, technical directors, engineering teams, and production personnel to deliver consistent and impactful audio experiences.
  • Develop and maintain show-specific audio configurations, routing strategies, and operational workflows.
  • Lead audio planning for remote productions, transmission paths, venue integration, and signal management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical audio issues in real time while maintaining on-air continuity.
  • Oversee proper setup, operation, and optimization of communications systems, including Riedel intercom platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with broadcast audio standards and best practices across stereo, surround sound, and emerging audio formats.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and operational direction to A2 and A3 personnel and freelance audio staff as needed.
  • Maintain proficiency in emerging broadcast technologies, IP networking standards, and audio production workflows.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional broadcast audio experience, including significant experience mixing live sports and studio productions.
  • Proven experience serving as an Audio 1 (A1) or senior-level broadcast audio mixer in a professional television, streaming, or live event environment.
  • Advanced experience operating SSL audio consoles; experience with SSL System T and S500 platforms strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated expertise in stereo, 5.1 surround, and multi-channel broadcast audio mixing.
  • Extensive knowledge of IP-based audio infrastructures, including AES67, Dante, SMPTE 2110, and related broadcast networking technologies.
  • Experience supporting complex remote productions, transmission workflows, and large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, routing, communications systems, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Proficiency with playback systems, audio servers, and broadcast production technologies.
  • Experience working with Riedel communications systems and networked intercom environments preferred. 

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting national sports broadcasts and large-scale live events.
  • Dante Certification or equivalent IP audio networking credentials.
  • Experience with EVS audio workflows and replay systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based or remote production environments.
  • CTS, Dante, or other relevant industry certifications. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in high-pressure live production environments.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple competing demands while maintaining production quality.
  • Strong technical proficiency with broadcast systems, production software, and collaboration tools. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Availability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.
  • Ability to support remote productions and occasional travel as business needs require.
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

Travel

  • Limited

  • Flexible schedule to include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Less than 29 hours/week when needed.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities. 

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Utility
job.description:
As a member of the stage crew the Utility position performs a wide range of tasks in support of the overall program production process. Under supervision of the Stage Manager, Director, and Operations team, Utilities work with technical staff to satisfy production needs for live, taped, and automated programming.

Responsibilities

  • Moving large set pieces and monitors during stage resets
  • Moving and arranging furniture pieces and props (set dressing)
  • Set talent marks on floor at the direction of Stage Manager and Director
  • Work with Stage Manager to support on-camera talent needs (i.e., bottled water, equipment, etc.)
  • Work with Stage Manager and other studio personnel to keep studio, set pieces and equipment clean and organized
  • Possess in-depth knowledge of all studio equipment
  • Support Camera Operators in the setup of studio cameras and over-under cable pulls
  • Familiarity with breakdown/setup of cameras and equipment

  • Strong work ethic, positive workplace demeanor and strong leadership skills along with demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities required

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity. 

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality  
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs   
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look  
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency  
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems   
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards  
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions   
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions   
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors   
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges   
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations   

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments  
  • Extensive experience with Sony broadcast camera systems, including studio and ENG configurations   
  • Experience shading, color correcting, and routing video using frame synchronizers and production systems (e.g., Imagine, Cobalt)   
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video formats, including 1080p, 1080i, and 720p   
  • Working knowledge of SMPTE 2110 or IP-based video workflows

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast production environments  
  • Experience with automated and robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics)  
  • Familiarity with Ultimatte compositing systems and virtual production workflows  
  • Experience working with OLED walls and large-format display environments   
  • Knowledge of HDR and emerging broadcast technologies   

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong eye for color accuracy and visual consistency  
  • Ability to remain calm and make precise technical adjustments under pressure in live broadcast environments   
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across control room, engineering, and production teams   
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple camera feeds and priorities simultaneously   
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot complex video and signal issues in real time   
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to work independently or within a team environment

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs as required for production setup and support   

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Schedule driven by production needs, including live broadcasts and events  
  • Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays   
  • This is a part-time position based on operational requirements up to 29 hours per week
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Product Operations Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media group seeks a dynamic Product Operations Coordinator to provide crucial support across various platforms including NFL.com, the NFL app, NFL Fantasy, and Club Sites. This role will be integral in coordinating operational activities and ensuring seamless execution. Reporting directly to the Senior Product Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in optimizing digital product performance.

Responsibilities

  • Support Product Operations projects across NFL.com, the NFL app, Club Sites, and other owned and operated digital platforms.
  • Assist with operational readiness for new products, features, and seasonal initiatives by helping create and maintain runbooks, training materials, documentation, workflows, and escalation paths.
  • Support digital content programming and site operations through approved administrative tools and content management systems.
  • Assist with tracking project deliverables, open issues, launch readiness items, stakeholder updates, and post-launch follow-up

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

job.title: Sr. Analyst, Digital Partnerships
job.description:
Are you ready to drive revenue growth and operational excellence in the fast-paced world of digital media? We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Digital Partnerships to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.

If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

job.title: Lead Studio Engineer
job.description:
Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who thrives in the fast-paced world of broadcast television? We're looking for a Lead Studio Engineer to join our team in Atlanta, GA. In this critical role, you'll be the technical backbone of our operations, ensuring our broadcasting systems run flawlessly while leveraging your expertise in IP networks, studio operations, and cutting-edge broadcast technology. If you're passionate about keeping live television on the air and love diving deep into complex technical challenges, this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Installs, maintains, and repairs critical broadcasting components to ensure all systems are functioning at peak efficiency.

  • Troubleshoot and repair a variety of issues with broadcast and IT equipment.

  • Relies on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to perform efficiently and successfully.

  • Collaborates with technology suppliers on setup, upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.

  • Programs/customizes equipment software functionality.

  • Tracks and assists users with equipment issues.

  • When resolving open issues, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information when necessary, close or escalate issues, and monitor resolution.

  • Works with the Network Ops leadership team to address operational issues and facilitate decision-making regarding technical matters.

  • Provides input and recommendations to assist in disaster recovery and system planning.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Makes recommendations for products and service enhancements.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associate's degree or equivalent work experience

  • 1-3 years of previous IT and/or broadcast engineering experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Experience with vendor support relations is highly desirable.

  • Previous television engineering experience preferred

  • Experience with live television production.

  • Must have thorough knowledge of Digital audio/video workflows and distribution.

  • C/Ku band satellite uplink and downlink systems.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY

Atlanta, Georgia, is a vibrant, dynamic city that perfectly blends Southern charm with big-city energy. As the capital of Georgia and a major hub for business, culture, and entertainment, Atlanta offers endless opportunities for professional growth and personal enjoyment. From world-class dining and thriving arts scenes to professional sports teams and beautiful outdoor spaces like Piedmont Park and the Atlanta BeltLine, there's always something to explore. The city's rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and welcoming community make it an exciting place to build your career and your life.

job.title: Facilities Maintenance Associate
job.description:
WLFL is seeking a reliable, hands-on Facilities Maintenance Associate to help maintain a clean, safe, and professional work environment. This position supports day-to-day facility operations, coordinates deliveries and vendors, and assists the engineering team with maintenance and repair projects.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional facility environment.
  • Monitor and replenish janitorial and facility supplies to ensure adequate inventory is available.
  • Identify maintenance needs and complete approved repairs promptly; obtain expense approval from the Chief Engineer before incurring costs.
  • Schedule, coordinate, and monitor work performed by outside vendors and contractors.
  • Quickly address safety concerns, including spills, trip hazards, and other unsafe conditions.
  • Handle and move heavy packages and equipment weighing more than 50 pounds for delivery or pickup.
  • Assist engineering team members with projects and other duties as needed.
  • Assist with light station vehicle maintenance such as state inspections, checking oil levels, and routinely driving them to ensure proper function, and registration renewals.
  • Perform all state-required monthly, semiannual, and annual safety inspections of equipment such as AED devices, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, and exit signs.
  • Perform other related duties to support station operations.
     

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in facilities maintenance, building operations, engineering support, or a related field preferred.
  • General knowledge of basic maintenance and repair practices such as electrical, plumbing, carpentry, and commercial building technologies.
  • Ability to safely lift, carry, and move items weighing more than 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and respond promptly to urgent facility or safety needs.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and vendor-coordination skills.
  • Comfortable collaborating with employees across departments and supporting a technical engineering team.
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record will be required.
