job.title: Principal Software Engineer - Backend Architect
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. As we continue to grow our global streaming platform, ViX, our technology teams are focused on building scalable, reliable, and secure experiences for millions of users across devices and markets.

The ViX Engineering team is seeking a Software Engineer, Backend – Lead/Architect to provide senior technical leadership across the backend platforms and services that power our streaming ecosystem. This role will lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of highly scalable backend systems supporting APIs, content and metadata, identity and entitlements, subscriptions, payments, search, personalization, and other core platform capabilities.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role that will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Cloud/Infrastructure, DevOps, and Quality Engineering. The Lead/Architect will establish technical direction and engineering standards, lead complex initiatives, and provide architectural guidance and mentorship to engineers while remaining actively involved in development, releases, production support, and problem-solving.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (Responsibilities)

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems supporting ViX.
  • Define technical direction and architecture with a focus on scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Remain hands-on in software development, including solution design, development of critical components, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Lead complex engineering initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation.
  • Design backend systems capable of supporting high-volume consumer traffic across multiple products, devices, and markets.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product roadmaps and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with Cloud/Infrastructure and DevOps teams on cloud-native deployment, scalability, resilience, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Partner across Data, Analytics, Personalization, Payments, Content, Identity, and other technology teams to support shared platform capabilities.
  • Establish and promote engineering standards and best practices for architecture, API design, code quality, testing, observability, performance, and security.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, scalability concerns, and opportunities to modernize systems and reduce technical debt.
  • Lead architecture and technical design reviews and influence major engineering decisions across teams.
  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, code and design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support production reliability, including incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that improve scalability, reliability, developer productivity, or customer experience.

YOU HAVE: (Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience)

  • 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and developing large-scale backend systems.
  • Experience operating at a Lead, Staff, Principal, Architect, or comparable senior technical level.
  • Deep expertise in backend architecture, distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and scalable system design.
  • Strong hands-on software development experience using modern backend programming languages and frameworks.
  • Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available production systems.
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs, service integrations, API architecture, performance, and security.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, caching, and large-scale data access patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud-native architecture, preferably AWS, GCP, or comparable environments.
  • Experience with containers, orchestration, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and observability.
  • Strong understanding of scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, security, and operational reliability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams and interconnected systems.
  • Experience establishing architectural standards and influencing technical direction without requiring direct people-management authority.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering with Product Management to translate product and business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience within streaming, media, entertainment, subscription services, e-commerce, or another large-scale consumer digital environment strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred but not required.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be willing to work in the U.S.
  • Employment and education will be verified.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Global Sports Business Operations & Audience Expansion Director
job.description:
This role is responsible for contributing to audience & revenue growth and leading operational efforts across ESPN’s global platforms. This person will identify and evaluate opportunities to determine the ROI for ESPN and constantly assess priorities to make sure they map to changes in our fast-paced industry. This position will report into the VP, Global Sports Cross Platform Development.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with internal departments to help drive revenue growth for ESPN Global Sports.
  • Conduct sports rights analysis/deal modeling to support acquisition process.
  • Partner with Programming & Scheduling teams to create efficiencies across global planning.
  • Synthesize financial or growth strategies into story-telling presentations and participate in communicating findings to management.
  • Serve as a key strategic partner, managing special projects and priorities on behalf of VP, Global Sports Cross Platform Development.
  • Oversee Business Operations Global Insights budget.
  • Help manage operations of Global Sports Films/Originals distribution across streaming and linear touchpoints.
  • Operationalize analytics and fan insights that inform the ongoing growth strategy and drive commercial opportunities.
  • Create and communicate digestible insight summaries for ESPN Global Sports leaders to understand performance and fan behavior. Insights should include the key audience opportunities & content performance based on strengths of our offerings.
  • Identify and action future revenue and growth opportunities beyond distribution and traditional ad sales revenue in close collaboration with Business Development, Corporate Strategy, and Disney Ad Sales.
  • Identify and evaluate content distribution opportunities onto third party platforms working in partnership with Disney Platform Distribution.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to develop appropriate actions from revenue forecasts to maximize annual performance.
  • Track competitive platforms to understand potential revenue and growth opportunities for ESPN Global Sports.
  • Manage the coordination of shared services to unify business objectives across teams.
  • Identify and conduct vendor evaluations that are focused on ESPN Global Sports growth.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 7 years working in media.
  • Ability to work across multiple time-zones and collaborate with regional teams.
  • Ability to strategize and think creatively; strong problem-solving skills required.
  • Organizational, prioritization and time management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects, with keen attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Must excel in a fast-paced, result-oriented work environment.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to communicate ideas and concepts into decks and one-sheets, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Workspace.
  • Exercise sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive, confidential, and pre-decisional information.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with growing revenue and understanding of financial inputs.
  • Experience working with multiple digital media analytics platforms (e.g. Adobe, Conviva, Google Analytics, etc.).
  • Experience in Media (to include experience in Entertainment or News), likely in an Audience Development, Strategy, Ad Sales, Business Operations, Finance, or Distribution function.
  • Knowledge of the differences in audiences and how to capitalize on those differences.

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

job.title: Senior Vice President, Unscripted Studio - Production
job.description:
With a strong pipeline of returning franchises and bold new formats coming down the line, Fox Entertainment Studios is in search of a Senior Vice President, Unscripted Studio - Production to shepherd its unscripted slate to air, ensuring the delivery of shows with the highest levels of entertainment and production value — on budget and on schedule.

We are looking for a leader who can take a complicated concept and simplify the process, working closely with creators and colleagues to champion shows and bring them to life. This executive will have deep knowledge of the unscripted production process from bottom to top — casting and field production through story, post and delivery — and the instincts to balance the creative ambition of each show against the financial resources available to produce it.

The Senior Vice President will join an innovative leadership team that isn't afraid to take calculated risks and experiment with content and production models. This is an untapped opportunity to be nimble, thoughtful, and innovative about how the content the studio creates comes to life and reaches audiences across platforms domestically and abroad.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee all aspects of physical production across a high-volume portfolio of concurrent unscripted series, returning multi-season franchises and paid development
  • Oversee integration and product placement deals on shows, vetting network and platform approval on all terms
  • Oversee productions made with external production companies and partners — assessing and approving each partner's production plan, budget, schedule and staffing, and holding them to Fox's creative, technical, legal, cost and delivery standards from greenlight through final delivery
  • Oversee risk management and insurance for both corporate and production
  • Provide insight and guidance to efficiently resolve creative, production and post-production hurdles, successfully balancing the creative needs of the shows with the financial resources available to produce them
  • Work closely with showrunners, executive producers, line producers and key department heads to ensure shows are produced at the highest quality within the constraints of budget and schedule
  • Innovate new unscripted production models and partnerships that speak to today's business realities — including domestic and international productions and co-productions — to protect margin without compromising on screen

  • Supervise series physical production and delivery schedules and cost reports in accordance with each network's and platform's deliverable requirements. Track costs and create cost reporting for the development and finance teams
  • Hire, supervise, and mentor a team of production executives, line producers, EICs, production managers, and freelancers; build credibility and strong working relationships across the organization

  • Identify production challenges and risks and work with the appropriate teams to resolve issues, streamline processes, and foster innovation
  • Stay on top of key industry trends and identify opportunities. In concert with senior leadership, evaluate opportunities for increasing revenue and margin across the studio
  • Drive operational excellence — ensuring systems are in place to direct and control costs, measure key financial and performance metrics, and identify opportunities for optimization
  • Participate in the analysis and development of new ideas, formats, and pitches, bringing a producer's lens to what each concept will take to execute
  • Partner with Finance to ensure proper cash flow, funding, and cost reporting on all projects
  • Partner with Business & Legal Affairs to negotiate network and platform deals, talent and producer contracts, staffing agreements and access agreements as needed

  • A track record of delivering marquee, tentpole formats and returning multi- season franchises — competition and game shows, culinary and lifestyle, celebrity-reality, docuseries, talk and live/event — at the highest quality yet cost-effectively, including re-engineering and refreshing recurring seasons to keep long-running brands strong
  • Direct experience on large-scale competition and culinary franchises of the kind that anchor Fox's slate is a distinct advantage.
  • Progressive, executive-level experience producing a wide variety of high-quality, boundary-pushing content that breaks through. Able to skillfully produce high quality yet cost-effective productions that are creatively synonymous with Fox Entertainment content.

  • Proven history of applying seasoned business judgment in creative decision- making strategies

  • Process-driven; functions tactically and with great detail within the production/postproduction process
  • Significant experience in contract negotiation, staffing agreements, licensing, rights and clearances, and state/international tax incentives.
  • Proven builder of teams — has recruited, developed, and led a bench of production executives, line producers, EICs and production managers, not merely staffed individual shows.

  • Ability to manage outside producers, build credibility and strong working relationships with other internal executives, and generate commitment to goals
  • Track record and reputation for conducting business with the highest standards of integrity and ethics.

  • Strong work ethic and multitasking skills
  • Live equally in the creative and the tactical spheres
  • Has the focus, drive and execution skills to guide a show to its highest potential while managing disparate stakeholders, teams and personalities — and, above

  • Reaches out to peers and cooperates with talent, colleagues, and partners to build a collegial and collaborative working environment
  • Understands that great ideas can come from anywhere; has a constrained ego, follows through on commitments, and often solicits feedback

job.description:
WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms. This is a per diem position.

 

Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.

 

We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.
  • Multi-Platform Content Generation: Actively write, produce, and adapt sports content tailored specifically for linear TV, CBS News Chicago Streaming, CBSChicago.com, and key social platforms (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube).
  • Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
  • Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
  • Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
  • Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
  • Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience: Proven experience as a Sports Anchor/Reporter in a major market (Top 10 preferred), with a demonstrated track record of success across linear and digital platforms.
  • Modern Journalism Mindset: Strong understanding of how sports consumption habits are shifting and a passion for experimenting with new digital, streaming, and social storytelling formats.
  • On-Air & On-Screen Presence: Commanding, authentic, and versatile presentation style suited for linear studio anchoring, streaming coverage, and digital video content.
  • Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of Chicago and national sports—including professional leagues, regional college athletics, and high school sports culture.
  • Writing Excellence: Superior writing skills with the ability to adjust tone and format effectively for linear television, digital articles, streaming scripts, and social copy.

  • Schedule Flexibility: Willingness and availability to work a flexible schedule that regularly includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and travel for major sports coverage.

job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment  – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The New York Post is seeking a full-time Director, Paid Social to help lead the paid social strategy and play a pivotal role in growing the business. You will collaborate closely with video, design, marketing, and product teams to ensure a cohesive and engaging experience for our followers.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Social Media, you will have a significant impact on the success of brand partnerships, sponsorship opportunities and paid social across the business. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Own the paid social strategy across The New York Post's portfolio, serving as the internal subject matter expert across planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and emerging opportunities.

  • Lead and mentor a team of paid social professionals, providing direction and coaching while establishing scalable workflows, processes, and best practices.

  • Develop and execute end-to-end paid social strategies that grow audience, engagement, traffic, content reach, and revenue, while aligning with broader company objectives.

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and X, staying ahead of platform updates, new products, and emerging capabilities.

  • Partner with the Senior Director of Social Media, editorial, and social teams to connect paid and organic strategy, identify high-potential content, and drive audience growth and monetization.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Brand Partnerships, marketing, product, design, and video teams to develop cohesive paid-social campaigns, sponsorship solutions, and advertiser programs.

  • Serve as a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, using platform expertise, audience insights, performance data, and reporting to make recommendations and drive optimization.

  • Build and maintain performance dashboards, reporting frameworks, and KPIs while monitoring campaign pacing and identifying opportunities to improve results.

  • Identify and test new platforms, formats, targeting strategies, tools, and optimization techniques, acting as an internal trend spotter across the evolving social ecosystem.

  • Educate stakeholders on paid social capabilities and best practices while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment. 

What We’re Looking For: 

  • 4+ years of experience in paid social, paid media, digital media, or a related field, with significant hands-on campaign management and optimization experience.

  • 1–2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading a team.

  • Deep knowledge of paid social platforms, including Meta/Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and X.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing paid social strategies across planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and reporting.

  • Strong understanding of paid social fundamentals, including audience development, campaign structure, bidding, pacing, budget management, creative formats, targeting, and optimization.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations, including experience building dashboards and reporting to senior stakeholders.

OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions

In addition to a resume, please submit:

  • Instead of a traditional cover letter, provide a brief statement outlining your approach to creative leadership, team mentorship, and how you balance artistic innovation with organizational goals.

Intro to Position

NPR is one of the country’s most trusted brands, but its reputation was built in a media landscape that no longer exists. Audiences have scattered across owned platforms, social video, and a dozen competitors fighting for the same attention. The organizations winning that fight are the ones willing to look and sound different, not just distribute more. This role exists to help NPR make that shift real.

This is, and is not, a caretaker role for an established brand. It's a build and evolution role: new formats, new visual language, a creative team stood up for video at a scale the organization hasn't operated in before. 

You'll report to the SVP of Brand & Communications and work closely with Product, Audience Insights, Marketing, and Editorial to shift a beloved legacy brand into one that can compete with new creators and challengers.

Responsibilities

Drive a more distinctive cohesive brand in a saturated market

  • Establish technical brand standards, visual principles, and digital design systems that make NPR’s visual expression instantly recognizable across direct-to-audience platforms. 
  • Build platform-native video formats and visual frameworks that drive industry-leading differentiation, compelling audiences to choose NPR over thousands of alternative journalism and entertainment options 
  • Push beyond generic institutional and media-industry conventions to create work with greater personality, clarity, emotion, and cultural relevance.
  • Translate organizational values, editorial priorities, and public service mission into standardized motion assets, video packages, and platform-native visual frameworks. 
  • Analyze market landscapes and digital competitor trends to ensure NPR’s video and motion visual language remains distinct, modern, and culturally relevant. 

Build creative capacity for an owned-and-operated future

  • Define the technical visual frameworks and motion standards required to integrate video seamlessly across NPR’s owned digital ecosystem (websites, mobile apps, newsletters, and membership portals). 
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Editorial teams to establish a cohesive UI/UX and motion experience across owned platform touchpoints. 
  • Build modular, scalable design systems and template kits that enable teams across the organization to independently publish brand-aligned digital content. 
  • Ensure that creative work supports a deeper direct relationship with audiences rather than treating owned platforms simply as distribution channels.
  • Help develop the visual and verbal conventions that make the organization’s digital experiences feel distinctive, intentional, and connected.
  • Identify opportunities to use design, storytelling, video, motion, and other creative tools to increase engagement with owned experiences.
  • Utilize audience analytics and engagement data to continuously optimize digital assets and direct-to-audience visual experiences. 

Build a modern video and motion capability

  • Establish production standards, camera/lighting guidelines, motion graphic templates, and editing signatures for short-form, social, explanatory, and talent-led video formats. 
  • Procure, maintain, and manage specialized video studio hardware, camera packages, lighting setups, field audio gear, and editing suites 
  • Partner with Editorial and other teams to determine where technical brand video and motion graphics complement editorial production.
  • Develop recognizable approaches to motion, editing, typography, graphics, sound, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • Ensure that video is treated as a core creative medium rather than an adaptation of work conceived for print or static digital formats.
  • Supervise a dedicated, technical video and motion production squad (2 direct reports), managing daily project allocations, post-production workflows, and technical skill development 

Drive creative excellence

  • Establish operational SLAs, resource management models, and quality-assurance protocols to scale high-volume video publishing efficiently. 
  • Lead the creative development of campaigns, executive communications, fundraising materials, events, presentations, reports, digital experiences, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure creative work is aligned with organizational priorities, audience needs, accessibility standards, and brand guidelines.
  • Encourage experimentation while maintaining consistency and quality.
  • Enforce strict compliance with federal digital accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1, closed captioning, color contrast, screen-reader compatibility) across all motion and video deliverables. 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of progressive creative leadership experience specializing in digital media, video production, or motion systems architecture within an in-house team or agency environment. 
  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating advanced technical mastery  conceptual thinking, creative direction, visual sophistication, and digital product visual identity across multi-platform ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience helping a brand evolve, modernize, or become more differentiated.
  • Deep technical proficiency in industry-standard video and motion software suites (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Figma design systems) and the changing ways audiences discover, consume, and engage with media.
  • Meaningful experience developing or directing video and motion work.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence cross-functional partners, and navigate complex organizational structures.
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and creative budgets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with a media, technology, cultural, entertainment, consumer, nonprofit, or mission-driven brand undergoing significant transformation.
  • Experience helping an established or legacy brand evolve for new audiences or platforms.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer, subscription, membership, or other owned-and-operated digital strategies.
  • Experience building or expanding an internal video, motion, or multimedia creative capability.
  • Experience developing enterprise design systems or brand governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with audience research, brand measurement, accessibility standards, and emerging creative technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing technical creative personnel, such as video editors, motion designers, and digital production leads. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong technical storytelling instincts across motion, video, and platform-native digital formats. 
  • Fluency in visual systems, digital motion design, video production workflows, and digital brand expression. 
  • Deep curiosity about media, culture, design technology, motion trends, and changing audience behavior on owned digital platforms.
  • Strong people leadership, technical team management, coaching, and talent-development skills.
  • Comfort leading creative/digital visual transformation within and systems integration within an established organization.
  • An ability to respect the equity of a legacy brand without being constrained by its history when building new platform formats.
  • Excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills across cross functional teams.
  • An ability to communicate the strategic, technical, and architectural reasoning behind creative choices.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, organizational complexity, and competing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making and prioritization skills.
  • A commitment to accessibility, inclusion, and creating work for a broad and diverse public.

Education Requirements

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. Application Instructions or Deadline: 

Application Deadline: Wednesday, September 30th at 12pm ET.

Materials to Submit:

  • A cover letter detailing your creative approach to explanatory journalism on video, your vision for adapting audio reporting to social platforms, and how you foster collaborative learning environments for colleagues new to video production.
  • Links to three short-form videos you conceived, shot, or edited that best illustrate your storytelling technique, editorial judgment, and technical execution. Please provide brief contextual notes on your specific role in each project within your cover letter.

Intro to Position

We’re looking for an experienced video maker to help us transition into a new era of video at Planet Money. The role is part creator, part strategist, part trainer.

Maybe you are a creator ready to join a team. Maybe you are a visual journalist who likes to build systems and start things. Maybe you’ve managed social channels and want to apply that to public media journalism. Maybe something else we haven’t thought of. In any case, here’s the job. 

First, you’ll work with the existing podcast/audio teams at Planet Money and The Indicator to pilot different types of social video or different processes for making them. Then together we will assess what works, what’s worth doing, and what’s not, and you’ll help us update our social video strategy and build sustainable workflows based on what we learn. By the end of your assignment, we hope to have a few new ways to represent our audio journalism on new platforms that our existing staff can sustainably carry on. 

A big part of the job will be helping our audio producers become comfortable creating more video on their own. You’ll help the audio team learn new video tools, analyze metrics and make smart choices about what to adapt to video and what not to. 

There’s wide latitude for experimentation, and an excellent team of creative, smart, fun journalists to collaborate with, including our existing video team. You’ll have lots of support and material to work with, and you’ll be a full part of the Planet Money and Indicator teams, with all the access to the podcast and reporting processes you need to make this work, including collaborating with our existing video colleagues. 

This is a temporary role with a specific mission: help a talented podcast team get a sustainable social video operation up and running and set them up to carry it forward after the assignment ends. There may also be some opportunities to pilot longer-form video, but our first priority is getting short-form systems working well. 

A little background may help you decide if this role is right for you:

Planet Money is like a little economics-themed media outlet within NPR. We explain how economics works and how it affects everyone’s life. We use stories to make the explanations memorable. We do this across media: two podcasts, Planet Money and The Indicator; regular segments on Morning Edition and All Things Considered; two newsletters; a nationally distributed weekend broadcast radio hour with How I Built This; a bestselling book; a board game; and, of course, video.

We’re extremely proud of our video presence, which has gone through several eras, beginning with our T-shirt project in 2013, to a series of live-action shorts in 2019, to a runaway TikTok channel starting in 2020. Now we’re ready to experiment more broadly with how Planet Money and The Indicator show up on video, and how we can do it more consistently and more frequently.

We are not replacing or ending our current short video approach. We couldn’t be more proud of that work! 

Our goal is to build on the excellent social videos our video team is already making. We love what we’re making there, and it works! We want to add more frequent videos that are more closely connected to the reporting we’re doing on the podcast and newsletters. To do that, we need more members of our team participating (maybe on camera and maybe in editing, that’s for you to help us answer). We want to find more opportunities to capture video and new processes that make all of that possible in intelligent, thoughtful and creative ways. Then we will know how to invest in our expanded video future. 

That’s where this role comes in. If you think you can help us build it, please apply.

 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Work with Planet Money leadership, video creators and NPR visual and social teams to refine and implement Planet Money’s video strategy, gathering and using audience and performance data to inform decisions. 
  • Lead experimentation with different forms of video journalism, assess results and help determine which approaches Planet Money should focus on. 
  • Collaborate with Planet Money and The Indicator editors, producers and hosts to conceive, produce, shoot, edit and publish video for NPR’s platforms and social media.
  • Train and coach some of our audio producers in video production and visual storytelling, video tools and interpreting performance metrics.
  • Develop short-form social video and other visual projects that extend Planet Money and The Indicator’s journalism to new and existing audiences.
  • Write and edit social video posts, captions, stories and other supporting copy and contribute to community engagement alongside other members of the team.
  • Coordinate production, publication and assessment of programming for visual platforms in collaboration with NPR’s visual and social teams.
  • Establish sustainable video production workflows that the podcast teams can continue on their own. 
  • Maintain NPR editorial and ethical guidelines in all production.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • At least four years of experience regularly making videos regularly in a journalistic, explanatory or comparable editorial setting. Please send us samples. 
  • At least two years of experience managing or creating video for social and digital platforms, with demonstrated experience using audience and performance data to inform editorial or creative decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing social media channels for a news or media organization, publisher or other editorial brand.

job.title: Manager, Artist Relations
job.description:
As a Manager in the Artist Relations team, you will take ownership of events and industry moments, supporting our artists, making sure nothing is left to chance. This is a role for someone who finds real satisfaction in making complex things run without a hitch,  juggling multiple events, itineraries and moving parts, and getting every detail right under pressure.

You'll be the person holding it all together behind the scenes, from logistics and scheduling to hospitality and gifting, so that when it counts, everything just works. Success in this role looks like calm, meticulous delivery, week after week, that the wider team can always rely on.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the planning and delivery of events, showcases, playback sessions, industry gatherings and key music moments, ensuring every experience is executed to the highest standard.
  • Attend gigs, festivals and other corporate events where necessary, organizing passes, disc presentations and meet & greets.
  • Represent Sony Music at major industry events, festivals and awards ceremonies, supporting artist attendance
  • Manage artist visits from end to end, overseeing itineraries, hospitality, travel logistics and bespoke experiences to ensure a seamless and memorable experience
  • Attend weekly scheduling meetings to facilitate knowledge of potential no.1 artists
  • Oversee and deliver artist recognition including milestone (Christmas, Birthdays) and commemorative gifting and other special moments that celebrate their success.
  • Provide guidance and day-to-day support to coordinators and interns, helping develop capability across the wider Artist Relations team.
  • Represent Sony Music at major industry events, festivals and awards ceremonies, supporting with table plans, logistics and after party coordination

Who you are:

  • You have experience in Artist Relations, Events, Talent Management, Hospitality or a similar fast-paced industry environment.
  • You are exceptionally organised and thrive managing multiple projects, stakeholders and priorities simultaneously.
  • You have strong knowledge of venues, hospitality, events and the live music landscape.
  • You build credibility quickly and are comfortable working with senior stakeholders, artists and management teams.
  • You remain calm under pressure, think ahead and consistently deliver high-quality work with meticulous attention to detail.
  • You are passionate about music, culture and creating outstanding experiences for artists and partners
 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

job.title: Group Vice President, Consumer Marketing
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Group Vice President, Consumer Marketing will be responsible for increasing SiriusXM’s relevance and creating demand by leveraging the power of our brand, content, talent and unique access to live events and fan experiences to develop compelling, integrated marketing opportunities across channels, partnerships and experiences. 

This leader will serve as SiriusXM’s senior consumer marketing expert, bringing deep expertise in building brand relevance, creative strategy, integrated marketing and media strategy. Working from the audience priorities and consumer understanding developed through Consumer Strategy, they will define how SiriusXM shows up in the market and identify new ways to use our extraordinary content, talent, live moments and experiences to make SiriusXM more relevant and compelling to current and future consumers. 

The role requires an exceptional combination of consumer marketing expertise, creative judgment, cultural fluency and digital orientation. The successful candidate will know how to turn consumer strategy into ideas that resonate, recognize exceptional creative work, connect marketing across channels and experiences, and see opportunities to make individual content, talent and cultural moments significantly bigger through integrated marketing. 

This leader will oversee Brand Strategy, Creative, Integrated Marketing & Brand Experiences, Media Strategy and Partnership Marketing, working closely with Consumer Strategy, Engagement Strategy, Product, Programming and other partners to create a more connected approach to marketing and customer outcomes.

What you’ll do:

  • Define and steward SiriusXM's brand positioning, differentiation, architecture and long-term brand direction, ensuring the brand remains distinctive and relevant.
  • Lead the development of creative strategy and expression across SiriusXM marketing, establishing a high bar for ideas, storytelling, design and execution.
  • Identify and develop integrated marketing opportunities that bring together creative, media, content, talent, partnerships, digital and live experiences to amplify our most important moments and create greater consumer relevance.
  • Turn SiriusXM’s unique content, talent, access and programming into compelling consumer propositions and marketing ideas that create relevance and demand.
  • Develop marketing strategies that broaden SiriusXM’s relevance with new and evolving consumer segments while strengthening the connection with our existing customer base.
  • Lead Media Strategy, defining the role of media within our integrated marketing approach, including channel strategy, investment priorities and measurement.
  • Partner with Marketing Activation & Operations to translate media strategy into effective activation and optimization across digital platforms.
  • Develop consumer-facing marketing opportunities with partners that extend the brand, create distinctive opportunities and connect SiriusXM with consumers in relevant ways.
  • Expand how SiriusXM uses experiential marketing, live moments, fandom and merchandise to create larger, more integrated brand experiences.
  • Partner closely with Consumer Strategy to translate audience priorities, consumer needs and identified opportunities into brand and marketing strategies.
  • Work with Engagement Strategy to connect brand and demand creation with acquisition and subscriber lifecycle strategies.
  • Build strong partnerships with Programming and Product to ensure our marketing effectively communicates and amplifies the content, talent, capabilities and experiences that differentiate SiriusXM.
  • Establish clear priorities across Brand, Creative, Media, Partnerships and Integrated Marketing and create stronger coordination across those capabilities.
  • Serve as a senior thought partner to leadership.
  • Lead multiple VPs and/or senior leaders across Brand Strategy, Creative, Integrated Marketing & Brand Experiences, Media Strategy and Partnership Marketing, creating alignment, accountability and leadership development across the broader function.
  • Own cross-functional budget and investment prioritization across the consumer and brand marketing portfolio, balancing resources across teams to maximize business impact and efficiency.
  • Exercise cross-functional decision-making authority across the portfolio, resolving competing priorities and aligning strategies across Brand, Creative, Media, Partnerships and Integrated Marketing.
  • Collaborate directly with ELT members and peer functional leaders on company-wide priorities, and represent Consumer & Brand Marketing in high-level enterprise discussions.
  • Drive transformation and innovation across the related marketing functions, improving how teams work together and scaling integrated approaches that increase consumer relevance and business performance.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically has 18 or more years of experience with 9-12 or more years of management experience.
  • Demonstrated success making an established consumer brand more relevant to new or evolving audiences without relying primarily on traditional mass-media advertising or wholesale brand reinvention.
  • Proven ability to turn content, talent, cultural moments, experiences or other differentiated assets into integrated marketing that creates consumer interest and demand.
  • Strong creative judgment and demonstrated ability to inspire, evaluate and elevate creative ideas and execution.
  • Deep digital fluency and experience using digital, social and emerging channels to amplify content, experiences and cultural moments.
  • Experience developing integrated strategies that connect creative, media, content, partnerships, digital and physical experiences rather than treating them as independent disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of modern media, with the strategic judgment to balance brand building and performance objectives and determine channel roles and investment priorities.
  • Strong cultural fluency and an instinct for fandom—understanding how talent, content, live moments and access can create relevance and deeper consumer connection.
  • Strong commercial orientation and a track record of connecting marketing decisions to measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling and influencing skills, with the ability to establish a clear marketing point of view across senior cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in media, entertainment, subscription, live experiences or another culturally relevant consumer business is strongly preferred.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $229,000 to $300,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

The Research Director, Content Insights will have a critical role informing the creation, iteration and measurement of video and video products at the New York Times. You will lead all video measurement research to inform our understanding of how video content performs across platforms, surfaces, and audience segments. You will oversee the end-to-end measurement of video effectiveness, from individual videos to longer-form recurring concepts, and translate data into relevant strategies that inform production, distribution, and editorial decisions. You will also work with product, design, and editorial teams to improve on-platform video experiences.

You will report to the Managing Director, News Products on the Audience Insights Team and will collaborate with partners across the Newsroom. You understand how to blend market research and user research methods and practices into actionable insights for an entire mission.

  • Develop audience research to support the creation and growth of video franchises and recurring shows. Drawing on research methods used by production studios and streaming networks, you'll conduct research that can inform greenlight decisions — including concept testing, pilot testing, audience appetite studies, and competitive landscape analysis.
  • Partner with video leadership to evaluate whether a format, host, or editorial premise has the demand to sustain an audience over time. For existing shows, help build longitudinal tracking that monitors audience health: loyalty, satisfaction, and reasons for churn.
  • Help build a video performance tracking program grounded in survey-based measurement, tracking metrics like awareness, recall, engagement, and sentiment among defined audience segments over time.
  • Working alongside analytics teams, you'll help establish benchmarks, monitor performance across all surfaces where video is published (owned and operated, social, streaming), and develop a consistent cadence of reporting that gives editorial, product, and business stakeholders a reliable read on how our videos are landing with audiences.
  • Lead quantitative and qualitative research among target audiences to support video strategy and format development (e.g., format preference studies, thumbnail and title concept tests, viewer satisfaction studies). Partner with video producers and editors to understand their needs and scope appropriate methodologies, from brief development through questionnaire design, survey launch, and insight delivery.
  • Manage multiple research projects and ad-hoc requests simultaneously, developing timelines and planning resources.
  • Partner or lead research on other editorial projects and franchises, such as newsletters, podcasts, or other emerging products
  • Collaborate with research partners, analytics teams, and company partners.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the quality, speed, and effect of video measurement, including recommending new vendors, tools, and methodologies.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in market research, user research, or consumer insights, with an emphasis on multimodal and product research.
  • Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and experience with continuous improvement and new ideas.
  • Experience leading all facets of a tracking program, including vendor relationships, questionnaire development, data mining, and reporting.
  • Fluency in analyzing large datasets, identifying insights, and creating clear reports.
  • Experience developing timelines across multiple projects, applying project management skills.

job.title: Temporary Social Media Editor, NYT Cooking
job.description:

It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

New York Times Cooking is looking for a temporary social media editor with strong writing skills, sharp strategic instincts, an eye for visuals and a love of food to join our interdisciplinary, fast-growing team through the end of the year.

In this role, you'll be responsible day to day for our Facebook account, building and publishing a high volume of engaging feed posts and video content. You'll pair food photography and video with sharp, compelling copy that inspires people to cook and ultimately drives them to NYT Cooking on platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Build, schedule and publish a high volume of daily content on Facebook.

  • Foster community by actively engaging with our followers in Facebook comments; translate conversations happening on Facebook into actionable, relevant content and product ideas.

  • Collaborate with social editors of other NYT Facebook accounts, finding opportunities to reach new audiences and drive traffic back to site.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Assistant Editor, NYT Cooking.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience working as a social editor or manager for a brand or publication, with direct experience running high-follower Facebook accounts.
  • Exceptional editorial judgement and copywriting skills, with the ability to write clearly, concisely, and in a distinct, engaging voice.
  • Hands-on experience with social scheduling platforms, graphic design platforms like Figma, database platforms like AirTable and digital analytics software like Facebook Insights, Dash Social, ManyChat, NewsWhip and Google Analytics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A strategic mind with a bend towards testing and iterating to find what resonates with various audiences.

  • Willingness to learn new skills and pitch in when needed to accomplish the goals of a small team.

job.title: Director, Enterprise SaaS Delivery
job.description:
The Director Enterprise SaaS Delivery leads technical delivery and demand-shaping activities for assigned enterprise SaaS applications. The role supervises a Technical Delivery Manager and a Technical Product Owner for SaaS solutions, ensuring vendor releases, integrations, technical dependencies, and operational readiness are managed with discipline. The Director also partners with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, and Technical Business Management to define and analyze new requests before they enter the delivery pipeline, helping the business confirm the problem, high-level requirements, process impacts, and expected value needed for a sound business case.

Essential Responsibilities

Leadership and Delivery Governance

  • Lead, coach, and evaluate the Technical Delivery Manager and Technical Owner; establish clear accountabilities, operating rhythms, priorities, and development plans.
  • Set the delivery governance for assigned SaaS applications, including release planning, dependency management, risk escalation, technical readiness, deployment coordination, and post-release review.
  • Review vendor roadmaps, release calendars, lifecycle notices, and implementation plans; align timing with product priorities, business operating periods, and change-management needs.
  • Provide leadership visibility into delivery performance, key technical risks, vendor commitments, operational trends, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Ensure technical delivery work follows applicable SDLC, change-management, security, architecture, and production-readiness standards.

Business Analysis and Demand Shaping

  • Partner with Product Management, Architecture, and Technical Business Management to assess new project and enhancement requests before commitment to a delivery roadmap.
  • Lead or direct high-level business analysis, including current and future-state process modeling, stakeholder analysis, problem definition, process impacts, assumptions, constraints, and dependency identification.
  • Guide development of epics, use cases, and high-level business requirements that give the business a sufficiently clear basis for scope, estimates, options, and business-case decisions.
  • Challenge incomplete requests constructively and help sponsors resolve gaps in objectives, process ownership, value, feasibility, data needs, integration needs, security considerations, and change impacts.
  • Coordinate technical discovery across product teams and shared technology functions so estimates and business cases reflect credible technical scope and dependencies.

SaaS Application and Vendor Oversight

  • Provide senior oversight for third-party SaaS vendors, including delivery commitments, technical documentation, escalation management, release quality, support responsiveness, and roadmap alignment.
  • Ensure the Sales SaaS Technical Owner maintains a reliable technical operating model for the application, including integrations, environments, access, monitoring, release readiness, documentation, and vendor coordination.
  • Work with Product Management to ensure technical delivery activities support product roadmaps and business outcomes without duplicating product ownership of prioritization, functional requirements, or value realization.
  • Partner with infrastructure, network, security, identity, data and integration, and service desk functions to address cross-functional dependencies and recurring operational issues.

Operational Excellence

  • Review release outcomes, incidents, and operational trends; direct corrective actions that improve application reliability, supportability, and user experience.
  • Establish practical measures for delivery reliability, release success, dependency readiness, incident escalation, vendor performance, and documentation quality.
  • Ensure Tier 2 product teams retain ownership for application support coordination, including vendor support where applicable, while the director provides governance and escalated operational oversight.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, computer science, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise application delivery, technical program management, SaaS delivery, systems integration, business analysis, or technology operations, including at least three years leading people or teams.
  • Experience working with third-party SaaS vendors and coordinating complex releases, integrations, and cross-functional technical dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into process models, epics, use cases, and high-level requirements that support decision making and business cases.
  • Strong judgment, stakeholder management, written communication, facilitation, and executive-level reporting skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting sales technology, CRM, revenue operations, advertising, media, or other commercially critical SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, and enterprise architecture or process-modeling methods.
  • PMP, ITIL, Scrum, SAFe, CBAP, or comparable certification.

 

Role Boundaries

The Director is accountable for technical delivery leadership, upstream analysis, vendor and dependency governance, and operational oversight for the assigned SaaS portfolio. Product Management remains accountable for product strategy, prioritization, functional requirements, and value realization. Technical Business Management retains financial and portfolio-management responsibilities, including application budgets. Product teams retain Tier 2 application support responsibilities. Infrastructure, security, service desk, and engineering teams remain accountable for their specialized technical services.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $140,000 to $190,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

job.description:
Job Title

Security Operations Supervisor

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced Security Operations Supervisor to serve as a visible, hands-on uniformed leader supporting daily enterprise security operations. Reporting to the Manager, Security Operations, this position works alongside in-house and contracted security personnel across reception, patrol, events, incident response, and workplace security operations.

The Supervisor also works closely with the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence to assist with GSOC personnel and operations, coordinate field response, and maintain effective communication and situational awareness during incidents, special events, and periods of increased activity. The ideal candidate leads by example, remains calm under pressure, and is equally comfortable assisting employees, directing security personnel, and coordinating with executives, vendors, and public safety agencies.

Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

Operational Leadership

  • Provide visible, hands-on operational leadership and work alongside in-house and contracted security personnel during daily operations.

  • Coordinate reception, patrol, event security, contract personnel, and other operational resources during assigned shifts.

  • Ensure post orders, procedures, access-control requirements, and service standards are followed; inspect operations and help correct deficiencies.

Incident and Emergency Response

  • Serve as the senior uniformed operational resource during incidents, emergencies, and critical events until relieved by Security Management.

  • Direct field response, deploy resources, coordinate with the GSOC, and ensure required notifications, incident reports, and after-action documentation are completed.

  • Respond to medical incidents, evacuations, suspicious activity, workplace violence concerns, executive incidents, and other security events; coordinate with law enforcement, fire, EMS, and property management as needed.

GSOC Support and Coordination

  • Work closely with the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence to assist with GSOC personnel and daily operations.

  • Provide operational guidance and support during major incidents, special events, after-hours activity, and periods of elevated demand.

  • Coordinate field operations with GSOC monitoring, communications, incident documentation, enterprise notifications, and situational-awareness functions.

Physical Security and Event Operations

  • Support access control, visitor management, reception, patrol, alarm response, CCTV operations, facility inspections, and other physical security functions.

  • Assist with planning and on-site execution of internal meetings, executive events, corporate venue activities, and major public-facing events.

  • Direct event security staffing and deployment and coordinate with vendors, venue personnel, law enforcement, and emergency responders while maintaining a professional and welcoming environment.

Leadership, Training, and Operational Support

  • Coach and mentor security and GSOC personnel through daily guidance, real-time feedback, onboarding support, drills, and hands-on instruction.

  • Provide Security Management with objective feedback regarding performance, training needs, staffing concerns, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Assist with shift coverage, daily assignments, operational documentation, special projects, audits, and other duties as assigned.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: 

Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, security management, emergency management, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in law enforcement, military service, public safety, corporate security, or a related security environment.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience directing personnel or operations during routine activities, incidents, emergencies, or special events.

  • Ability and willingness to work as a hands-on, uniformed operational leader rather than in a primarily administrative role.

  • Sound judgment and the ability to make timely, defensible decisions under pressure.

  • Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and customer-service skills, with the ability to interact professionally at all levels of the organization.

  • Working knowledge of access control, CCTV, alarm monitoring, incident reporting, and common security operations practices; proficiency with Microsoft Office and related reporting systems.

  • Ability to remain mobile throughout the workday, conduct patrols and inspections, stand or walk for extended periods, and successfully complete required pre-employment screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior supervisory or field leadership experience in law enforcement, corporate security, military service, emergency management, or another operational environment.

  • Retired law enforcement experience, particularly in a supervisory or field leadership capacity.

  • Experience supporting a GSOC, command center, emergency operations center, or similar security environment.

  • Experience coordinating proprietary and contracted security personnel, reception, events, or executive support.

  • CPP, APP, PSP, PCI, FDNY Certificates of Fitness, First Aid, CPR, AED, or similar relevant certifications.


The responsibilities described above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by Security Management based on business and operational needs.

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The New York Post is seeking a talented and creative Part-Time Social Media Editor (16-24 hours per week) to join our newsroom team. The ideal candidate will be deeply engaged in the social landscape, skilled in video editing, fluent in emerging trends, and adept at producing compelling content that connects with a broad, news-driven audience.

  • Package and publish content for New York Post social media accounts across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Threads, and more.

  • Film, edit, and produce video content from live events, interviews, and in-house programming for social distribution, ensuring alignment with platform-specific best practices.

  • Pitch and execute timely, newsworthy, and trending content ideas.
