job.title: Vice President, Product – Business Applications
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD 

Universal Music Group is seeking a Vice President of Product to lead our Business Applications product organization.  

Reporting to the Chief Data Officer, you will lead a portfolio of strategic business applications that transform trusted enterprise data into intuitive, AI-enabled software experiences. You will oversee Product Leaders responsible for multiple application domains, establish a modern product operating model, and ensure investments across the portfolio are aligned to the company's highest priorities. 

This is a player-coach leadership role. While your long-term responsibility is building a high-performing product organization, your immediate priority will be leading the successful development and launch of an artist application that puts data and audience development tools into the hands of UMG’s artists.   

This role requires equal comfort discussing product strategy with executives, organizational capability with product leaders, software architecture with engineering, AI-native product development practices with technical teams, and business workflows with stakeholders across UMG. 

We believe AI is fundamentally changing both what software can do and how software is built. We're looking for a product executive who can help transform not only our application portfolio, but the way our product teams discover, design, build, and continuously improve software. 

 

How you'll CREATE 

Lead the Product Organization 

  • Build and lead a high-performing organization of Product Managers and Product Leaders responsible for UMG's business application portfolio. 

  • Coach Product Leaders to strengthen product strategy, customer discovery, prioritization, execution, and product quality. 

  • Establish consistent product operating principles, governance, planning processes, and success metrics across the organization. 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional product talent while fostering a culture of ownership, learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement. 

  • Partner closely with UMG’s label leadership and data teams, Finance, Partnerships, Engineering, UX, Applied AI, Data Platform Products, and business stakeholders to deliver exceptional software. 

 

Define Portfolio Strategy and Investment 

  • Own the long-term strategy and roadmap for UMG's portfolio of internal business applications. 

  • Continuously evaluate where to invest, accelerate, expand, consolidate, or retire applications based on business value and strategic priorities. 

  • Allocate product resources across multiple teams, making thoughtful tradeoffs between near-term business needs and long-term platform investments. 

  • Maintain a multi-year portfolio roadmap that balances innovation, modernization, operational efficiency, and user experience. 

  • Guide build-versus-buy decisions and vendor strategy across the application portfolio. 

 

Lead UMG’s Artist-facing data and CRM solutions 

  • Personally lead the strategy and execution of Halo, UMG's flagship application for artist teams. 

  • Partner closely with labels, territories, engineering, design, and business stakeholders to ensure Halo becomes the trusted daily workspace for artist teams worldwide. 

  • Drive successful delivery, adoption, and measurable business impact while establishing a scalable product foundation for future capabilities. 

  • Transition from direct involvement over time as the product organization matures and additional Product Leaders assume greater ownership. 

 

Build an AI-Native Product Organization 

  • Help redefine how products are built at UMG by embedding AI throughout the product development lifecycle. 

  • Establish modern product management practices that leverage AI across customer discovery, prioritization, prototyping, requirements generation, engineering collaboration, testing, documentation, and release planning. 

  • Coach Product Leaders to effectively use AI as part of their everyday work, improving both product quality and delivery velocity. 

  • Partner with Engineering leadership to continuously evolve AI-assisted software development practices, evaluating emerging capabilities such as agentic workflows, AI coding assistants, rapid prototyping tools, and intelligent product operations. 

  • Champion a culture of experimentation that enables teams to move faster while maintaining governance, quality, and security. 

 

Drive Business Outcomes 

  • Define success metrics across the application portfolio, measuring business impact, adoption, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. 

  • Ensure product teams remain focused on delivering measurable business outcomes rather than technical outputs. 

  • Build trusted partnerships with executive stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Artist Services, Labels, Technology, and Corporate Functions. 

  • Communicate product strategy, investment decisions, and portfolio performance to senior leadership. 

 

Bring your VIBE 

Required Qualifications 

  • 10+ years of product management experience leading complex software products or enterprise applications. 

  • Experience leading multiple product teams or Product Leaders within a portfolio environment. 

  • Demonstrated success building high-performing product organizations and coaching Product Managers into stronger product leaders. 

  • Experience developing enterprise business applications, workflow platforms, or data-intensive software products. 

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and modern product management practices. 

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to improve product management, software development, and organizational effectiveness—not simply delivering AI features. 

  • Experience leading cross-functional organizations spanning Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and AI. 

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills. 

  • Experience operating successfully within large, highly matrixed organizations. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience within media, entertainment, technology, or digital platforms. 

  • Experience leading portfolios of enterprise software products. 

  • Experience supporting Finance, forecasting, CRM, marketing technology, or internal workflow applications. 

  • Experience establishing AI-native product organizations and introducing AI-assisted software development practices. 

  • Hands-on familiarity with AI product development tools including Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Codex, or similar platforms. 

  • Curiosity about agentic software development, AI-enabled product organizations, and emerging engineering practices. 

 

Success in the First 12 Months 

  • Successfully launch Halo as UMG's flagship artist application. 

  • Establish a high-performing product organization with clear operating principles, governance, and product management standards. 

  • Coach Product Leaders to improve product quality, execution, and customer outcomes across the portfolio. 

  • Implement AI-native product development practices that materially improve experimentation speed, engineering collaboration, prototyping, and delivery velocity. 

  • Establish a clear multi-year application portfolio strategy and investment roadmap. 

  • Strengthen partnerships across Engineering, Design, Data Products, Applied AI, and business leadership. 

  • Deliver measurable improvements in adoption, productivity, and business value across UMG's application portfolio. 

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Coordinator, Label Operations

A little bit about our team:

The Label Operations team at Atlantic Music Group is dedicated to managing our music efficiently and effectively from A&R handoff to commercial availability. We coordinate and work cross-functionally with A&R Operations, Marketing, Business Affairs, Creative, and Production teams to ensure successful releases for our artists. This team is critical to both the operations of our product planning & delivery system, as well as communication within the company as the owners of the master release schedule.

Your role:

This is an opportunity to work at one of the most historic and successful record companies in the world, in the center of the action. You will hold a critical role with access and communication across all levels within the company and will learn, in a front row seat, how a major record label works. If paying close attention to detail, navigating digital supply chain systems, communicating calmly yet effectively, and working collaboratively with top industry professionals aligns with you, this is your opportunity. If you are a collaborator at heart, love managing in an incredibly fast- paced, complex environment, and have a thirst to learn and grow with the industry, we should talk.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Work with the marketing team to plan for upcoming releases, maintain our company-wide release schedule, and communicate updates to the company.

  • Work with production teams to coordinate product set-up strategy and execution, employing a knowledge of release management systems and DSP requirements.

  • Keep release status up to date by interfacing with key staff across a wide range of teams at AMG and WMG.

  • Ensure all release timelines are kept and lead the charge if they are not. Provide timely communication regarding the status of each project, jump in to fix problems, and coordinate changes as they arise.

  • Think broadly about the music industry ecosystem as it changes day to day, and work to build new release strategies to help our artists get the most from their work.

  • Be a company-wide resource.

About you:

  • You are proactive. Anticipate problems before they arise and help to build creative solutions.

  • You are detail-oriented, able to assess the accuracy and efficiency of a release plan’s execution at both micro and macro levels.

  • You work well and can communicate effectively with different teams across every part of the AMG and WMG organizations.

  • You are service-oriented and willing to often take on tasks that are not part of the job description in a constantly evolving environment.

  • You shift gears comfortably and maintain composure when under pressure.

  • You work independently and are a self-starter.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Project management expertise and experience in a process-centric, operational role. 

  • Basic understanding of the music creative, production and distribution process.

  • Digital supply chain experience.

  • Hands-on experience using modern project management software such as Airtable, Notion, or Monday.com.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role


The Software and Platform Architecture Team is looking for a creative, highly skilled and talented AI Lead Architect with deep Subject Matter Expertise in AI governance and implementation for our downtown Toronto, Ottawa or Montreal Office location.

Reporting to the Director of Software Architecture and Contract Management, you will be responsible for establishing, leading and contributing to the AI Architecture evolution and governance.

This role will join an existing team of architects who have a focus on software and cloud platforms architecture best practice and governance. 


As part of the Architecture department you will leave your mark by bridging the gap between advanced AI technologies and practical business needs.  You will help design, build, and oversee the integration of scalable artificial intelligence systems, including machine learning pipelines and agentic AI workloads, ensuring security, compliance and alignment with overall enterprise objectives.

You will enjoy innovative work in a creative and dynamic work environment, working with leading technologies, and opportunities for continued professional development.  

How will you make an impact?

As the AI Lead Architect, you will: 

  • Evaluate AI frameworks, platforms and tools (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) to recommend optimal build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Guide foundation model selection aligned with CBC's use cases and infrastructure capabilities.
  • Lead the architecture of AI applications using large language models (LLMs), machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP).
  • Develop architectural roadmaps for deploying AI initiatives, including generative AI (GenAI), LLMs, and agentic business processes.
  • Lead the integration of scalable artificial intelligence systems, including machine learning pipelines and agentic AI workloads, ensuring security, compliance and alignment with overall enterprise objectives.
  • Monitor emerging AI technologies and assess their business value.
  • Establish architectural standards for model performance, traceability, data lineage, and privacy compliance.
  • Understand business requirements and identify AI use cases.
  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications.
  • Craft prompts, evaluate outputs, and design automated end-to-end agentic workflows.
  • Continuously test and refine models to ensure reliability, scalability, and optimal performance in production.
  • Support continuous monitoring and governance of AI solutions post-deployment.
  • Lead technical discussions with stakeholders and development teams.
  • Work with business leaders to define desired outcomes, success metrics and value drivers for AI initiatives.
  • Collaborate with ethics and compliance teams to ensure AI initiatives adhere to regulatory requirements and CBC's governance standards.
  • Work with business leaders to define desired outcomes, success metrics and value drivers for AI initiatives.
  • Mentor technical teams on AI architecture best practices.

  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.

Minimum Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years experience in software architecture, cloud architecture, data engineering, or AI solutions.
  • 1-2 years of experience designing enterprise AI or machine learning solutions.
  • Experience delivering cloud-native AI solutions.
  • Vendor-specific certifications such as the Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect or equivalent AWS/GCP architecture credentials are highly valued.
  • Deep understanding of Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and AI application deployment using languages like Python or R.
  • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with data management systems and MLOps tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Git, model registries).
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, technical leadership, and ability to evangelize AI adoption internally.

Desired Skills

  • Experience in media, broadcasting, or content distribution technology.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, etc.).
  • Executive communication and product management experience.
  • Prior work in regulated industries with compliance expertise.
  • Ability to multitask and deal with concurrent and/or conflicting priorities.

  • Strong communication and coaching skills.
  • Creative and Innovative.

Two exciting opportunities are available with the ICI Première team in Montréal!


1) Radio Production Assistant – Tout un matin


Are you energized by the idea of waking up the city? Become the next Radio Production Assistant for Tout un matin, our flagship morning show!


Hosted by Patrick Masbourian, the program offers a unique opportunity to join an exceptional team where every morning is a blank page. In this key behind-the-scenes role, you will support the Producer in the conception, planning, preparation and on-air execution of the program from the control room. Your organizational skills, attention to detail and logistical support will help bring our content to life, minute by minute, every morning. Come experience a one-of-a-kind morning at the heart of a dynamic, fast-paced show.


Ready to set your alarm to the rhythm of the news and help make the team shine in the studio?


Work schedule: Monday to Friday, 4:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.


2) Radio Production Assistant


The Radio Production Assistant supports the Producer in the conception, planning, preparation and on-air execution of our radio programs from the control room.


This is a casual position with no guaranteed hours. Assignments may range from occasional to regular, depending on operational needs.


Radio-Canada radio is broadcast 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The position therefore requires availability for atypical work schedules, including early mornings, evenings and weekends.


Duties and Responsibilities for both positions:

  • Assists the Producer and, when delegated, replaces them at certain stages of production, including editing, recording, music selection, on-air execution and other related activities.
  • Participates in meetings and collaborates in determining production and program content needs. Organizes production logistics according to the Producer’s requirements, including production schedules, resource bookings, team travel and transportation, etc. Maintains contact with relevant resource persons.
  • Researches and selects, as requested, sound materials and musical selections required for the program.
  • Plans, establishes and adjusts schedules for actors, musicians and contributors for rehearsals and recordings. Contacts participants and coordinates their attendance. Collects and compiles the information required to prepare contracts, fees and payroll documentation. Ensures that documents are prepared and signed and follows up as required.
  • Listens to and times the program and tracks all segments. Isolates and identifies reports, interviews and excerpts. Ensures that the program runs according to the rundown. Provides instructions to individuals in the studio, control room and on location. Anticipates and proposes alternative solutions to address technical, computer-related, timing and other issues that may disrupt production.
  • Participates in updating the website.
  • Participates in the preparation and on-air execution of programs and live or pre-recorded segments. Follows the rundown, scripts and musical scores; verifies and communicates all relevant information to production teams and provides instructions to team members.
  • Performs other related duties as required to carry out the above responsibilities.

Skills:

  • Broad general knowledge and cultural awareness.

job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Automotive Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

iHeartMedia is seeking a Multiplatform Producer-Board Operator to produce and distribute compelling Spanish-language content across digital and social platforms, podcasts, television/video and broadcast radio.

Digital content production will be a primary focus of this role. The ideal candidate is a strong multimedia producer with solid editorial judgment, live production experience and the ability to work closely with on-air talent and Programming to develop content from concept and preparation through live execution, editing, publishing and distribution.

This position requires a Spanish-language-first editorial approach rooted in Miami and South Florida, with a strong understanding of the region’s news, culture, current events and diverse audiences. The producer must be able to identify the local relevance, cultural context and audience angle of local, national and international stories.

• Create, edit, package and publish daily content for social media, digital platforms, podcasts and broadcast.

.• Identify compelling moments from the show and turn them into platform-appropriate digital content, including short-form video, audio clips, graphics, posts and articles.


• Produce, edit, package and distribute podcast content and other on-demand audio.


• Write headlines, captions, descriptions, articles and other supporting copy for digital content.


• Create and adapt graphics, photos and visual assets for social media and show promotion.


• Schedule, publish and distribute content across social, web and other digital platforms.


• Exercise editorial judgment in selecting timely, relevant and engaging content for digital distribution.


• Monitor digital and social trends and identify opportunities for timely content.


• Maintain brand and visual consistency across platforms.


• Operate the control board and produce live and recorded radio programming.


• Coordinate show elements, audio, playback, callers and other production elements with on-air talent.


• Record and edit audio and video content for broadcast and digital use.


• Monitor programming and troubleshoot basic studio, audio and production workflow issues.


• Support remote broadcasts, special programming, digital productions and live events as needed.


• Coordinate with Programming, Digital, Engineering and other teams as needed.

• Minimum 2 years of professional television production experience, with experience at a major television network strongly preferred.

• Working English proficiency required for internal communication and collaboration.

• Strong knowledge of Miami and South Florida news, culture, current events and the interests of the region’s diverse Spanish-speaking audiences.

• Strong research, interview preparation and editorial skills, with the ability to quickly understand a topic, identify the relevant angle and provide talent with accurate context and supporting information.

• Strong understanding of live television and radio timing, programming benchmarks and audience-focused programming strategies.

• Strong audio and video editing skills and proficiency with professional digital content creation and production tools.

• Experience creating, editing, packaging and publishing short-form and long-form video for major social media and digital platforms.

• Experience producing, editing, packaging and distributing podcasts and other on-demand content.

• Strong Spanish-language writing and copywriting skills for social posts, headlines, descriptions, articles and other digital content.

• Ability to create or adapt graphics, photos and visual assets for digital and social use.

• Strong understanding of how content should be produced and packaged differently for television/video, social media, web, podcasts and broadcast radio.

• Strong editorial judgment and ability to identify timely, relevant and engaging content while maintaining accuracy and appropriate context.

• Experience with broadcast consoles and radio production workflows preferred.

• Ability to work quickly and accurately in live production and fast-moving digital environments and adapt when content, timing or priorities change.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to collaborate closely with on-air talent, Programming, Digital and other production teams.

iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Specialized knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large and/or national accounts

  • Experience to anticipate customer needs based on advanced business knowledge and in depth understanding of customer’s strategy

  • Ease counseling and negotiating with senior executives

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Ability to guide others to solve complex problems using sophisticated analytical thought to identify innovating sales solutions

  • Team leadership experience and/or a desire to act as a role model or mentor to develop others

                                                                             

Location:

job.title: Director of Digital & Radio Content - Fort Collins
job.description:
Director of Digital & Radio Content – Fort Collins

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Where Creative Leadership Meets Local Impact:

Are you a strategic, people-first content leader with a passion for building winning brands and developing top-tier talent? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Director of Digital & Radio Content to lead our MARKET market—overseeing strong local brands and driving audience growth across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.

This is a full-time, in-office leadership role working closely and collaboratively with a talented local team. You’ll set the vision for local content, coach and develop market-leading talent, and play a hands-on role in creating compelling, clickable, and shareable content that resonates with the local community—while partnering closely with sales and leadership to drive revenue and impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital & Radio Content for Fort Collins, you’ll provide leadership, strategy, and creative direction for our local brands—ensuring excellence across on-air, online, and on-site experiences. This role blends high-level strategy with hands-on leadership and content creation. You will:

  • Establish and execute a clear, competitive vision for local content while maintaining ownership of the overall sound, content strategy, and brand execution across all stations to drive audience growth, market leadership, and business results.
  • Lead from the front as an active influencer, content creator, and brand ambassador, setting the standard for audience engagement while coaching team members to build meaningful connections across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing on-air, digital, and production talent, fostering a positive, collaborative, high-performance culture that drives market-leading results across all brands.
  • Partner closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to develop compelling, revenue-generating content, sponsorships, promotions, features, and events, creating innovative marketing solutions for clients while ensuring alignment across programming, sales, production, and market leadership.
  • Develop innovative, multi-platform content strategies that build highly engaged audience communities, drive ratings and digital growth, cultivate strong relationships throughout the market, and create revenue-generating partnerships across all channels.
  • Host a live, engaging on-air show on a regular, ongoing basis, preparing daily content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Create and publish a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Create and oversee compelling local content and digital storytelling across websites, mobile platforms, and social channels
  • Design and execute programming clocks, music strategy, and tactical plans to grow time spent listening, audience occasions, and digital reach

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for an Audience Engagement Manager to help define how live, breaking news reaches and resonates with audiences across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X—and whatever comes next.

As the Audience Engagement Manager, you will be at the center of our distribution strategy—focused on growing reach, deepening engagement, and unlocking new audiences through smart, platform-native storytelling. You’ll be a key partner to our editorial team—bringing news judgment, content presentation and platform expertise to how we show up on all social platforms.

Reporting to the VP of LiveNOW, you will serve as a motivating, credible partner who provides clear, actionable guidance grounded in data, and help the entire team elevate how we reach audiences. 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead Multi-Platform Strategy

  • Own and evolve LiveNOW’s presence across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, and emerging platforms

  • Continuously evaluate where audiences are going—and ensure LiveNOW is showing up with purpose and impact

  • Shape how LiveNOW shows up in vertical video ecosystems (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

Win on YouTube

  • Drive strategy across live streams, long-form video, and Shorts

  • Guide content team on packaging, programming, and presentation—including titles, thumbnails, descriptions, and live decisions that drive reach and watch time

Bring Editorial Judgment to Social

  • Act as a trusted editorial voice in how breaking news is presented across platforms

  • Help team understand what works—and what doesn’t, balancing platform performance with journalistic integrity

  • Provide clear guardrails on tone, framing, and platform-appropriate storytelling

Drive Live & Real-Time Execution

  • Lead how we package and distribute live breaking news in the moment

  • Partner closely with the team and editorial leaders to make fast, informed decisions during major news events

Build Workflows That Scale

  • Establish efficient, repeatable workflows that make it easy for producers and hosts to execute strong social and YouTube content

  • Create clarity—so teams know what to do, when to do it, and why it matters

Coach, Motivate & Empower the Team

  • Serve as a trusted, motivating partner to hosts and producers—someone they rely on for smart, practical guidance

  • Lead through influence by delivering crisp, actionable recommendations backed by performance data

  • Equip the team with clear playbooks, best practices, and ongoing feedback that drive results

Turn Insights Into Action

  • Analyze performance across platforms and translate data into clear, digestible takeaways

  • Identify trends, test new ideas, and quickly scale what works across the team

  • Keep the team engaged with updated performance data on progress to KPI goals

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Experience leading successful digital audience growth strategies, including social media and YouTube, with emphasis on news content (live is a plus!)

  • Strong understanding of both editorial decision-making and platform performance

  • Deep knowledge of YouTube (live + VOD + Shorts) and social platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Threads

  • Proven ability to create or guide compelling, platform-native content, especially in live and vertical formats

  • Ability to build trust quickly and influence teams without direct authority

  • Strong communicator who can deliver clear, concise, and data-backed guidance

  • Experience building workflows, playbooks, or systems that scale across a team

  • Data-driven mindset with sharp editorial instincts

  • Curiosity for emerging platforms, news formats, and audience behaviors

Why LiveNOW from FOX

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

The successful candidate will support both in-studio and remote production operations and report directly to the Assistant Chief Engineer.

  • Technical know-how to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live newscasts.

  • Experience with file-based media workflows and modern broadcast automation systems is strongly preferred.

  • Television control room and studio operations experience.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

We have two Sales opportunities available with different compensation structures. One position offers a base salary range of $38,000–$40,000, plus 3.8–15% commission on sales that meet the definition of “earned.” The second position is fully commissioned, with no guaranteed base salary, and pays 3.8-15% commission on all sales generated with no cap on earnings potential. Successful representatives in the fully commissioned role typically earn $60,000–$70,000 annually, though actual earnings vary based on individual performance, sales volume, and market conditions. Final compensation and/or earnings may also vary based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full-time positions are eligible for benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement plan participation, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, paid time off, parental leave, and an employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Director, Strategy & Audience Intelligence
job.description:

  • Able to translate complex research, data, and marketplace intelligence into clear, actionable strategies.
  • Structured thinker who can connect business priorities with audience opportunities.
  • Collaborative leader who can influence across teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Establish standardized planning frameworks, strategic playbooks, and best practices across marketing campaigns.
  • Develop campaign strategies by connecting business objectives, audience insights, marketplace dynamics, historical learnings, and media opportunities.
  • Build audience architecture, personas, segmentation, and media consumption profiles to inform audience-first marketing and media planning.
  • Partner with Research and Audience Insights to translate consumer behavior, cultural trends, and research into actionable strategies and audience growth opportunities.
  • Monitor competitive activity, consumer behavior, and evolving media trends to identify opportunities and inform strategic recommendations.
  • Establish planning parameters and investment guidelines to help inform marketing priorities and resource allocation.
  • Partner with Marketing Analytics to establish KPIs, learning agendas, and measurement frameworks, translating campaign results into actionable learnings for future planning.
  • Provide strategic direction across the U.S. and Mexico while balancing global priorities with local market needs.
  • Serve as a strategic center of excellence for Marketing, bringing an audience-first perspective to cross-functional planning.
  • Develop and present clear strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Advertising, Media, Research, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in marketing strategy, media strategy, audience strategy, consumer insights, communications planning, or a related discipline.
  • Strong strategic planning experience with a demonstrated ability to translate business objectives, consumer insights, and data into actionable strategies.
  • Experience developing audience segmentation, personas, consumer journeys, and other audience frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of the media landscape across linear television, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience with consumer research, audience measurement, media measurement, and business intelligence tools such as Nielsen, MRI-Simmons, Comscore, VideoAmp, Domo, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of campaign measurement, KPIs, learning agendas, reach and frequency, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. Hispanic audiences and the broader multicultural marketplace; Mexico market experience highly preferred.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, storytelling, presentation, and executive communication skills.

job.description:

  • 2-3 years of proven hands-on experience in full execution of digital media planning and buying
  • Hands on experience with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads manager, Google Ads, DV360 or similar programmatic partner. Google Campaign Manager or similar Ad Server
  • Basic understanding of Google Analytics
  • Proficient with MS Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, story-telling and problem-solving skills
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English

Desired Skills

  • Knowledge of digital research tools such as comScore, Nielsen, etc. to inform media planning
  • Experience with DOMO or similar business intelligence tools
  • Passion for social media and current social trends 
  • Experience with tracking and onboarding tune-in study measurement campaigns (Videoamp, SambaTV etc)
  • Experience working with social media and activating paid social campaigns
  • Meta Certification or TikTok Certification (Media Planning or Media Buying) is a plus.

job.title: VP, Recruiting
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

TKO Group Holdings | Stamford, CT

ABOUT TKO

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns and operates UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization, WWE, the recognized global leader in sports entertainment, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), the world’s premier bull riding organization, IMG, a global leader in sports, events, media, and fashion, and On Location, a premium experiential hospitality business. Together, these brands and businesses produce hundreds of live events annually, serve partners across the globe, and reach hundreds of millions of fans worldwide.

POSITION SUMMARY

TKO is looking for a VP, Recruiting to lead talent acquisition for UFC, WWE, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), and Zuffa Boxing. Reporting to the SVP, Global Recruiting and based in Stamford, CT, this leader will manage a team of three recruiters, oversee strategic search as well as TKO’s early careers internship program.

This is a role for someone who takes immense pride in their work, brings high standards, and earns a reputation as a trusted partner across the business. The VP, Recruiting will be just as comfortable building relationships on the floor of a live event as they are driving process and strategy from their desk. Presence and proximity to the businesses matter here. This person will be in Stamford 3–4 days per week, visit the NYC office frequently, and travel regularly to Las Vegas and Fort Worth to stay immersed in each business, know its leaders and employees, and maintain a pulse on the candidate market.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the team. Manage, develop, and inspire a team of three. Set high standards. Create an environment where the team does their best work, holds themselves accountable, and takes pride in the quality and consistency of what they deliver.

  • Set recruiting strategy. Develop and deliver recruiting strategies that align with the priorities of each business. Translate what UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing need to grow into a clear, actionable talent plan. Revisit and adapt that plan as business needs evolve.

  • Partner with the business. Serve as the primary recruiting partner for UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Build strong, trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders. Stay connected to each business’s culture, priorities, and talent needs. Show up, be present, and be known.

  • Drive results. Manage a high volume of searches without sacrificing quality. Fill roles efficiently, with the right candidates, and deliver a consistent hiring manager and candidate experience. Be measured by client feedback and satisfaction, and by the success of the people you place once they are in the building.

  • Build programs that scale. Lead the development and adoption of a referral program across UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Drive meaningful usage of AI recruiting tools including Findem and Paradox. Strengthen TKO’s employer brand externally and internally.

  • Develop talent pipelines. Know the candidate market. Build and maintain relationships with top talent before the need arises. Think ahead of the business, not behind it.

  • Lead early careers. Oversee TKO’s early careers internship program with the same rigor and client-service mindset applied to all other recruiting activity.

  • Recruit for senior roles. In addition to leading the team, personally lead searches for senior and critical positions across the portfolio.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, with a proven track record leading teams and managing full-cycle searches across multiple business units or brands

  • A client-service mentality. You are responsive, proactive, and treat every hiring manager interaction as an opportunity to build trust and deliver value

  • Strong follow-up and follow-through. You close loops, update stakeholders without being asked, and never let things fall through the cracks

  • A reputation builder. The way you work and the quality of your output speak for themselves

  • Genuine curiosity about the businesses you support. You want to understand how UFC, WWE, PBR, Zuffa Boxing operate, who makes them run, and what talent they need to grow

  • Experience building or significantly scaling referral programs

  • Hands-on experience with AI recruiting tools and a drive to lead adoption across your team and business partners (experience with Findem and/or Paradox a plus)

  • A creative problem-solving approach. You find solutions, not obstacles

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment without letting quality slip

  • Comfort with regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX

  • A bias toward presence. You understand that relationships are built in person and you show up accordingly

LOCATION

Stamford, CT (3–4 days per week in office), with frequent visits to the NYC office and regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX.

job.title: Paralegal Specialist
job.description:
The Paralegal Specialist position carries out a range of para-professional duties under the supervision of one or more attorneys in ESPN’s Legal department, spending the majority of time handling trademark-related matters. 

This role will be focused mainly on trademark prosecution and enforcement and drafting and reviewing trademark-related contracts, but will also include the drafting, review, and analysis of non-trademark contracts as well, handling the contract drafting process from term sheet through signature. The Paralegal Specialist position will regularly engage with in-house attorneys, outside counsel, and business leads.   

What You Will Do:

  • Maintains ESPN’s global trademark portfolio by filing US and global trademark applications and renewals, including preparation of specimens, first use dates, and identifications of goods and services, working closely with outside counsel in doing so.
  • Reviews watch notices for trademarks and domain names and tracks infringing domain names.
  • Conducts preliminary US and international screening searches via Saegis and the Internet.
  • Analyzes comprehensive screening and search results and drafts reports for internal clients.
  • Prepares cease and desist letters and processes takedowns for online IP infringement.
  • Reviews and edits opposition-related documents and works with business units and outside counsel to collect information and evidence for UDRP and other trademark proceedings.
  • Reviews product, marketing, and other materials for proper trademark use.
  • Tracks trademark deadlines and ensures deadlines are not missed by keeping trademark attorney and clients apprised of such deadlines.
  • Drafts contracts and/or other legal documents, ranging from standard to highly complex, for attorney review and approval, with a high degree of competence, knowledge, legal judgment and drafting skill.  Range of subject matters may include all matters handled within the Legal Department.
  • Conducts legal issue identification and analysis, including regarding intellectual property ownership (e.g., trademark, copyright, name and likeness); legal risk assessment at a high para-professional level. 
  • Conducts research, which may include some higher-level analysis, in areas of focus.
  • Sets up matters in Tracker (billing system), reviews invoices from outside counsel and vendors, and processes quarterly billing reconciliation.
  • May conduct administrative support activities for attorneys and interface with finance function as necessary.
  • Expected to contribute/participate in department oriented initiatives beyond assigned duties on occasion (e.g., legal department intranet site, presentations to client departments).

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years of applicable legal experience required.
  • Expertise in all areas of trademark prosecution and enforcement.
  • Expertise in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. 
  • The ability to consistently solve problems with a high degree of independent decision-making.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management.
  • Demonstrated strong operational expertise.
  • Proven success in judgment in a broad scope of matters.
  • Full knowledge of selected legal procedures, terminology, and contract policies and standards.
  • Ability to handle a high volume of work with minimal supervision while exercising the judgment to appropriately discern when to escalate issues.
  • Superior organization skills with the ability to prioritize workload efficiently and effectively, and excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and must be highly team-oriented.
  • High level of professionalism and ability to maintain absolute confidentiality.
  • Ability to build business acumen and understand core elements of the applicable business area(s).

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

  • Knowledge of NetDocs and Tracker.
  • Subject matter expertise in trademarks and other categories of agreements in the sports/media/entertainment/music space.

Education:

  • High School Diploma

Preferred Education:

  • Paralegal certification or Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree

As a Senior Engineer, you will lead the design of complex scheduling and ranking features in our GCP-based stack. You will tackle the unique assignment of personalizing content that is tied to a specific time slot, utilizing TensorFlow and PyTorch to predict what a user wants to watch now versus what they might want to watch in an hour.

  • Reinventing the Grid: You shift the PlutoTV experience from a static grid to a personalized discovery engine, significantly reducing "Time to Content."

  • Technical Mentorship: Guide junior engineers in the nuances of Linear TV data and FAST-specific success metrics.

 

 

Basic Qualifications

 

  • 5+ years of experience in MLE; knowledge with GCP; proficiency in TensorFlow and PyTorch.

 

Additional Qualifications

 

 

  • Direct experience with FAST apps or linear TV scheduling; experience with "Always-on" streaming data

job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence, and authority, averaging 90 million unique monthly viewers. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television, and commerce.

Politics is core to who we are — and nobody covers it like The Post. We break big stories, stir the pot, and shine a light on what’s really going on in the nation’s capital. From policy drama and power grabs to scandals and backstabbing, we’re looking for someone who gets the whole DC circus and can help lead the way in breaking news.

The New York Post is seeking an enterprising DC-based Breaking News Politics Reporter (Sunday - Thursday) to join our growing DC team and cover the fast-moving world of Washington politics. This reporter will write about the big political stories of the day, spot trending news, and bring readers sharp, authoritative coverage of how decisions in the capital shape the nation.

Responsibilities:

  • Report and write breaking news and enterprise stories on DC politics and government actions.

  • Spot news from political interviews, speeches and social media postings

  • Land interviews with power brokers in DC politics 

  • Cover legislative battles, policy shifts, elections, and key political figures.

  • Break exclusive stories and find fresh angles on widely covered issues.

  • Build and maintain a strong network of sources, from lawmakers and lobbyists to administration and campaign officials. 

  • Stay on top of political developments in real time and file timely, accurate copy.

  • Use public records, FOIA requests, and social media to surface and verify stories.

  • Work closely with editors and colleagues to produce fast, engaging coverage across digital and social platforms.

Requirements:

  • Minimum three years of newsroom reporting experience, with a focus on DC or political coverage.

  • Experience writing about the White House and Congress and building sources within the Trump administration

  • Fast, accurate and efficient, high-impact reporting

  • Strong editorial judgment and writing skills under tight deadlines.

  • Available to work Sunday to Thursday 

  • Flexibility to work evenings and irregular hours as news demands.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

WMX, Warner Music Group’s culture-driving media, creative content, and artist services’ division, sets a new standard for artists, advertisers, and fans through world class experiences, award-winning creative content, and industry leading audience insights. Digital Web Operations is a cross-functional team that sits at the center of Warner Music Group within the Warner Music Experience (WMX) division.  We build fan-focused and data-driven websites and campaigns that deliver our artists’ content to millions of fans around the world.  We’re the backbone of the marketing teams -- providing program and project management, production services, and full stack enterprise solutions while maintaining operational efficiency and scalability.

job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM:

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

Pandora:

Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. Pandora provides consumers with a uniquely-personalized music and podcast listening experience with its proprietary Music Genome Project® and Podcast Genome Project® technology. Pandora is available through its mobile app, the web, and integrations with more than 2,000 connected products. 

How you’ll make an impact:

The Vice President, Consumer Strategy will be responsible for developing a clear, actionable understanding of our consumers and translating that understanding into strategic direction for the business. This leader will oversee Consumer Research and Programming Research, bringing together those capabilities with internal data, external research, and industry, competitive, cultural and macroeconomic trends to create a holistic view of our audiences, their needs, motivations and barriers, and the opportunities they create for SiriusXM.

The role is designed to move us beyond individual research findings and data points to a cohesive point of view on the consumer and what it means for our business. This leader will identify the questions we most need to answer, connect insights from across the organization and external environment, and distinguish interesting findings from those that should materially influence our customer and marketing strategies.

This leader will work closely with Commercial Analytics & Data Science, Consumer & Brand Marketing, Engagement Strategy, Product, Programming and other partners to ensure consumer understanding informs strategic decisions across the organization. The role requires a unique combination of consumer intuition, strategic synthesis, structured thinking and commercial judgment, along with the ability to turn complex and sometimes conflicting information into clear priorities and compelling strategic narratives.

  • Exceptional ability to connect quantitative analysis, qualitative research, behavioral data and external signals into a clear and actionable consumer point of view.

  • Strong consumer intuition and a deep understanding of the needs, motivations, perceptions and behaviors that influence consumer decisions.

  • Strong structured thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, develop hypotheses and identify the few issues that matter most.

  • Fluency in quantitative and qualitative research methodologies and enough analytical depth to challenge findings and draw meaningful conclusions without needing to personally perform the underlying analysis.

  • Strong external orientation and curiosity about changes in culture, technology, competition, media consumption and the broader economic environment.

  • Demonstrated commercial judgment and the ability to connect consumer opportunities to meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Experience with segmentation, audience frameworks, consumer opportunity assessment and translating those insights into business or marketing strategy.Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and create compelling strategic narratives for senior executives.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence across Marketing, Product, Programming, Analytics and other functions without relying on direct authority.

  • Experience leading functional change, process improvement and risk management in a complex organization.
