Your role


Reporting to the Value Management Delivery Office (VMDO), the Project/Program Portfolio Manager (Real Estate Projects) plays a pivotal matrix leadership role. Operating without direct hierarchical authority, you will act as the strategic and tactical orchestrator of the Corporation's real estate transformation. Your mission is to oversee the entire investment portfolio (Capex/Opex), ensuring rigorous alignment with corporate objectives, resource optimization, and standardized risk management.


As the key facilitator for the instances of the new real estate governance model, you will bridge the gap between technical teams, operations, service provider, and senior executive leadership.


You are seen as someone who:

  • Fosters and maintains alignment among diverse stakeholders.
  • Balances strategic thinking with execution and delivery.
  • Demonstrates and encourages continuous improvement and value creation.
  • Effectively reports out to and works with other areas including Finance and Executive Governance.

The opportunity


CBC/Radio-Canada is implementing a rigorous portfolio approach to its real estate assets to achieve critical strategic objectives.  This role offers the opportunity to be a driving force in ensuring that financed real estate projects align with the corporation's strategic goals, while maximizing the efficiency of financial resources. You will champion transparency, resource optimization, and risk management while supporting critical executive reporting.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities


Governance, Facilitation, and Strategic Alignment

  • Committee Leadership: Act as the primary leader and facilitator for the Steering Committee (SteerCo) and the operational Portfolio Sync instance. Actively support the executive Governance Committee.
  • Strategic Alignment (100% Target): Deploy and maintain an evaluation framework to ensure that 100% of funded real estate projects directly align with corporate priorities.
  • Arbitrage and Continuity: Structure prioritization and trade-off files throughout the year to ensure dynamic allocation of financial and human resources during monthly and quarterly reviews.

Capacity Management and Resource Optimization

  • Integrated Roadmap Planning: Maintain global and centralized visibility of the short-, medium-, and long-term real estate roadmap (annual and 5-year plans).
  • Demand/Capacity Balancing: Continuously assess internal and external team workloads against capacity envelopes to proactively anticipate bottlenecks and plan future requirements effectively.
  • Interdependency Management: Cross-analyze critical dependencies across different groups (Facilities Planning, Asset Management, Engineering, Leasing, Major Construction Projects) to eliminate operational conflicts.

Delivery and Synchronization

  • Dashboards and Visibility: Develop and maintain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and visual tracking tools to provide stakeholders with real-time visibility into costs, timelines, and expected benefits.
  • Data Integrity: Ensure the collection, centralization, and modeling of operational and financial portfolio data to support informed, value-driven decision-making.
  • Escalation process: Identify and resolve escalated tactical issues impeding project delivery, preparing files for the Governance Committee when required. Identify risk or issues that require escalation to the SteerCo for resolution.

Standardized Risk Management and Partner Tracking

  • Risk Management Process: Based on a risk-wise approach, drive informed risk management strategies, tracking action plans to reduce overall portfolio exposure.
  • Partner Performance Monitoring: Monitor the tactical and operational performance of PDS service provider, ensuring adherence to CBC/Radio-Canada’s quality control and compliance standards.

We are looking for a candidate with the following:

  • Seven (7) or more years of experience in project/program management, with at least three (3) years acting in a portfolio management or senior leadership role on complex initiatives.
  • Experience delivering large Real Estate projects and a strong understanding of what is involved in the maintenance of assets, modernization of workspaces, and transformation of owned/leased portfolios.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of both capital and operating expenditures within a real estate portfolio.
  • Expert ability to adapt communications and maintain alignment among diverse audiences, bridging the gap between highly technical teams, operational groups, and executive governance.

CBC Saskatchewan is looking for an experienced journalist and newsroom leader to drive our daily and enterprise news coverage as an assignment producer. The role can be based in either Regina or Saskatoon. This is a permanent, full-time role that will include weekends and three weekdays.

Reporting to the Executive Producer, News, the successful candidate will join the team that assigns our newsgathering resources, decides what stories to cover, when and by whom. You will help set the news agenda for Saskatchewan on weekends, and continue that work on our assignment desk for three days during the week. You will be familiar with the editorial needs of audiences in both Regina and Saskatoon.

You will be an editorial leader and an experienced mentor, someone who demonstrates sound news judgment and critical thinking skills in both breaking news and enterprise reporting, and who inspires others to be innovative and creative.

As a leader, you are naturally collaborative, skilled at navigating conflict and change, breaking down silos and developing a representative and inclusive culture.

You will have experience in all aspects of news, from breaking events to investigative projects, and you will thrive as part of a team in the fast-paced, high-pressure world of a multi-platform newsroom. You understand that daily news can be a flat-out sprint to deadline, with myriad complex decisions to make along the way, so organizational skills are key.

You will be a strategic thinker who puts audience needs at the centre of your decision-making, ensuring our news content on all of all platforms connects our audiences to the news they need to know, the stories that affect their lives and the issues that resonate in their communities. You will strive to broaden the range of perspectives and experiences reflected in our news content, especially those from people who have been traditionally underrepresented in the media.  

You will ensure that all our work adheres to CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices and that it upholds our core principles of accuracy, fairness, balance, impartiality and integrity. 

Your responsibilities:

  •  Organize and lead news coverage across all platforms (video, digital, social, radio, television, streaming), including making decisions about story priorities and rollouts, allocating resources and assigning staff, and providing editorial oversight to ensure our content is original, relevant and impactful, and meets our journalistic standards.

  • Oversee all aspects of story development including assigning, researching, gathering, writing, copy editing, vetting, packaging and push alerts.

  • Oversee the distribution of our content on multiple platforms, 

  • Ensure assignments and content choices resonate with residents of Saskatchewan and align with CBC’s strategic objectives to connect with and grow audiences.

  • Oversee and collaborate with the other producers on the assignment desk (mornings, afternoons, weekends) to ensure continuity of news coverage.

  • Coordinate and collaborate on story assignments with producers of digital, visuals and current affairs radio, the weekend Radio-Canada team, as well as with producers in other locations and program units.

  • Provide feedback and coaching to journalists to help them develop their skills and produce content of the highest quality.

  • Help lead the planning of newsroom-wide coverage for special projects and events.

  • Help oversee staffing and scheduling decisions. 

Your profile:

  • Demonstrated experience leading a team in a fast-paced daily multi-platform news environment.

  • Excellent journalistic and critical thinking skills, including knowledge of and familiarity with CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices as well as the legal and ethical issues related to journalism.

  • Ability to manage and organize large volumes of fast-moving information and redirect resources to meet priorities and objectives.

  • Knowledge of and experience in assigning and creating content for all platforms (video, digital, social, radio, television, streaming) as well as vetting, editing, fact-checking and packaging.

  • Superior communication, interpersonal and organizational skills.

  • A strategic thinker with a proven track record of executing on a vision.

  • Demonstrated ability to exercise both quick editorial judgment and long-term planning.

  • A high-energy leader with a positive, team-first attitude and the ability to motivate and coach teams, encourage creativity and embrace experimentation.

  • Experience and commitment to developing content strategies to feature new voices and perspectives and to connect with new, younger and more diverse audiences.

  • A strong proven connection to the communities we serve in Saskatchewan, and a deep and nuanced understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives and lived experiences.

  • Strong people management skills with a keen desire to live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture. 

  • Ability and willingness to work flexible hours as required.

Here's some of what you will be doing...

The NFL’s Club Business Development department (Club BD) supports the 32 clubs in delivering direct local value and best-in-class fan experiences via data-driven insights and innovation. The team utilizes its robust sports business expertise to develop 'next practices' and facilitates the sharing of 'best practices' between clubs.  In addition to working with the clubs, Club BD works cross-functionally to drive key strategic initiatives at a League level, including the sales, marketing, strategic planning, and operations behind the League’s domestic and international tentpole events.

The Manager, Revenue & Strategy, will support two main initiatives: A cross-functional program developed and led by Club BD that identifies opportunities to optimize club revenue and drive sustainable, local business improvements and the sales, strategy, management, and operations of the NFL’s Super Bowl Suites. Both initiatives require collaboration with internal NFL teams, the 32 clubs, and third parties at all levels of seniority.

This role is at the unique intersection of strategy, analytics, consulting, and business development. Candidates with mastery in one or multiple of these skill sets, as well as generalists, will be considered. A self-starter with strong skills in data analysis, problem-solving, project management, and organization is most preferred.

The individual in this role will also have the opportunity to support critical strategic initiatives both within the Club Business Development group as well as cross-organizational groups that inform club revenue, fan engagement, and gameday experience strategies, among others.

  • Support local business optimization initiative across League and clubs, collaborating with League and club stakeholders, and external vendors
  • Support the ongoing management of the data model that identifies the revenue opportunities across the 32 NFL clubs and lead project management across the program
  • Support all phases of the Super Bowl Suite sales process including strategic planning, pricing, inventory management, sales, reporting, and driving operational execution and backend administrative management.
  • Drive local business analysis to inform actionable insights and strategic recommendations in coordination with Club Business Development’s club consulting team

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging.

job.title: Morning Anchor/MMJ, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN, we believe local journalism makes a difference in people's lives every day. We're looking for a Morning Anchor who is much more than a presenter behind the desk. You'll be a storyteller, a reporter, and a visible presence in the Tucson community, helping our audience start their day informed and connected. This role is ideal for a journalist who loves uncovering original stories, building relationships, and being where the news is happening. If you're passionate about meaningful reporting and committed to journalism that serves the community, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Anchor weekday morning newscasts with accuracy, urgency, and authenticity.
  • Report and deliver live coverage from breaking news scenes, major events, and community gatherings.
  • Research, gather, write, and develop compelling news content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Cultivate sources and generate original story ideas that impact Southern Arizona viewers.
  • Produce enterprise journalism that goes beyond reading a teleprompter and drives meaningful conversations in the community.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, photographers, and newsroom leadership to deliver impactful coverage.
  • Conduct interviews and field reporting that provide context, accountability, and storytelling depth.
  • Represent the station at community events, charitable initiatives, and public appearances.
  • Serve as a master of ceremonies or host for station-sponsored and community-focused events.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support newsroom operations and audience engagement.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of on-camera news experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the community to report stories and cover news events.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • A strong on-camera presence with the ability to connect with viewers and communicate with urgency when news demands it.
  • Demonstrated passion for reporting, storytelling, and enterprise journalism.
  • Ability to cultivate sources, uncover original stories, and continuously develop meaningful content ideas.
  • Strong news judgment and sound editorial decision-making skills.
  • Knowledge of newsroom computer systems, digital publishing tools, and news databases preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and changing priorities.
  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, accuracy standards, and libel law.
  • Clear, concise, and confident verbal communication skills.
  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to serving the community through trusted journalism.

OUR TEAM:


At KGUN, you'll join a passionate team of journalists who care deeply about storytelling, accountability, and community impact. We value curiosity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, and we believe the strongest journalism comes from people who are engaged with the communities they serve. Our newsroom is energetic, supportive, and committed to producing content that informs, empowers, and connects viewers across Southern Arizona.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Tucson offers an exceptional blend of natural beauty, culture, and adventure. Surrounded by stunning mountain ranges and blessed with more than 300 days of sunshine each year, the city provides endless opportunities for hiking, cycling, golfing, and exploring the outdoors.


Beyond its scenic landscapes, Tucson is known for its vibrant arts scene, rich multicultural heritage, award-winning food, and welcoming community atmosphere. Whether you're discovering local festivals, enjoying world-class cuisine, or exploring nearby national parks, Tucson offers a unique lifestyle that makes it an exciting place to build both a career and a home.

job.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Digital Marketing Coordinator is a key support role within the Digital Marketing & Audience Development team, providing hands-on assistance across artist and label campaigns. The role will work closely with Digital, Marketing, Social & Content, Influencer and wider label teams to support domestic and international artist campaigns across paid, owned and earned digital channels. The Coordinator will build and deliver email communications, support database growth and segmentation, and maintain CRM best practice. Alongside this, they will gain broad experience across digital marketing, including social media, content, creator campaigns, digital platforms, reporting and campaign coordination.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is highly organised, digitally savvy, creative and passionate about music and internet culture, and who is looking to develop a broad career in digital marketing.

What you'll do:

Digital Campaign Support

  • Serve as a key contact for the digital marketing team, collaborating with internal managers, artists, labels, and external partners to deliver domestic and international campaigns.
  • Manage day-to-day project workflows, including campaign timelines, tracking documents, asset folders, release links, and general digital housekeeping.
  • Support paid media execution, creator and influencer activations, fan acquisition pages, competitions, and pre-save campaigns

Social, Content & Owned Channels

  • Support the delivery and scheduling of social media plans across label-owned platforms, including TikTok and Instagram, while contributing to overall channel strategy.
  • Capture mobile-first content at live shows, events, and artist shoots, performing basic short-form video editing like cutting clips, subtitling, and adding trending audio.
  • Identify strategic opportunities across social channels and campaign touchpoints to convert social followers into owned channel audiences.

CRM & Audience Development

  • Build, schedule, and execute targeted email and SMS CRM campaigns for artist and label accounts, maintaining the master CRM calendar.
  • Grow first-party fan databases by managing data capture across websites, pre-saves, and competitions while maintaining CRM data hygiene and privacy compliance.
  • Develop, test, and optimise automated fan journeys, sign-up flows, and lifecycle messaging to improve overall campaign conversion.

Reporting & Insights

  • Collect and analyse campaign metrics across social, CRM, paid media, and UGC activity using internal and external reporting tools.
  • Consolidate performance data into regular reports and share actionable insights to inform future marketing strategy and campaign optimization.

Trends, Innovation & Team Development

  • Monitor emerging digital trends, platform updates, streaming features, and internet culture to identify creative opportunities for artists.
  • Prepare internal presentations, case studies, and educational updates for the broader marketing team and assist in key digital partner meetings

Who you are:

  • Passionate about music, digital culture, and how audiences engage with artists across social, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Creative, curious, and proactive, with an interest in audience development, CRM, and content strategy.
  • Data-literate, able to interpret campaign performance and turn insights into action.
  • Highly organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator and collaborative team player who enjoys working with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience in digital marketing, CRM, social media, content, or the wider entertainment industry.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and the ability to quickly learn new platforms and technologies.
  • Experience working within a record label, music company, creative agency, or similar environment.
  • Hands-on experience delivering social media campaigns, CRM communications, or short-form video content.
  • Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, website CMS platforms, fan capture tools, and digital music marketing workflows

What we give you:

  • You join a global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day. 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.

job.title: Director/Senior Director, Deal Structuring & Valuation
job.description:
At Warner Chappell Music (WCM) - the global music publishing arm of Warner Music Group (WMG) - we shape the culture of songwriting and champion songs that resonate for generations by creating transformational opportunities for songwriters everywhere. Our people and culture are at the epicenter of our company, and we are looking for team members who share our service-oriented mindset and have a passion for looking after our songwriters.

A little bit about our team:

The deals office drives the evaluation and structure of all recorded music and music publishing deals to enable long-term growth. We partner with closely with global business leaders to assess opportunities that balance creativity with commercial value strengthening our market position and shareholder value

Your role:

The Director, Deal Structuring & Valuation will play a critical leadership role within the Deals Office, leading all aspects of the financial assessment, complex modeling, and strategic structuring of significant deals across recorded music and music publishing. This role demands deep industry knowledge, advanced analytical capabilities, and the ability to proactively identify deal structures that maximize shareholder returns while aligning with business strategy and artist-first values.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the development and refinement of sophisticated financial models and valuation analyses for high-stakes deals (e.g., partnerships, artist/publishing catalog acquisitions, and frontline deals).

  • Drive the strategic structuring of deal economics and terms, collaborating closely with senior business, legal, and creative collaborators to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and growth plans.

  • Proactively identify and assess diverse deal structures to optimize financial returns and lead risk effectively.

  • Develop and implement global frameworks and best practices for deal valuation methodologies, financial forecasting, and scenario planning.

  • Manage adherence to deal budgets, forecast expenditures, and ensure adherence to cash targets and corporate return thresholds.

  • Prepare and present compelling financial analyses and deal recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Mentor and guide junior analysts/managers on financial modeling techniques, valuation best practices, and industry-specific deal nuances.

  • Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and evolving monetization models to inform innovative deal structures and pricing strategies.

About you:

  • 7-10+ years of progressive experience in finance, corporate development, investment banking, or a similar deal-focused role, with significant experience in the music, entertainment, or media sectors.

  • Extensive expertise in advanced financial modeling, valuation techniques (DCF, precedent transactions, comparable company analysis), and deal structuring.

  • Proven track record of successfully leading financial analysis for complex commercial agreements.

  • Deep understanding of music rights, revenue streams, and the unique economic drivers of the music industry.

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Superior communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate at all levels.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

  • MBA, CFA, or equivalent experience strongly preferred

About Us:

Before the fans and fame, the soundtracks and syncs, there is the song. And before the song comes the songwriter - the heart of an art form that defines generations, and the soul of our business. Songwriters are our inspiration; we are their partners, collaborators, and crusaders. Songwriters shape culture; and here at Warner Chappell Music we help hone their craft, build their careers, and protect their legacies. We value curiosity, collaboration, and commitment – which helps set us apart and helps us in our commitment and global service to our songwriters. We are Warner Chappell Music - where songwriters are heard.

As part of the larger Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office.   • Edit live interviews/press conferences and identify and pull relevant soundbytes for updates/show use.
  • Edit live sports games, identify and pull relevant highlights for updates/show use.
  • Monitor the sports news cycle throughout the shift and bring relevant audio to support top sports stories.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree or relevant experience.
  • 1-year experience with sound editing and sports newsroom operation in a fast-paced news-gathering atmosphere.
  • Deep understanding and knowledge of sports news across all major sports.
  • Excellent time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and work under shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Night/Weekend/Holiday availability is REQUIRED.
  • Experience with digital editing.
  • Experience with Adobe Audition, Zetta, and Galaxy a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

You will direct correspondents in the field, serve as a partner to their editors and coordinate with our security advisers and newsroom leadership. You will assess risk and make tough calls while building systems to support our journalists around the world in an era of prolonged and changing war.

This is an in-office position preferably based in London, and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per departmental guidance. You will also be expected to deploy internationally as news events dictate.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and guide newsgathering operations: The primary goal of this position is to inform and ensure we’re making the right calls on assignments in security-sensitive locations.  With guidance and close partnership from our security experts, you will collaborate with senior editors to make the tough decisions on editorial necessity and safety to ensure the safety of our teams in the field. 
  • Leadership Briefings: Provide daily situation and staffing updates for newsroom editors and leadership. Investigate and analyze security incidents and issues to find vulnerabilities and enact corrective measures as needed so we are continuously improving our systems.
  • Establishing Conflict Bureaus: Deploy quickly to rapidly create or scale wartime bureaus. Work with security and the bureau chief to secure and vet critical local infrastructure and ensure our on-the-ground presence and operation supports safety and exceptional journalism.
  • Business continuity: Lead disaster recovery, evacuation planning and crisis management in partnership with our business continuity team.
  • Operational Security : Work in close partnership with the security operation to ensure teams have the specific gear and training required for their assignments, and that we’re following proper protocols to enable our journalists to stay safe while doing their jobs. 
  • Freelancer & Evacuee Support: In collaboration with Legal and Global Operations, coordinate support for our freelancers in conflict zones, and for Times journalists who have had to relocate or evacuate due to conflicts. 
  • Digital Security: Work with our information security team to ensure that journalists in sensitive environments have their data, devices and sources properly protected.
  • Journalistic values: Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

This role reports to the International Editor, based in New York.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Experience working with journalists in conflict zones
  • Experience in a role requiring high-level operational skills and crisis management.
  • Excellent news judgment and understanding of journalistic imperatives.
  • Strong communication skills, able to brief and advise leadership with clarity 
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience working across a broad range of stakeholders and partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience in journalism, including significant time as a correspondent or editor in security-sensitive places.
  • Demonstrated experience managing local teams (fixers, drivers, interpreters) in volatile or hostile environments.
  • Demonstrated organizational and process-management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally, including to security-sensitive locations on short notice.
  • Experience developing safety protocols for complex newsgathering operations

job.title: Director, Editorial Booking
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Director of Editorial Booking to lead editorial booking for Axios Live’s most high-profile events.

Why it matters: Axios Live stages are where leaders come to make news. Reporting to the Managing Editor of Axios Live, the Director, Editorial Booking will serve as a senior editorial representative working alongside the Managing Editor to book top-tier newsmakers, move quickly in breaking news moments, and ensure every conversation meets Axios’ editorial standards.

Go deeper: Axios Live events are among the most sought-after platforms for newsmakers. We’re looking for a seasoned editorial leader to own booking strategy for events that represent Axios to today’s key influencers, and lead editorial booking across Smart Brevity programming around the world. This role plays a critical leadership function across Axios Live programming and will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor the associate director, setting clear expectations, workflows, and performance standards across Axios Live programming.
  • Collaborate with the managing director on editorial booking strategy for Axios Live’s portfolio of annual summits and franchise events, including flagship properties such as the Future of Health Summit.
  • Serve as a key talent manager across Axios Live, building trusted relationships with both external newsmakers and Axios newsroom talent to strengthen bookings, cultivate on-stage talent, and ensure reporters and leaders are thoughtfully deployed across live programming.
  • Work on editorial booking for Axios House and other Axios Live products at major global tentpoles, including Climate Week/UNGA, and other similar high-profile moments.
  • Secure senior newsmakers — including CEOs, elected officials, administration leaders, and global decision-makers — while delegating and guiding bookings across the team.
  • Serve as a liaison between Axios Live, the Axios newsroom, and Axios leadership to align booking priorities and programming strategy.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment in fast-moving news environments, including making real-time decisions to pivot talent, framing, or programming in response to breaking news.
  • Ensure Axios Live programming meets Axios’ editorial standards, reflects diverse and compelling perspectives, and maintains editorial independence.
  • Oversee editorial preparation for live events, including interview prep, run-of-show development, scripts, stage cues, and briefing materials.
  • Guide collaboration on event language and marketing materials, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and Smart Brevity principles across platforms.
  • Provide guidance to senior newsroom leadership during live events, ensuring the team is coordinated, materials are accessible, and programming remains responsive to news developments.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with principals, chiefs of staff, communications teams, and senior influencers to support both immediate bookings and long-term Axios Live growth
  • Travel regularly to Axios Live events across the U.S. and internationally, providing on-site editorial leadership and supporting programming execution at major summits, franchise events, and global tentpoles.
  • Leverage AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency across research, booking, and production workflows, and to help scale best practices across the booking team.

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for a senior editorial leader who brings sound judgment, strong relationships, and a collaborative management style. Ideal candidates will have: 

  • 5+ years of editorial booking or media experience, with demonstrated experience leading or mentoring other bookers or producers.
  • A proven track record of owning booking strategy for large-scale editorial events, including recurring summits or franchise programming.
  • Experience booking and working with high-profile leaders, including senior executives, policymakers, and global influencers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear editorial guidance and feedback.
  • Deep knowledge of the news cycle and emerging trends across politics, business, and technology.
  • Experience building full show programs, from concept through execution.
  • Strong organizational and people-management skills, with the ability to balance coaching, delegation, and execution.
  • Familiarity with Axios’ Smart Brevity style and editorial values.
  • Bonus points for experience or established networks in:
  • Health care and life sciences
  • Energy, climate, or sustainability
  • Defense, national security, or geopolitics
  • Media, technology, or communications
  • Background in media, Capitol Hill, government, or political campaigns is a plus.

We now have a permanent full-time role available in Sydney for an experienced Programmatic Operations Executive, working closely with our Ad Sales team and utilizing your deep understanding of programmatic revenue generation and data-based audience solutions. This role is responsible for driving Programmatic monetization of CTV video inventory across the AU market. 

   

Functions will include:    

  • Aid in the direction of open exchange, private exchange & Programmatic Guaranteed / Automated Guaranteed commercial strategy for video, display and mobile inventory.  
  • Identify, prioritise and translate key Programmatic business requirements into operational projects with the goal of increasing revenue, improving efficiency, reducing risk and improving inventory performance across multiple platforms.  
  • Cultivate an extensive understanding of Network 10 brands, products & commercial intelligence systems in order to provide the best sales solution to Programmatic buyers and their clients.  
  • Focused development of all Trading Desk / DSP/ client relationships to optimise revenue across all brands within the 10 network.  
  • Organisation & integration of all Programmatic platform’s / monetisation partners across the AU market e.g. various SSPs / Exchanges  
  • Co-ordinate data-based audience solutions via DMP partner for the APAC region, with a focus on creating commercial insights actionable via Programmatic platforms.  
  • Delivery of education & training on the use of Programmatic platforms, data-based opportunities & Programmatic strategy to internal stakeholders.  
  • Display organisational and leadership capabilities to track progress, execution and consistency of trading desk sales programs.  
  • Meet and exceed Programmatic revenue targets, contributing to Paramount’s overall performance and revenue targets across the AU market, with a core focus on Sydney-based business.  

 

What are we looking for in a Programmatic Operations Executive? What’s important?     

  • A solid 4+ years of experience in digital media 
  • Strong understanding of the Programmatic advertising space, specifically ad exchanges, RTB and Programmatic trading

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills

Job Title: News Anchor 

 

Department: News

Employment Type: Part-Time 

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site 

 

Overview: 

KYW Newsradio, Philadelphia’s leading multimedia newsroom, is seeking an experienced, dynamic broadcast journalist to be a news anchor on a part-time basis. A qualified candidate must be news-savvy, full of fresh and relatable story ideas, willing to jump into the anchor chair at a moment’s notice, and available to work all dayparts, weekends, and holidays. She or he must be practiced and comfortable with conversational, compelling broadcast news writing and delivery. The ability to expertly ad-lib when the situation warrants is crucial. On-air experience and a working knowledge of the Philadelphia news environment are key. An audio demo must be included with the application.

  • Write and deliver half-hour and hour-long newscasts.
  • Assist the editor with the selection and production of stories.

  • Ensure station compliance with FCC regulations.

CBC News is looking for a creative editorial leader with sharp news judgement to lead our live and daily audio news programming on the weekends. 


As Senior Producer, Live & Daily News, Weekend Late Audio you drive daily programming with a hyper-focus on live and breaking national and international news for our hourly radio news and podcast programs, Your World Tonight and The World This Hour. 


You bring an audience-first mindset to the role, shaping compelling content that plays equally well as a podcast as it does on terrestrial radio. You are expected to steer daily editorial meetings, stimulate creative discussions, and identify the most impactful stories and treatments for the day. 


You react decisively to major developments, track stories in real time and reshape shows on the fly to ensure our audiences are getting the content they need to know, now. You support your colleagues across the CBC News system when it pivots to extended live coverage. Extensive studio skills are essential to succeed in this fast-paced setting. 


You care about the people you work with and have a deep appreciation for different perspectives, opinions and experiences. You live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture. You provide meaningful, constructive feedback; guide complex editorial decisions; and actively teach advanced writing and producing skills. 


You ensure that all CBC journalistic standards are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful, immediate and resonate with the communities we serve. 


Reporting to the Executive Producer of Live & Daily News, Weekends, you help meet CBC’s strategic goals, including working across platforms to meet audience needs no matter where they consume our content. 


Based in Toronto, this is a full-time, permanent position. The successful candidate will work a four-day compressed work week (Thursday to Sunday). Hours will be decided by operational requirements. You can expect some overtime, including early mornings and evenings when news is breaking.


Key Tasks 


● Editorial Direction: Determine story priorities, develop innovative content strategies, and expertly guide teams through live, breaking, and ongoing news coverage. Guide the team on story length, deadlines, updates, and audio treatments. 


● Live Experience: Develop & practise a culture of embracing breaking news and leaning into developing stories with a disciplined focus on audience needs and CBC News strategy. Collaborate with broadcast, streaming and digital to ensure a full live experience across all platforms. 


● Manage Production & Broadcast: Exercise editorial responsibility over daily production and live broadcasting. Co-ordinate resources and determine the look, style, and pace of the lineup to maintain consistency with network mandates. Thrive under intense deadline pressures. 


● Change Agent: Drives continuous improvement, agile and adaptable in transforming newsroom structures and roles and lead transitions. You understand what motivates people. You welcome feedback and carefully consider that input as you align your team around shared goals. You celebrate success. 


● Foster Collaboration: Facilitate open, inclusive story meetings. Encourage story pitches and development. Collaborate across CBC News platforms to co-ordinate content, such raw sound, clipped material and packaged audio items. 


● Team Leadership: Actively support staff development, provide ongoing constructive feedback and coaching. Connect regularly with senior leadership about staffing and scheduling requirements and team culture. 


● Champion Audience Growth: Translate insights and data to guide content decisions to expand our reach to new and younger news consumers, and to deepen our engagement with all Canadians. 


● Maintain Standards: Strictly uphold CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices at all times. 


● Operational Support: Step in to perform all or part of the functions of an equivalent or lower classification as needed. 


Qualifications:

 

● Experience: Minimum of seven years in broadcast journalism, with a university degree or college diploma in journalism, audio production, or a related field.


● Live Broadcast Expertise: Proven experience producing live and breaking news programming, including production planning and resource co-ordination. Demonstrated ability as a programmer with a keen ear for pacing, tone, and presentation. 


● Technical Proficiency: Mandatory experience taking programs to air, alongside highly developed audio production skills. Familiarity with technology including iNews, Dalet, Avid Media Central and Google tools for content creation, distribution, and planning. 


● Critical thinking: Exceptional problem-solving skills to navigate fast-moving, high-pressure news situations. You're adept at verifying and fact-checking content. 


● Broad Knowledge Base: Deep interest and understanding across topics such as politics, business, science, sports, entertainment, and health. 


● Mentorship Skills: Superior coaching abilities to support developing journalists, veteran staff, and on-air hosts. Exceptional communication, organizational, and feedback skills. 


● Industry Awareness: A deep commitment to public broadcasting, understanding of modern industry trends, ability to identify legal and ethical issues in journalism, and application of CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.

You  ensure deployment roadmaps, budgets and travel are planned out as required. You work closely with newsroom leadership to manage deployments while prioritizing the physical and mental well-being of employees. 
  • Leadership & Staffing: You are a key leader within CBC News. You connect regularly with senior leadership about staffing requirements, interpersonal relationships and any necessary shift changes. You create a culture of collaboration, feedback and support, ensuring the safety and well-being of the team is considered in every assignment. 
  • Champion Audience Growth: Your decisions are focused on expanding our reach to new and younger news consumers, and to deepen our engagement with all Canadians. You understand the pulse of Canadian audiences, their habits and what they need from your coverage. You are able to translate insights and data into actionable content strategies for all platforms. 
  • Uphold Journalistic Excellence: You have a deep understanding of CBC’s rigorous Journalistic Standards and Practises. You help your team navigate complex ethical and legal considerations with grace and precision. 
  • Foster Authentic Storytelling: You champion content that truly reflects the richness and diversity of perspectives, ideas, and real-life experiences. You inspire your team to think inclusively, always asking whose voice is missing and you work diligently to close that gap. You collaborate with journalistic leaders across CBC News, ensuring our daily coverage is reflective of the stories and issues that help Canadians make sense of their world.  
  • Innovate & Strategize: You demonstrate daily the role of a public broadcaster in a media landscape proliferated with misinformation, disinformation and rapidly evolving technologies. Verification is a core value. You lean into data, and use it to drive audience-focused strategies for your team. You translate big ideas into tangible actions. 

We're looking for someone who:


  • Has a minimum of seven years of leadership experience in a fast-paced news environment, particularly in roles involving breaking news, national coverage and overseeing large teams through times of change. Experience risk assessment and management is an asset, experience in change management. 
  • Demonstrates exceptional critical thinking, news judgement and a deep knowledge of the legal and ethical issues in journalism. 
  • Is an astute strategist, capable of translating audience insights and data into effective content decisions and programming results that meet the evolving needs of Canadian news consumers. 
  • Finds solutions to a variety of technical, resource and operational issues and can make decisions on tight deadlines; can effectively juggle multiple short and long term tasks and projects.
  • Is comfortable navigating rapid change, troubleshooting complex situations, and making swift decisions under pressure.
  • Brings a deep and nuanced understanding of both domestic politics, events, geography, and history, coupled with strong cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Exhibits stellar communication and collaboration skills, essential for working across diverse teams and regions.
  • Has a university degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Is flexible to work varying hours and overtime, including early mornings, nights, weekends and holidays to respond to the demands of live and breaking news. 

This is an eight-month position, from November 2026 until June 2027, that can be based anywhere in Canada where there is a CBC station. As collaboration is a key requirement, you will be expected to be on-site. This is a Monday-Friday role. Hours that could be adjusted based on operational needs.

job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Marketing & Publicity

Work Status: Full-time (Hybrid)

Location: Toronto, Ontario

About the Role

The Senior Publicist plays a leadership role on Corus' Lifestyle PR team, helping drive awareness, engagement, and audience growth for Home Network, Flavour Network, HISTORY, Slice, and each network’s portfolio of original and acquired programming and talent.

Reporting to the Publicity Manager, with the support of a Publicist and a Publicity Coordinator, the Senior Publicist is responsible for developing and executing integrated publicity campaigns that generate impactful earned media coverage, social conversation, and influencer engagement across platforms. This role leads strategic communications plans for priority series and initiatives, manages talent and media relationships, oversees publicity events and activations, and collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to support business objectives.

The Senior Publicist also provides day-to-day leadership and mentorship to the Publicist and Publicity Coordinator while contributing to broader team and departmental initiatives.

Does mouth-watering food content stop your scroll? Are you constantly saving home reno reveals and luxury home tours? Perhaps historical documentaries send you down a rabbit hole for hours. If your algorithm knows you this well, maybe it's time we did too.

You will contribute by:

• Lead strategic publicity campaigns for priority Lifestyle brands and series, developing creative communications plans that support audience growth, brand awareness, and corporate objectives.

• Develop and execute earned media, influencer, talent, and event strategies for Home Network, Flavour Network, HISTORY, Slice, and their programming portfolios.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with entertainment, lifestyle, news, trade, and digital media outlets, as well as influencers and content creators across Canada.

• Manage media outreach and pitching efforts, securing high-impact coverage opportunities across broadcast, print, online, podcast, and social platforms.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with network talent, production partners, distributors, independent producers, and unit publicists to maximize promotional opportunities.

• Lead talent-related publicity initiatives, including media training support, interview opportunities, appearances, press tours, and promotional events.

• Develop, write, edit, and approve publicity materials, including press releases, media alerts, key messaging documents, biographies, press kits, show descriptions, briefing materials, presentations, and reports.

• Analyze media performance and campaign effectiveness, providing strategic recommendations and reporting on earned media and influencer results.

• Lead the planning and execution of publicity events, red carpets, press junkets, screenings, influencer activations, media experiences, and special events.

• Manage photography and promotional assets, including oversight of photo shoots, approvals, distribution, and organization of media materials.

• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Social Media, Programming, Creative Services, Research, Streaming, Sales, and Production teams to ensure integrated campaign execution.

• Identify innovative publicity opportunities and emerging media trends to keep Corus brands culturally relevant and top of conversation.

• Provide guidance, mentorship, and daily support to the Publicity Coordinator, helping develop their skills and career growth.

• Contribute to broader departmental initiatives and special projects as required.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Undergraduate degree or diploma in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Media Studies, Marketing, or a related field.

• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in publicity, media relations, communications, or entertainment marketing, preferably within the broadcasting, media, or entertainment industries.

• Proven ability to develop and execute strategic communications plans that support business objectives and generate measurable results.

• Exceptional written, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills.

• Strong media relations experience with an established network of contacts across Canadian lifestyle, entertainment, news, and trade media.

• Demonstrated success securing meaningful earned media coverage and developing innovative publicity campaigns.

• Experience managing influencer relations and creator partnerships.

• Strong understanding of talent relations and experience supporting talent-facing publicity initiatives.

• Experience planning and executing events, media experiences, launches, screenings, and press tours.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Highly collaborative with exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

• Proven ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience mentoring or supervising junior team members is considered an asset.

• Strong understanding of social media, digital content trends, and the evolving media landscape.

• Interest in and understanding of the Canadian broadcasting, media, and entertainment industries.

• Strong technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office and platforms such as Cision, Benchmark, MRP, WordPress, Meltwater, Canva, or similar tools.

job.title: Streaming Producer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX 32 Chicago/WFLD is seeking a dynamic, energetic, and innovative Streaming Producer to join our News team. This role is ideal for a curious, creative journalist who understands how audiences consume news across streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms.

The Streaming Producer will help develop engaging, conversational live-streaming concepts and produce content that informs, connects with, and serves Chicago audiences. This position requires strong news judgment, excellent writing and storytelling skills, and the ability to recognize when a conversation should continue, change direction, or end. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking calculated risks, testing new ideas, learning from results, and continually improving the viewer experience.

 

This is a hands-on role that may require flexible working hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and coverage during breaking news.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and produce engaging live and on-demand streaming content for FOX Chicago and FOX LOCAL.
  • Investigate and gather ideas for local Chicago stories that matter to our community.
  • Develop conversational streaming concepts, interview questions, segments, and audience-focused formats.
  • Quickly identify compelling angles, ask thoughtful follow-up questions, and guide conversations in real time.
  • Source, organize, and prepare video, graphics, user-generated content, and other visual elements.
  • Manage video editing and content-production workflows from concept through publication.
  • Write clear, compelling, and accurate content for digital, streaming, and linear platforms.
  • Ensure live streams and newscasts run smoothly while maintaining quality, accuracy, and editorial standards.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, producers, directors, photographers, editors, and digital teams.
  • Monitor audience engagement and use performance insights to improve content and coverage.
  • Publish and promote content across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, TikTok, Snapchat, and emerging platforms.
  • Respond quickly and effectively to breaking news, developing stories, and changing editorial priorities.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and community service.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A minimum of two to three years of experience in a producing, digital journalism, streaming, or related newsroom role.
  • Experience developing and publishing news content for digital and social platforms.
  • Strong writing, editing, interviewing, and storytelling skills.
  • Excellent news judgment and a commitment to factual accuracy.
  • The ability to generate creative ideas and present information in an original and engaging way.
  • The ability to think quickly, ask probing questions, and make sound editorial decisions in real time.
  • Familiarity with live-streaming production, digital publishing, video editing, and social media workflows.
  • The ability to quickly learn and effectively use various newsroom, editing, publishing, and production software systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments under tight deadlines.
  • The ability to respond well to direction, feedback, and changing priorities.
  • Dependability, professionalism, and a willingness to work a flexible schedule.
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • Experience line producing a live newscast or stream.
  • Experience producing conversational, interview-driven, or audience-interactive programming.
  • Experience with FOX LOCAL, CTV, OTT, or other streaming platforms.
  • Experience with live control-room operations or newsroom automation systems.
  • Experience using analytics to evaluate content performance and guide editorial decisions.
  • Experience creating short-form vertical video for social platforms.
  • Experience covering Chicago news, neighborhoods, politics, public safety, culture, or community issues.
  • Familiarity with video-editing, graphics, rundown, content-management, and social-publishing tools.
  • A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, or a related field.

Working conditions

  • Work is performed in a fast-paced newsroom and live-production environment.
  • The position may require evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and extended-hour work.
  • The schedule may change based on breaking news, special coverage, weather, and station needs.
  • The role may require working under tight deadlines and adapting quickly to changing editorial priorities.
  • Occasional field work or travel within the Chicago area may be required.
  • This position may require working onsite and collaborating across newsroom, studio, control-room, and digital-production areas.

Physical requirements

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while producing or monitoring live content.
  • Ability to use computers, phones, production systems, and other newsroom equipment for extended periods.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in person, by telephone, and through digital communication tools.
  • Ability to move throughout the station and, when assigned, work in field locations.

job.title: Manager, Insights & Analytics - Subscription
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.

This role is the marketing and lifecycle specialist on the subscription analytics team. You will own the measurement behind how we acquire, convert, win back, and retain subscribers: campaign and channel performance, CPA and spend efficiency, offer and promotional testing, and the CRM and lifecycle programs that carry subscribers through their tenure. You will also work on engagement measurement for our subscription products, because what subscribers do after they convert is what ultimately determines whether marketing spend pays back.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver with real marketing intuition who can write their own SQL, turn data into actionable business insight, and tell a clear story to non-technical partners.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Marketing & Acquisition Analytics

  • Serve as a key strategist for marketing, acquisition, win-back, and retention efforts, turning data insights into concrete recommendations on offers, timing, and targeting

  • Own recurring reporting on subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), and cancellations

  • Partner with Marketing to analyze campaign performance across channels and connect marketing spend to downstream subscriber acquisition and retention

  • Own CPA calculations and marketing spend efficiency analysis, monitoring performance by channel, campaign, and offer, and identifying where spend should shift

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription metrics (churn rate, cancel rate, plan mix, CPA, and related measures)

  • Conduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, and tenure

  • Investigate drivers behind churn and cancellation trends and flag actionable takeaways to stakeholders

  • Analyze pricing, packaging, and promotional performance to inform future offer strategy

CRM & Lifecycle Measurement

  • Measure CRM and lifecycle campaign performance across email, push, in-app, and SMS, and connect it to subscription conversion, migration, and retention outcomes

  • Build and refine attribution models (e.g., first-touch) to quantify the impact of marketing and CRM activity on subscriber outcomes

  • Conduct segmentation and cohort analysis to surface at-risk segments, re-engagement opportunities, and personalization angles across lifecycle channels

  • Support experimentation efforts (e.g., offer, subject line, and message format testing) by helping isolate confounding variables such as content quality versus format

  • Troubleshoot discrepancies between CRM platform reporting and internal tracking — naming mismatches, missing campaigns, deduplication logic — and resolve them at the query level

Engagement Measurement for Subscription Products

  • Report on engagement KPIs for subscription products — active days, session frequency, content starts and completion, and platform mix across web, mobile app, CTV, YouTube, and third-party platforms

  • Link early-tenure engagement to retention and LTV, identifying the behaviors that indicate a healthy subscriber and feeding that back into acquisition targeting, onboarding journeys, and offer design

  • Evaluate which acquisition sources and offers produce the most engaged subscribers, not simply the most subscribers

Reporting, Data Quality & Partnership

  • Write and maintain SQL (Snowflake or comparable) against subscription, billing, campaign, and engagement data to support recurring reporting and ad hoc stakeholder requests

  • Translate data into clear, digestible summaries and recommendations for marketing and cross-functional stakeholders

  • Maintain and improve recurring reporting processes to reduce manual work and improve accuracy, supporting the move toward self-service dashboards

  • Proactively flag anomalies — tracking gaps, app issues, data quality problems — before they distort reporting or reach decision-makers

  • Flag data quality issues or tracking gaps to Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering partners

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong SQL skills required — able to independently write queries involving joins, aggregations, and CTEs against large datasets. This is a must-have

  • Experience in marketing analytics, subscription or growth analytics, or a related quantitative and reporting role

  • Marketing intuition — an interest in and feel for how acquisition channels, campaigns, and offers affect subscriber behavior, not just the ability to pull numbers

  • Experience analyzing or reporting on subscription and lifecycle metrics (acquisition, churn, cancellations, retention)

  • Understanding of marketing attribution, including first-touch and multi-touch approaches

  • Comfort working in a BI or visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)

  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for ad hoc analysis, including pivot tables

  • Good communication skills — able to explain data findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders

  • Detail-oriented, with a track record of catching and resolving data quality issues before they reach leadership

  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor

  • Hands-on experience with a CRM or lifecycle platform such as Braze — including campaign and canvas reporting, segment auditing, and data reconciliation — a plus

  • Familiarity with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Recurly, Zuora, Stripe Billing) a plus

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, or a comparable engagement measurement tool a plus

  • Prior experience in media, streaming, publishing, or another content subscription business a plus

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Math, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience
