job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented and driven Assignment Desk Editor based in Miami to join its news team. The ideal candidate will bring strong editorial judgment, production experience, and a passion for breaking news. This role is responsible for coordinating story development, securing high-profile guests, booking interviews, field producing, and ensuring coverage is compelling and relevant across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. The successful candidate will manage story assignments, coordinate logistics, support field crews, and follow up on daily newsroom workflows across multiple news programs and platforms. This individual must be a strategic and creative thinker, a self-starter, and a collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Constantly monitor and respond to breaking news and developing stories across multiple platforms.
  • Monitor news wires, social media, scanners, broadcasts, and online sources to quickly identify breaking news opportunities.
  • Generate, research, verify, plan, and develop story ideas for newscasts, digital platforms, and special coverage.

  • Secure high-profile guests, newsmakers, public figures, and subject matter experts.

  • Participate in editorial meetings and communicate daily coverage plans and developments.
  • Assist with news production and special projects as assigned.
  • Field produce and travel as needed for major news coverage and special assignments.
  • Stay informed on national and international current events, legal developments, and culturally relevant topics.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing breaking news situations and adapting quickly to changes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines independently.
  • Be available to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during breaking news and continuous coverage situations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal).

job.title: Manager, Insights & Analytics - Subscription
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.

This role is the marketing and lifecycle specialist on the subscription analytics team. You will own the measurement behind how we acquire, convert, win back, and retain subscribers: campaign and channel performance, CPA and spend efficiency, offer and promotional testing, and the CRM and lifecycle programs that carry subscribers through their tenure. You will also work on engagement measurement for our subscription products, because what subscribers do after they convert is what ultimately determines whether marketing spend pays back.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver with real marketing intuition who can write their own SQL, turn data into actionable business insight, and tell a clear story to non-technical partners.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Marketing & Acquisition Analytics

  • Serve as a key strategist for marketing, acquisition, win-back, and retention efforts, turning data insights into concrete recommendations on offers, timing, and targeting

  • Own recurring reporting on subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), and cancellations

  • Partner with Marketing to analyze campaign performance across channels and connect marketing spend to downstream subscriber acquisition and retention

  • Own CPA calculations and marketing spend efficiency analysis, monitoring performance by channel, campaign, and offer, and identifying where spend should shift

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription metrics (churn rate, cancel rate, plan mix, CPA, and related measures)

  • Conduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, and tenure

  • Investigate drivers behind churn and cancellation trends and flag actionable takeaways to stakeholders

  • Analyze pricing, packaging, and promotional performance to inform future offer strategy

job.title: Streaming Producer
job.description:
FOX 32 Chicago/WFLD is seeking a dynamic, energetic, and innovative Streaming Producer to join our News team. This role is ideal for a curious, creative journalist who understands how audiences consume news across streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms.

The Streaming Producer will help develop engaging, conversational live-streaming concepts and produce content that informs, connects with, and serves Chicago audiences. This position requires strong news judgment, excellent writing and storytelling skills, and the ability to recognize when a conversation should continue, change direction, or end. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking calculated risks, testing new ideas, learning from results, and continually improving the viewer experience.

job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Program Manager, you will be a key member of the Delivery team, leading complex, high-impact programs across our portfolio of digital products and value streams. You will operate at the intersection of technology, product, and business strategy, partnering with senior and executive stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into executable plans and drive successful outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives.

You will provide program-level leadership across planning, execution, risk and dependency management, and delivery, while establishing the structure, transparency, and operating rhythms teams need to succeed. You will also play a leadership role in evolving our ways of working, applying SAFe and Agile best practices pragmatically to improve alignment, predictability, and delivery across the organization.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead complex, cross-functional programs across multiple teams and value streams, driving alignment from strategic planning through execution and delivery
  • Partner with senior and executive stakeholders to translate business and product strategy into actionable program plans, priorities, milestones, and measurable outcomes
  • Establish program governance, operating rhythms, and delivery frameworks that provide clear accountability, visibility, and decision-making across stakeholders
  • Proactively identify, assess, and manage program-level risks, issues, dependencies, and organizational changes, driving resolution and escalating critical decisions when necessary
  • Provide clear, timely, and actionable communication to senior leadership on program health, milestones, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and outcomes
  • Drive accountability across teams for commitments, budgets, timelines, and outcomes while partnering with leaders to remove obstacles and resolve complex delivery challenges
  • Lead planning and coordination across multiple Agile teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, and other cross-team planning and execution ceremonies
  • Lead the adoption and continuous improvement of delivery practices, processes, and tools, applying SAFe and Agile principles pragmatically based on organizational and team needs
  • Identify opportunities to improve program execution, predictability, transparency, and operational effectiveness, and lead initiatives to implement those improvements
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Product, Engineering, and business leaders, facilitating alignment and decision-making across competing priorities and complex dependencies
  • Mentor and coach program and delivery team members on program management methodologies, Agile practices, stakeholder management, and delivery best practices
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with executives, stakeholders, delivery teams, and external partners to enable effective collaboration and successful program outcomes
  • Stay current on program management, Agile delivery, technology, and media industry trends and apply relevant best practices to continuously evolve how teams operate

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 8+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, project management, or related delivery roles, including significant experience leading complex, cross-functional technology programs
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale programs involving multiple teams, workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities
  • Proven ability to partner with senior and executive stakeholders, influence decision-making, and create alignment between business strategy and technical execution
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and demonstrated experience applying Agile practices within complex technology organizations
  • Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including facilitating PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, or similar cross-team planning and coordination activities
  • Demonstrated ability to establish or evolve program management processes, governance, operating rhythms, and delivery practices
  • Strong program leadership skills with the ability to anticipate risks, navigate ambiguity, resolve complex problems, and drive decisions across teams without direct authority
  • Experience partnering closely with Software Development leadership, Product Owners, Product Management, business leaders, and other cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of technology delivery and the importance of stability, reliability, and the customer experience within production environments
  • Proficiency with the Atlassian suite and other relevant program and project management tools
  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations, decisions, and actions for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to listen, facilitate productive discussions, and build trusted relationships across all levels of an organization
  • Proficiency with AI-powered tools and demonstrated ability to leverage AI to improve productivity, workflows, analysis, and/or decision-making.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Agile certifications such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Certified SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE), or comparable Agile or program management certifications
  • Experience establishing SAFe processes, ceremonies, or Agile delivery practices within an organization or team from the ground up

job.description:
Job Title

Test Lead

Job Description

People Inc. Group has an opening for a Test Lead in New York, NY.

 

The position duties are as follows:  Responsible for reviewing requirements and working closely with developers, product managers, and other teams to ensure the software meets quality standards and is ready for release. Daily job duties include:


  • Analyze testing patterns and effectively communicate insights to managers.
  • Monitor application health during and post-deployment by analyzing logs, metrics, and test results.
  • Lead efforts to improve test processes across multiple SCRUM teams in collaboration with managers.
  • Debug CI/CD test infrastructure for functional test orchestration.
  • Provide constructive feedback on test scenarios developed by senior QA analysts to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Align technical testing strategies with business objectives to ensure seamless integration.
  • Analyze application and infrastructure logs with APM tools to identify application boundary issues.
  • Utilize expertise in test automation creation and test maintenance activities on a daily basis to oversee framework and ensure maintenance best practices.
  • Identify and remediate flaky tests through root cause analysis and test stabilization techniques.
  • Troubleshoot Jenkins job failures and pipeline errors to ensure continuous delivery stability.
  • Analyze metrics from automated performance tests, load tests, and monitoring tools to provide actionable insights.
  • Work closely with SCRUM teams to understand business priorities and contribute to timely, high-quality deliverables.
  • Communicate status updates and priorities clearly to ensure alignment across teams.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to senior engineers to enhance readability and optimize test code.
  • Enhance the automation framework to support and benefit other automation engineers.
  • Review and critique framework implementations by senior QA engineers to drive continuous improvements.
  • Offer constructive feedback to analysts and engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Participate in technical recruiting efforts by identifying and recommending best-fit candidates.
  • Design, execute, and maintain automated regression tests using Telescope, Voyager-UI, and CaseGen in JavaScript, and Nova-MCP in TypeScript, integrated with CI/CD pipelines for consistent daily coverage.

The position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Sciences, a related technical field or foreign equivalent, followed by 4 years of experience as a quality assurance analyst or tester. Experience must include:

  • 4 years of experience creating and running test cases for different types of testing, including manual, functional, regression, integration, and compatibility.
  • 4 years of experience defect tracking and management (using tools Jira, TestRail or Azure).
  • 4 years of experience with test management tools (including Jira) and Agile methodologies and overall SDLC.
  • 2 years of experience with automated testing frameworks (including Selenium and Playwright)
  • 2 years of experience testing APIs and data validation with tools such as Postman or Swagger
  • 2 years of experience with basic programming/scripting (including Java, and JavaScript or TypeScript)
  • 2 years of experience with CI/CD exposure (including Jenkins and GitHub Actions)
  • 2 years of experience with Version control (including Git)
  • 1 year of Cloud basic experience, including a demonstrated understanding of cloud-based environments, deployments and testing applications hosted on cloud infrastructure.
  • 1 year of experience with performance testing tools (including JMeter and Google Lighthouse)
  • 1 year of experience with test reporting and monitoring tools (e.g. Allure, Grafana, Kibana)

This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. 


Offered Wage: $130,354/year

Inside Sales / Account Advisor – Remote Sales

100% Remote | Full-Cycle Sales | Uncapped Earnings

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: 100% Remote – Work from Anywhere

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help local businesses grow through powerful, data-driven marketing solutions. We bring together marketing expertise, technology, and the reach of a nationally recognized media network to help businesses connect with customers and achieve their goals.

As an Inside Sales / Account Advisor, you’ll work directly with small and mid-sized businesses to understand their needs and connect them with marketing solutions designed to help them grow. You’ll have the opportunity to sell across a broad portfolio of solutions, including SEM, SEO, Social Media, YouTube, OTT/CTV, Display, Websites, and more.

This is a high-activity sales environment where consistency, resilience, and a willingness to put in the work directly contribute to your success.

About the Role

Our Inside Sales / Account Advisor role is a full-cycle, high-activity sales position for someone who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and owning their results.

You’ll be responsible for developing new business, growing existing accounts, and managing opportunities throughout the sales process. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers through outbound calls and virtual meetings, uncover their marketing needs, and recommend solutions that align with their goals.

This role provides the opportunity to operate with a high level of autonomy while having the support, training, technology, and resources of a nationally recognized organization behind you.

You’ll manage your pipeline in Salesforce, maintain consistent prospecting activity, conduct virtual client meetings, present tailored marketing solutions, and help ensure a smooth transition from sale to campaign launch.

In your first 90 days, you’ll participate in hands-on training, learn LocaliQ’s products and sales approach, build your pipeline, and develop the habits needed to succeed in a high-activity sales environment. As you ramp, you’ll take increasing ownership of your pipeline, client relationships, and revenue goals.

Why This Role Stands Out

• $40,000 base salary + uncapped commission, with an expected OTE of approximately $70K–$80K and top performers earning $100K+

• First 3-month earnings guarantee to support you while you ramp

• 100% remote work environment with the flexibility and autonomy to work from wherever you perform best

• Full-cycle sales ownership, from prospecting and discovery through close and post-sale support

• Opportunity to sell an extensive portfolio of digital and traditional marketing solutions

• Contests, incentives, and recognition programs for top performers

• Strong onboarding, training, coaching, and career development

• Career growth opportunities across the organization

• Backed by marketing expertise, Salesforce, and a nationally recognized brand

• Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and more

What You Will Do

• Drive new business and grow existing accounts through 50+ outbound calls per day and consistent prospecting

• Conduct virtual client meetings to uncover business needs, challenges, and growth opportunities

• Build and manage a strong sales pipeline in Salesforce

• Prospect for new business while identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts

• Recommend and sell bundled, multi-channel marketing solutions based on client goals

• Present marketing solutions across areas such as SEM, SEO, Social Media, YouTube, OTT/CTV, Display, Websites, and more

• Manage opportunities throughout the sales process and consistently work toward revenue goals

• Maintain accurate CRM activity, pipeline information, and follow-up

• Coordinate with internal teams on creative assets and campaign setup to help ensure a successful post-sale experience

• Consistently meet activity expectations and performance goals in a fast-paced, high-activity environment

Qualifications

• 2–5+ years of sales experience, with B2B or high-activity sales strongly preferred

• Confidence with outbound prospecting and engaging new clients

• Ability to manage a pipeline and consistently follow up with prospects and clients

• Strong communication, organization, and follow-through

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and conducting virtual meetings

• Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools is a plus

• Interest or exposure to digital marketing is helpful, but not required

• Ability to work independently and stay motivated in a fully remote environment

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Advisors are consistent, resilient, self-motivated, organized, and driven to succeed. They’re comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new prospects, handling rejection, and staying focused on the next opportunity.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy a fast pace, like having clear goals to work toward, and take ownership of your results. The strongest performers understand that success comes from consistent daily activity, strong follow-through, coachability, and a willingness to keep improving.

You’ll have autonomy in your day-to-day work, but you won’t be on your own. LocaliQ provides the training, coaching, tools, and support needed to help you build your skills and grow your career.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:

Participate in hands-on training, learn LocaliQ’s products and sales process, build your pipeline, establish consistent prospecting habits, and ramp toward goal.

6 Months:

Demonstrate strong product knowledge, maintain consistent activity, manage a healthy pipeline, and establish steady sales performance.

12 Months:

Operate at full productivity across multiple products, effectively manage your pipeline and book of business, and consistently deliver against revenue and activity goals.

Benefits

We believe strong performance should be supported through competitive compensation, development, and opportunities to grow.

• $40,000 base salary + uncapped commission

• Expected OTE of approximately $70K–$80K

• Top performers earning $100K+

• First 3-month earnings guarantee

• 401(k) with company match

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options

• PTO and paid holidays

• 100% remote work environment

• Career progression opportunities

• Ongoing coaching and professional development

• Incentives, contests, and recognition programs

• Access to industry-leading sales and marketing tools

• Training and support from experienced sales leaders

Build Your Future with LocaliQ

If you’re motivated by earning potential, enjoy building relationships, and want the opportunity to own your success, LocaliQ offers a place to build your sales career.

You’ll help local businesses grow, develop valuable sales and marketing expertise, and have the autonomy to make an impact—all while working remotely.

If you’re ready to put your skills to work and grow with a winning team, we encourage you to apply.

job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a Manager, Campaign Operations to join a newly established function at RCA Records. Campaign Operations is the connective tissue between departments — tracking, surfacing, and flagging cross-departmental activity across the full roster to ensure that when a decision gets made in one room, every other team knows what it means for them.

Reporting to the Campaign Operations Lead and sitting within the SVP Commercial Partnerships organization, this role will own the day-to-day operational relationship with a cluster of departments, monitoring their workflows, lead times, and deliverables across every active artist campaign. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of how to work cross-functionally between departments, thrives in ambiguity, and brings the kind of diplomatic, low-ego energy that builds trust without creating friction.

What you'll do:

  • Department Relationship Management: Own the day-to-day operational relationship with an assigned cluster of departments. Learn their workflows, lead times, tools, and pain points. Become the person they trust to represent their status accurately.
  • Release Readiness Monitoring: Track workability status across all active releases. Surface gaps in clearances, masters, artwork, agreements, and delivery timelines before they become blockers.
  • Budget Visibility & Tracking: Monitor campaign spend against approved budgets across the roster. Surface divergence, flag overages, and track budget status in real time so that the people who own those decisions have full information. Campaign Ops does not approve or deny spend — it ensures the numbers are visible and accurate.
  • Cross-Department Flagging: Identify when an issue in one department affects another. Surface the connection, prompt the teams involved, and track resolution.
  • Meeting Support: Contribute to cross-department meeting preparation, transcript processing, and action item tracking. Help produce Goal Briefs and meeting notes for distribution.
  • Artist Briefing Support: Assist in producing artist briefings and prep packages for new signings and key roster moments. Compile information from multiple departments into a single, clear picture.
  • Data Layer Maintenance: Keep shared operational data current and accurate across Airtable and internal dashboards. Ensure department status is reflected in real time.
  • Escalation: When an issue cannot be resolved at the department level, route to the Campaign Operations Lead for consolidation. The team speaks as a unit.
  • Tool & System Awareness: Stay current on internal tools, Sony enterprise systems, and department-specific platforms. Surface what exists, who uses it, and where there are gaps or duplication.

Who you are:

  • Minimum of 3 years in the music industry, entertainment, media, or a similar field, with previous experience working collaboratively across various teams and departments.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities across a large roster.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams. You can translate technical or operational information into clear, concise language for varied audiences.
  • Familiarity with project management or operational tracking tools (Airtable, Asana, Monday, or similar). Willingness to learn new systems quickly.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records. Comfortable tracking dozens of open items across multiple workstreams without losing threads.
  • Diplomatic and low-ego. This role requires navigating departmental sensitivities without creating friction. You amplify other teams’ work — you don’t add oversight.
  • Curiosity about how systems work and why they break. Interest in process improvement, data visibility, and operational design.
  • You are a motivated self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

This role serves as a technical leader responsible for defining architecture strategy, guiding enterprise solution delivery, and enabling scalable business capabilities across the SMS ecosystem. This role exercises wide latitude in determining objectives, technical approaches, and architecture standards for critical SMS initiatives with broad organizational visibility. This role will drive modernization, scalability, performance optimization, and integration initiatives across Oracle BRM and related enterprise systems while partnering closely with engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver strategic enterprise solutions. The team participates across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, Agile development, deployment, and production support.   • Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, enterprise integrations, and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, containerization, Kubernetes, or modernization initiatives is a plus.
  • Strong software development skills in C, SQL, Python, and Java within Unix/Linux environments.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Recommendations (Experience)
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Recommendations Experience team, focusing on building ML-powered features that directly improve personalization, engagement, and satisfaction for our users. While this is an MLE role, you’ll bring strong engineering fundamentals and work across the full stack and end-to-end systems, from data pipelines to APIs to real-time serving, and everything in between. The Recommendations team ships ML-powered features that connect 200M+ users with music they'll love. 

You'll own features end-to-end: from understanding user needs with Product and Design, to architecting data pipelines processing billions of events, to building and shipping production ML systems that balance performance, cost, and user experience. This means working across BigQuery (trillion-row datasets), Airflow orchestration, real-time serving infrastructure (BigTable), APIs, and constant collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, and Platform teams.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop, test, and productionize ML and LLM-based systems serving real users
  • Design and build end-to-end ML pipelines, including data, features, training, and serving
  • Make technical decisions considering cost, latency, complexity, and maintainability 
  • Navigate distributed systems (BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, DynamoDB) to build reliable, scalable solutions
  • Set up monitoring, A/B testing, and metrics frameworks to measure real user impact
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines, ML models, and distributed systems
  • Contribute to technical strategy and team best practices
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier to work at 10x the speed of traditional methods

Experience and Background:

  • 1-2+ years building ML systems in production - you understand the difference between a model that works in Jupyter and one that serves millions of users
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience - you write production code, not just notebooks
  • Strong Python and Scala (or Java/JVM) skills, with experience writing scalable, production code
  • Experience building and deploying ML models end-to-end (data, training, serving, monitoring)
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-based features in production
  • Familiarity with integrating LLMs into ML systems (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation, model serving)
  • Understanding of shared ML architecture across domains (e.g. search and recommendations)
  • Strong focus on data quality and correctness, and how upstream data impacts downstream models and user experience
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (BigQuery, Spark)
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS/GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with distributed data processing and ETL pipelines (Airflow, Spark)
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

job.title: Safety Supervisor
job.description:
Title: Safety Supervisor

Reports to: Safety Director

Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power), a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises, is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction.

But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions.

 

About the Role:

The Safety Supervisor will be responsible for training and administer Train and administer the Company safety, health and accident prevention program and ensure all employees have a safe environment in which to work.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Administer the Company safety program; implement and coordinate safety and health activities.  

²  Able to conduct safety training classes; safety certification classes and maintain all related records. 

²  Monitor and evaluate training program’s effectiveness, success and periodically report on them.

²  Able to review accidents and incidents, take corrective action as needed and make recommendations to prevent future occurrences.

²  Analyze inspection findings to determine the need for employee safety training. 

²  Recommend safety equipment to be used or worn; coordinate with safety committees and the purchasing departments concerning the purchase, storage and issuance of approved safety equipment and products for employees.

²  Able to coordinate fleet safety programs; keep current on new trends and methods in accident prevention field; keep current on OSHA reports and standards.

²  Able to analyze all loss data to determine causes of injuries; develop trend analysis and statistical summary of accidents and injuries.

²  Conduct studies concerning the interest and need for safety training programs; administer safety awareness awards program.

²  Able to attend and participate in professional safety organization projects.

²  Able to supervise and administer safety, first aid and rescue squad activities including work assignments, personnel administration, staffing, training, etc.

²  Able to review documentation to insure all required records and reports are complete, accurate and submitted per established procedures, and implement appropriate corrective action as required.

²  Perform additional duties as assigned by the Safety Director.

 

Qualifications:

²  Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Industrial Hygiene or related discipline or a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge.

²  Minimum 3 years safety related experience or field related experience in the underground construction industry.  

²  OSHA 30 Construction required.

²  Possession of a valid class A or C California driver's license

²  Thorough understanding of and ability to enforce federal, state, local and company regulations.

²  Ability to recognize hazardous situations and implement corrective measures.

²  Good interpersonal and communication skills required.

²  Must have extensive knowledge of applicable safety regulations, regulatory requirement and industry standards for construction and general industry; knowledge of EPA, DOT and NEPA standards.

²  Experience in high voltage utility construction a plus

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

You are an energetic, interactive, and social media savvy media personality who understands that today's talent represents the station both on and off the air. You are equally comfortable entertaining listeners on the radio, engaging audiences on social media, creating digital first content, and helping shape the sound and strategy of a growing multimedia brand. You embrace emerging technologies and understand how to build meaningful audience connections across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, websites, mobile apps, video platforms, and social media.

  • Create engaging, audience-focused content across broadcast, digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media.

  • Strong storytelling, interviewing, writing, communication, and on-camera presentation skills.

  • Strong understanding of audience development, digital content strategy, social platforms, and emerging trends.
  • Experience shooting, editing, publishing, and optimizing video and multimedia content using mobile and professional production tools.
  • Ability to interpret audience insights and analytics to improve content performance and audience engagement.
  • Strong organizational, collaboration, project management, and time management skills.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish preferred.

  • Participar en la creación y mantenimiento de entornos tipo sandbox para pruebas, experimentación y validación de modelos, automatizaciones y herramientas basadas en IA.  

  • Ejecutar pruebas funcionales y de calidad sobre herramientas de automatización, documentando hallazgos y recomendaciones de mejora.  

  • Apoyar en la generación, organización y optimización de instrucciones (prompts), flujos de trabajo y casos de prueba para sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial.

  • Contribuir a la identificación de oportunidades para reducir tiempos de procesamiento, eliminar actividades manuales y aumentar la eficiencia operativa del área.

job.title: Software Data Engineer
job.description:
About the Role & Team 

Do you remember seeing trailers for The Devil Wears Prada 2 earlier this summer? What about digital spots for a cruise on the Disney Wish? Or the California Adventure Food and Wine Festival? If you did, it was likely because of the detailed planning and execution of The Walt Disney Company’s Enterprise Media and Marketing team…and if you didn’t – it’s probably because our targeting is that good. 

 

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the Performance Marketing arm of this media team. We are an integrated, cross-functional team of marketers, software engineers, data scientists, and analysts who help the Media team execute highly data-driven marketing campaigns and tactics. 

 

As a Data Engineer, you will help expand our technology portfolio of innovative campaign planning tools, complex data science workflows, and elegant web applications that blend the art of advertising with the science of data-backed insights.  

 

This role is unique – our team is embedded directly within the Disney media team. We're aligned, mission-driven, and free to move fast and innovate towards our goals. You'll tackle the challenges of executing and optimizing precise paid media strategies, using the latest technologies and tools. If you're excited about this, please get in touch – we'd love to hear from you! 

 

What You Will Do 

 

  • Contribute to the development of the suite of tools used by the Performance Marketing group 

  • Drive data engineering, data modeling, and architectural standards within the team; uphold standards and rigor around pipeline development, observability, and documentation 

  • Create and manage end-to-end data pipelines – from source system to end consumer teams, applications, and users 

  • Collaborate with the broader team of media/marketing experts to rapidly iterate from prototypes to high-quality, production pipelines and applications 

  • Implement quality controls, monitoring, and other safeguards to ensure optimizations are accurately and safely applied to in-flight ad campaigns and key business metrics are always presented accurately  

 

Required Qualifications & Skills 

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 

  • 3+ years of experience designing and delivering backend architectures in a production environment, with a strong understanding of design patterns and best practices. 

  • Strong opinions on how to best use AI/LLMs in the software development process; ability to quickly discern hype from value in the quickly evolving AI landscape (and an equal ability to put it into practice) 

  • Experience with Spark and SQL; experience building simple and maintainable data pipelines on scaled data platforms 

  • Ability to dive deep into any technical component 

  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into reality-based requirements 

 

Preferred Qualifications     

 

  • Experience working effectively with data science teams  

  • Specific experience with our stack: Spark, Python, Databricks/Snowflake, AWS, Terraform 

  • Knowledge of media buying and ad platforms including DMPs, Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram, Innovid, LiveRamp and DSPs (Google Display Video, The Trade Desk, Yahoo)  

 


The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $106,900.00 - $143,300.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

  Job Title: Lead Software Engineer in Test Team: Global Quality Engineering Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Staff Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This senior technical role combines deep Java engineering expertise, advanced test automation, media/streaming domain knowledge, and modern CI/CD practices to accelerate quality, reduce risk, and ensure world-class customer experiences across CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web. You will be a senior technical leader within the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization. You will use and enhance our existing departmental automation framework, define quality strategies, and mentor engineers across GQE to elevate testing maturity and engineering excellence. You will also drive AI-augmented development and testing practices using GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Automation Framework Architecture • Enhance and extend our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Establish scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. Quality Engineering Technical Leadership • Define technical strategy for automated testing across services, microservices, UIs, mobile apps, and OTT/CTV applications leveraging the departmental framework. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns. • Lead the evaluation and adoption of modern automation technologies and quality platforms.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 7+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with robust Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional automation initiatives. • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Technical leadership – ability to guide teams and evolve automation coverage. • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – knowledge of distributed systems and complex media pipelines. • Ownership – ability to drive initiatives end-to-end with autonomy.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams

Overview

 We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational layer around our personalization and recommendation Machine Learning (ML) systems. Our models retrain and deploy daily on automated pipelines. Your job is to make sure we can trust what's running, know when something is off, and fix it fast. You'll sit within DevOps and work closely with ML engineers, who own the models end-to-end. You won't be building infrastructure from scratch, you'll partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to get the tooling you need, then own it day-to-day.

What You'll Do
  • Own model traceability: Every model in production should have clear lineage: what data trained it, what code produced it, what validation it passed, and how it's performing. Evaluate and recommend tooling for versioning, metadata, and model registry, and work with MLEs to drive adoption.
  • Build end-to-end monitoring: Monitor the full signal path: data arrival, feature distribution stability, model metrics, and serving latency against SLA. Own this individually, don't rely solely on upstream teams to catch their own issues.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality: Collaborate to surface data quality issues, detect drift in upstream sources, and ensure features stay fresh and reliable.
  • Detect issues proactively: Track drift over weeks, flag slow degradation before it crosses a threshold, surface feature freshness problems before they cascade.
  • Build diagnostic tooling: When something goes wrong, get from "recommendations look off" to root cause in minutes. That means ensuring the right context is logged at each stage, candidates, features, serving context, and building the dashboards to tie it collectively.
  • Own incident response for ML systems: Maintain rollback playbooks and pre-defined hotfix strategies with quantified tradeoffs. Own automated gates that block bad deployments. Run post-mortems and close the gaps.
  • Coordinate on post-deployment metrics: Work with ML engineers, data engineers, and stakeholders to define what metrics to collect after deployment and why they matter.


Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years in ML engineering, applied ML, or a related ML role, with demonstrated experience on the operational side of monitoring, reliability, deployment, or incident response
  • Has built or operated model registries, ML monitoring systems, or production ML pipelines
  • Understands ML systems end-to-end — not just the infra layer, but why a stale feature or a shifted distribution matters
  • Robust SQL skills and comfort digging into data distributions, feature health, and model behavior
  • Comfortable partnering with DevOps and Platform teams to define infrastructure needs without needing to own the infra yourself


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation or personalization systems at scale

Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Maintenance Technician responsible for maintenance and support of production and broadcast systems for the CBS Network and affiliated production units, providing critical 24x7 support for on-air and production infrastructure. This role covers hands-on troubleshooting and repair of routing systems, audio/video transport and IP media infrastructure (SDI and SMPTE 2110), production switchers, audio consoles, media file transfer and storage systems, video acquisition and playback servers, non-linear postproduction systems, production intercom, cameras, prompters, and other studio production systems, working to mitigate impact to production and on-air deadlines. This is a shift-based role covering rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays, with on-call/callback responsibilities per the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

 

•    3+ years' experience working with professional television broadcast equipment, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot to the component/system level under time pressure, in a live production environment.
•    Hands-on experience with broadcast test equipment (waveform monitors, vector-scopes, audio analyzers, cable/fiber test sets) and cable/fiber termination and testing.
•    In-depth knowledge in of the following: Video, Audio, Cameras, Control/Data Systems, RF, Fiber-Optics, and IP media distribution (SMPTE 2110/2059).
•    Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals — VLANs, subnetting, multicast, and basic switch/router configuration — sufficient to troubleshoot IP-based media infrastructure.
•    Strong understanding of broadcast media systems design and signal flow; ability to read and work from schematics and as-built documentation.
•    Experience with Windows, Linux, and macOS workstation/server environments as used in broadcast and postproduction facilities.
•    Ability to communicate technical root-cause and status updates clearly to non-technical production staff (directors, TDs, producers) during live troubleshooting.
•    Ability to perform physical work associated with rack and machine room environments, including lifting equipment and working in confined or elevated spaces.

 

Bonus Skills:

 

•    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Engineering, or IT preferred.
•    Direct experience with SMPTE ST 2110 (2110-20/30/40) and ST 2059 PTP timing in a production environment.
•    Scripting/automation experience (Python, JSON) for diagnostics, monitoring, or system integration.

•    Familiarity with Evertz, Grass Valley routing systems; RTS intercom, Sony switchers and cameras, EVS, Grass Valley AMPP video playout/record servers a plus.

The Director of Creative Music, Paramount Pictures serves as a key creative partner across Paramount Pictures’ theatrical slate, supporting filmmakers and creative leadership in the development and execution of music for feature films. Operating as an in-house music supervisor, this role oversees all creative music elements from early development through final delivery, ensuring that each film’s musical vision enhances storytelling and supports the filmmaker’s intent.   This position works closely with directors, producers, composers, artists, and internal studio partners to deliver high-quality, filmmaker-driven music for Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases. This position is based at the historic Paramount Lot in Los Angeles.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with directors, producers, and Paramount Pictures creative executives to shape and execute the musical vision for assigned theatrical films.
  • Engage in projects early in development to provide creative guidance on score, source music, and overall music strategy.
  • Serve as a trusted creative collaborator to filmmakers and talent throughout pre-production, production, and post-production.
  • Advocate for the filmmaker’s creative vision while ensuring alignment with Paramount Pictures’ production goals and creative standards.
  • Act as the in-house music supervisor for assigned Paramount Pictures theatrical films.
  • Oversee all creative music elements including score, source music, needle drops, themes, and temp music.
  • Supervise spotting sessions, music reviews, and creative discussions with filmmakers and post-production teams.
  • Ensure music choices support narrative, tone, and emotional impact.
  • Identify, recommend, and help secure composers and music collaborators in partnership with filmmakers.
  • Guide composers creatively throughout the scoring process, maintaining clear communication between creative and post-production teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with composers, artists, music editors, and scoring partners.
  • Oversee music workflows through production and post-production, including scoring schedules, recording sessions, and final mixes.
  • Attend scoring sessions, dubbing sessions, and final mixes as appropriate.
  • Ensure all music is creatively approved, delivered on time, and ready for theatrical release.
  • Collaborate with internal Paramount Pictures teams including Production, Post-Production, Creative Affairs, Legal, Business Affairs, Finance, and Marketing.
  • Partner with music clearance and licensing teams to balance creative ambition with budgetary and legal requirements.
  • Support soundtrack, marketing, publicity, and awards initiatives tied to Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in music supervision, film music, or creative music roles within a theatrical film or studio environment.
  • Proven experience supervising music for feature films from development through post-production.
  • Strong creative instincts with deep knowledge of film scoring and source music.
  • Established relationships with composers, filmmakers, artists, and music industry partners.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple films simultaneously across a theatrical slate.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Prior in-house studio experience at a major theatrical studio.
  • Experience working directly with high-profile filmmakers and talent.

job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join Hearst Connecticut Media Group to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview: Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at Hearst Connecticut Media Group. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Connecticut area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within Hearst Connecticut Media Group, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

Why Hearst Connecticut Media Group? 

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieves success as an Account Executive. 
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.
  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.
  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.
  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.
  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.
  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.
  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.
  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.

  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

     

Compensation: In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Connecticut. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Connecticut, is $50,000 - $60,000 base plus commissions with on-target earning potential of $90,000 - $120,000 annualized in the 1st year, based on individual performance, commissions are uncapped for unlimited earning potential. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

Benefits: Eligible employees enjoy Health, dental, vision coverage, Health savings and/or flexible spending accounts, short & long-term disability insurance, 401k with company match, paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays and floating holidays.

 

Join us at Hearst Connecticut Media Group and become part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Apply now to make an impact in the Connecticut advertising market!

Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) is the leading news organization in the state, serving readers across all platforms through its news and lifestyle portfolio—including CT Insider, The Connecticut Post, Danbury News-Times, Greenwich Time, New Haven Register, The Middletown Press, The Norwalk Hour, The Register Citizen, Republican-American, Stamford Advocate, and Connecticut Magazine.

Overview

Job Title: WCCO Producer

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Minneapolis, M.N. 

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Overview:

Audacy Minneapolis' WCCO-AM, is searching for an experienced, full-time Producer. Duties include following station format, editing podcasts, assisting with remote talk broadcasts, handling live phone calls, sound effects, conceptualizing topics, arranging guest interviews, playing commercials and IDs according to the program and commercial logs, following applicable laws and FCC regulations and executing to the Program Director’s direction. Candidates must have prior radio experience and be familiar with control room operations. Applicants should have a minimum of three (3) years’ experience operating broadcast equipment and conceptualizing topics in a broadcast setting. Editing and production experience is preferred. The right candidate will be a team player, be computer savvy, and have the flexibility to work their assigned shift.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • One to three years as producer or on-air contributor
  • Passion for current events, news, pop culture and what’s happening around town
  • Comfortable running (and learning) multiple different board operating styles
  • Experience with radio clocks, logs and scheduling
  • Working knowledge of computer audio software, Adobe Audition, and Wide Orbit preferred
  • Demonstrated ability for using social media including, but not limited to, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter, and Instagram.
  • Willingness to learn new tools and how they can help content, distribution or sales
  • Willing to work in the office or on location.
  • Multi-task with a variety of duties
  • Ability to ad lib while on air and at appearances in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.
  • Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.
  • Work established schedule and other hours as needed. Travel to and attend station promotional appearances including sales appearances.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

  • Ability to produce programs that meet WCCO programming standards
  • Proven ability to contribute to a positive, diverse, creative, productive culture
  • Ability to evaluate content/quality/sound and act decisively w/sound judgment
  • Knowledge of new media applications for digital distribution, audience engagement and community networking
  • Spontaneous, interpretative judgments and solutions in fast-paced environment
  • Manages own workload with priorities based on show content and production

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

About Us

Audacy is a leading audio content and entertainment company. As champions of audio, we connect with people in the moments that matter — delivering trusted local news, passionate sports and your favorite music across 220+ radio stations, premium podcasts, live events and digital experiences that reach more than 200 million listeners every month.We create compelling content, foster deeply engaged audiences and deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. Learn more at www.audacyinc.com and join the conversation on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.
