Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

The Senior Manager, Planning and Operations, directs the planning and publishing operations for news, sports and variety content on ICI TOU.TV. As a key strategic pivot, your goal will be to translate business orientations into concrete results, for example by expanding the digital audience, boosting subscription and advertising revenues, steering the deployment of major events on ICI TOU.TV (Olympic Games, Eurovision, year-end programming, special news coverage) and promoting our variety content on YouTube while overseeing the dedicated team of digital editors.


Your Responsibilities:

Strategic planning and organizational alignment

  • Take part in quarterly and annual strategic and operational planning processes, including performance reviews and priority adjustments. 
  • Define key performance indicators and achievement targets for ICI TOU.TV’s News, Sports and Variety Section.
  • Identify growth opportunities based on market trends, subscription and viewing behaviour and business objectives.
  • Drive cross-functional cohesion and guide decisions in line with the vision and strategic objectives of the ICI TOU.TV platform.

  • Optimize workflows among programming, marketing, product, digital innovation, technology and customer service teams to ensure speed and efficiency.
  • Guarantee a high editorial standard, enrich metadata management and apply advanced SEO strategies to maximize referral.

YouTube growth strategy (Variety segment)

  • Develop and execute the YouTube growth strategy for our variety content and promote off-platform discoverability.
  • Supervise the work done to create appealing visuals/thumbnails, manage playlists and optimize retention, viewing time and impression metrics.

  • Engage the various departments and ensure alignment towards our strategic priorities and business objectives.
  • On a day-to-day basis, oversee, empower and support the ICI TOU.TV team of digital editors who are responsible for editorializing, showcasing and publishing content from the News, Sports and Variety Section.
  • Be a strategic mentor to your team and co-workers as they develop their analysis, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Promote a culture of innovation, diligence and operational excellence and explore the integration of new technologies.

In this role, you will champion the lifecycle of our Workday product features, ensuring they align with broader business objectives and deliver maximum value to the organization.


You will lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing, cross-functional team of Business Analysts and Product Owners. As the bridge between business strategy and technical execution, you will own the Workday product evolution roadmap, investment alignment, governance and drive the end-to-end project management of feature rollouts, system optimizations, and semi-annual Workday releases.


Location: This is a bilingual position (English/French) and can be based in either Ottawa or Toronto with flexible hybrid work options.


Key Responsibilities


Strategic Leadership & Roadmap Management


  • Own the Evolution Roadmap: Define, manage, and execute the multi-year product evolution roadmap for the Workday platform and third party system integrations, balancing business-critical enhancements with technical debt and scalability.
  • Feature Evolution: Direct the evaluation, testing, and deployment of new Workday features, modules, and functionalities (including Workday’s semi-annual release cycles).
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Provide enterprise leadership and guidance by collaborating with People & Culture colleagues, Finance, IT, and other business units to translate organizational pain points into scalable technical solutions.

Team Management & Capability Building


  • Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Guide a dedicated team of Managers, Workday Business Analysts and Specialists, fostering a culture of agility, accountability, continuous learning and consultative service excellence.
  • Resource Allocation: Manage team capacity and prioritize incoming business requests against strategic platform goals.
  • Mentorship: Elevate the team’s capabilities in business analysis, Workday configuration best practices, and agile delivery methodologies.


Platform Performance, Risk & Compliance

In an environment where data has become a critical strategic asset supporting decision-making, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence solutions, CBC/Radio-Canada is implementing an enterprise-wide data governance program. The creation of the Director, Enterprise Data Governance role is at the heart of this transformation and aims to establish the foundations required for the effective, secure and consistent management of information assets.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Framework, Policies & Compliance

  • Develop, refine, and enforce enterprise-wide data governance policies, directives, and standards aligned with corporate priorities.
  • Work with Legal, InfoSec, and Data Engineering to establish data classification rules, access controls, and compliance monitoring.
  • Define core data concepts and maintain central governance documentation and artifacts.

 

Core Programs & Data Operations

  • Data Catalog & Metadata: Oversee the implementation of an enterprise data catalog and metadata management processes to ensure reporting mechanisms and datasets are clear and accessible.
  • Data Quality & Lineage: Stand up an enterprise data quality program and implement data lineage tracking to monitor how data moves across systems.
  • Usability & AI Readiness: Partner with technology and analytics teams to make sure data is clean and structured for BI, reporting, and AI/ML models.

 

Governance Bodies & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Manage the Enterprise Data Governance Steering Committee to align senior leadership on strategic priorities.
  • Lead the Enterprise Data Council (domain leads and Data Officers) to translate strategic directives into policies and actionable initiatives.
  • Drive the creation of cross-functional networks of data stewards, owners, custodians, and working groups as needed.

 

Data Literacy & Culture

  • Lead change management, training, and communication programs to improve overall data literacy across the corporation.
  • Influence senior executives and business stakeholders to adopt governance practices and understand their role in protecting and using data.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a small, high-impact data governance team.

 

Metrics, KPI Tracking & Reporting                       

  • Define, track, and report on core governance KPIs, including data quality, issue resolution, policy compliance, and user adoption.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards to regularly report program progress and outcomes to leadership.

 

What You Bring

 

Qualifications, experience & skills

  • 5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proven experience building and launching enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience leading enterprise-grade data catalog / data governance tooling initiatives.
  • Experience developing and managing a business glossary.
  • Experience operating in a national, matrixed organization.
  • Bilingualism (English and French).

 

Technical:

  • Core Skills & Technical Proficiencies: Strong hands-on experience with SQL, data modeling, structured/unstructured data governance, and ETL/ELT logic. Profiency  withPython, Jira, and workflow mapping tools is a key asset.
  • Governance Tooling & Platforms: Hands-on experience with integrating and/or heavy use of enterprise data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Purview) and familiarity with major cloud-based data platforms (e.g.: Google Cloud Platform, Azure).
  • Data Lifecycle & Quality Operations: Proven track record in building and validating data lineage, managing data quality validation/remediation, and creating or overseeing automated scripts for metadata harvesting and validation.
  • Architecture & Team Collaboration: Deep understanding of modern data architectures (cloud data platforms, BI/analytics, AI/ML pipelines) paired with a strong ability to collaborate across technical, product, vendor, and business teams.
  • Communication & Technical Translation: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical, architectural, and regulatory concepts into clear, actionable business language.
  • Nice-to-Have Technical Assets: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and API-based metadata harvesting.

 

Non-technical:

  • Ability to understand and communicate the value of data as an asset.
  • Ability to manage cross-functional teams.
  • Business and technical requirements documentation skills.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
  • Ability to lead by influence and work across teams and business units at varying levels of data governance maturity.

Vendor Management & Industry Representation

You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team.

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Media Sales Strategist 

  

***Please note that we offer flexibility regarding work location for candidates based in Alberta*** 

  

Who we're looking for:  

  

We are seeking a dynamic Media Sales Strategist to join our team. This role is pivotal in driving revenue across multiple platforms, including Radio, Television, Digital, Out-of-Home (OOH), and Sports. The Media Sales Strategist will enhance operational efficiency and streamline sales tasks, allowing Account Managers to focus on building strong business relationships and improving solution selling skills.

 

The ideal candidate will possess a solid background in multimedia sales, exceptional project management skills, strong technical proficiency and a collaborative approach to working with both internal and external stakeholders, along with a keen understanding of the evolving media landscape. 

  

What you'll do:  

  

Transactional Task Management 

  • Exceed annual revenue targets by efficiently managing transactions and ensuring operational accuracy.
  • Assist Account Managers in developing strategy and crafting multi-media proposals and presentations that align with client KPIs.
  • Utilize AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to enhance efficiency and share insights with the team. 

  

Campaign Support 

  • Assist with operational details for campaign development and execution, ensuring seamless communication with internal teams and clients as needed.  
  • Collaborate with departments such as Credit, Creative, AdOps, Branded Content & Integrations, Go-to-Market Team, and Insights.  
  • Working knowledge of the RSM order management systems (S4M, DOMO and Hivestack) and monitor campaigns for optimal performance. 
  • Collaborate closely with sales teams to ensure all campaign deliverables are aligned and completed according to their business requirements 

  

Data Hygiene Maintenance

FOX LATAM

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor to join the FOX team in Mexico City. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day general accounting operations, manage AR workflows, and drive the month-end closing process across Mexico and Central America.


Serving as a crucial bridge between operational execution and managerial oversight, you will ensure total financial accuracy, regional tax compliance (including Mexican CFDI 4.0 and local tax/e-invoicing regulations across Central American countries), and strict alignment with US GAAP and local statutory standards.


The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, expertise in multi-entity regional accounting, and proven experience guiding junior accounting staff within a dynamic, fast-paced multinational environment.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Regional Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting activities across Mexico and Central American entities, including general ledger maintenance, AR operational cycle, accruals, prepaid expenses, and fixed assets.
  • Month-End Close: Lead and streamline monthly, quarterly, and annual closing schedules for regional entities, preparing and reviewing complex journal entries, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Tax Compliance & Invoicing Standards: Ensure strict adherence to local tax regulations across all assigned jurisdictions (including Mexican CFDI 4.0, payment complements, and Central American e-invoicing and tax requirements).
  • Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with shared service centers, corporate finance, regional tax, and treasury teams.
  • Audit & Internal Controls: Maintain and enforce robust internal control policies across regional entities. Assist the Accounting Manager in coordinating internal and external audit deliverables for local and corporate audits.
  • Process Optimization: Actively identify opportunities to standardize and automate accounting processes across countries.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Management: Serve as a key escalation point for complex cross-border customer reconciliations, regional onboarding due diligence, and multi-country operational inquiries.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Experience: 5 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 1–2 years supervising or mentoring accounting staff within a multinational corporate environment. Experience managing or supporting Central American entities is highly preferred.
  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Technical & Tax Expertise: Deep expertise in Mexican electronic invoicing/tax regulations (CFDI 4.0) and working knowledge of Central American tax and statutory requirements. Solid proficiency in local GAAP and working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with major ERP systems. Familiarity with multi-entity financial software and tools such as Workday, Coupa, or Graphite is highly desirable. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Leadership & Analytical Skills: Strong leadership capabilities, attention to detail, and a proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage tight deadlines and multi-country priorities.

FOX Weather is looking for a creative and forward-thinking Producer, Social Strategy & Creative Content to join our Content Core team, the center of our weather newsroom and storytelling operation. This role will help power our rapidly expanding presence across digital and social platforms by turning real-time weather news and extreme weather events into highly visual, shareable, and culturally relevant content that propels our growth in the new media space. The ideal candidate combines strong news judgment, video production and editing skills, platform expertise, and creative instincts to produce content that captures attention, informs audiences, and strengthens FOX Weather’s digital presence. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom at the intersection of innovation, social media, and audience engagement, this is your opportunity to make a national impact with us.

  • Conceptualize, produce, edit, and publish short-form video, vertical video, visual graphics, and other platform-native content
  • Track down, clear, and creatively repackage viral user-generated content (UGC) to showcase real-time weather stories with speed.
  • Translate complex weather information, meteorological data, and breaking developments into clear, visually engaging content.
  • Write and produce digital stories for foxweather.com that complement social initiatives and expand cross-platform reach.
  • Monitor breaking weather news, identify compelling editorial angles, and pitch creative content for social platforms and live streams
  • Track platform analytics to optimize video performance, experiment with new video formats, and adapt to visual media algorithms
  • Collaborate with meteorologists, reporters, producers, editors, and other members of the FOX Weather team


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience
  • Experience producing multimedia content for a high-volume digital newsroom, media organization, or creator-focused environment
  • Demonstrated experience creating content for YouTube and vertical-video platforms, including TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Proficiency with video editing suites including Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar software
  • Strong news judgment, writing skills, and an understanding of what makes content timely, engaging, and shareable.

  • A strong interest in weather news, live coverage, visual storytelling, and emerging media trends
  • Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including weekends, early mornings, evenings, and during major weather events.

job.description:
Turn Your Passion for Sports into a Career

Do you live for game day? Do you follow the biggest matchups, support your favorite teams and make time for live sports all year long? Turn that passion into a rewarding career.

News 8 Now, CBS Sports and Phase 3 Digital are looking for an ambitious, consultative Sports Account Executive to help businesses connect with highly engaged fans through the live teams, events and programming they care about most. This is an opportunity to sell more than advertising—you’ll create powerful, results-focused marketing solutions built around the energy and impact of live sports.

Sell the Power of Live Sports

You’ll bring advertisers into the action across traditional television, digital and Connected TV (CTV), with opportunities spanning the NFL—the No. 1 programming on television—Big Ten football, Wisconsin Badgers athletics, Green Bay Packers coverage, the NBA and Milwaukee Bucks, the WNBA, March Madness and NCAA basketball, Major League Baseball and Milwaukee Brewers, UEFA professional soccer, WIAA sports coverage, WIAC athletics, Wisconsin Huddle, CBS Sports, PGA Tour golf and more.

Why This Role Is Exciting

At News 8 Now and Phase 3 Digital, we are transforming how local businesses connect with customers through high-impact digital advertising and Connected TV solutions. As a Sports Account Executive, you will build innovative, data-driven campaigns that combine the unmatched impact of live sports with OTT, CTV, programmatic display, streaming audio, paid social and traditional television.

You’ll be a trusted marketing partner to local businesses—helping them turn attention into action, build their brands and drive measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect, develop and grow new business relationships with local and regional advertisers.
  • Create customized, multi-platform campaigns featuring sports, CTV, OTT, streaming audio, paid social and programmatic advertising.
  • Present clear, compelling marketing strategies that align with each client’s goals, audience and budget.
  • Partner with creative, digital strategy and analytics teams to launch, optimize and report on campaigns.
  • Use campaign insights and performance data to make informed recommendations and earn long-term client partnerships.
  • Stay current on sports media, digital advertising, streaming and emerging technology trends.
  • Meet and exceed new-business and revenue goals, with uncapped commission potential.

What You’ll Bring

  • Genuine enthusiasm for sports and an understanding of the connection fans have with live events and local teams.
  • An entrepreneurial, self-motivated approach to finding opportunities and helping clients succeed.
  • Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.
  • A consultative sales mindset and the ability to translate client objectives into effective marketing solutions.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission potential.
  • Unlimited earning opportunity; top sales performers can exceed $150,000 annually.
  • Monthly cell phone allowance and mileage reimbursement.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision and life insurance benefits.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Ongoing training, professional development and meaningful career-growth opportunities.
  • A supportive, collaborative team committed to helping local businesses and communities thrive.

Ready to Build a Winning Career?

If you’re ready to combine your passion for sports with an exciting career in media and digital advertising, we want to hear from you. Join News 8 Now, CBS Sports and Phase 3 Digital—and help local businesses win with the power of live sports.

Morgan Murphy Media is a progressive and family-owned business that places our highest values on our employees, the workplace culture, and the communities we serve. This is your opportunity to combine strategic thinking with creative problem-solving while building lasting relationships in a community that values hard work and authenticity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.

  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

Twin Falls, Idaho offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Magic Valley. This vibrant community of approximately 50,000 residents combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The area is famous for the stunning Shoshone Falls, often called the "Niagara of the West," which plunges 212 feet into the Snake River Canyon—actually taller than Niagara Falls itself.

Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless recreation opportunities, from hiking and mountain biking along the canyon rim to world-class fly fishing, kayaking, and BASE jumping at the Perrine Bridge. The region's high desert climate delivers 300 days of sunshine annually, with four distinct seasons that include mild winters and warm, dry summers.

Twin Falls boasts a thriving local economy anchored by agriculture, food processing, and growing tech sectors. The downtown area features locally-owned restaurants, breweries, shops, and a vibrant farmers market. The College of Southern Idaho adds cultural and educational opportunities to the community. With affordable housing, excellent schools, and a strong sense of community, Twin Falls offers the perfect balance for professionals seeking both career growth and an outstanding lifestyle. Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with account executives and sales leadership on media plans, proposals, presentations, pipeline management, account growth, retention, and opportunities to increase advertiser investment.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, delivery, and performance; analyze KPIs including CPA, CPL, ROAS, response, conversion, reach, and frequency; and implement optimization strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness.

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

  • Strong and comprehensive understanding of linear TV, digital, and streaming/CTV media planning, buying, and optimization across integrated platforms
  • Knowledge of Direct Response advertising, performance metrics (CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates), and campaign management processes
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional client-service and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively present strategic recommendations to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capability in end-to-end campaign oversight with focus on revenue optimization and strategic partnership alignment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY


New York City is the epicenter of media, advertising, and innovation—and there's no better place to advance your career in strategic account management. From Broadway shows to rooftop bars, Central Park to Brooklyn's vibrant neighborhoods, you'll find endless ways to explore and be inspired. KIVI, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Boise, ID, is seeking a creative, motivated Part Time Producer who will craft engaging stories that connect with our community. This position offers a unique opportunity to produce content for multiple platforms and make a real impact in one of the fastest-growing markets in the nation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and organize newscasts or local programs.
  • Write story development and showcasing.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine content needs.
  • Enhance content with graphics, video, research, and station branding.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions.
  • Oversee live broadcast and up to the minute editorial decisions.
  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Post content to station's websites.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Avid local news consumer: knows daily news, events, trends and happenings on a local level
  • Strong vision and ability to advance stories
  • Excellent interpersonal communicator
  • Extraordinarily passionate about writing; courageous and creative storyteller with attention to even tiny details - choosing the perfect words, grammar, spelling
  • Highly organized
  • Highly adaptable - fast paced, deadline driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life in one of America's most dynamic and fastest-growing cities. Nestled in the Treasure Valley along the Boise River and backed by the stunning Boise Foothills, this vibrant capital city perfectly balances urban sophistication with outdoor adventure. Downtown Boise features a thriving food and craft brewery scene, local boutiques, and a walkable city center, while the famous Boise Greenbelt provides 25 miles of scenic pathways for biking, running, and recreation.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless opportunities year-round, from world-class skiing at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown to hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in the nearby foothills. The Boise River offers excellent fishing, rafting, and kayaking, while multiple nearby reservoirs provide boating and water sports. The city's growing economy, strong sense of community, affordable cost of living compared to other Western cities, and family-friendly atmosphere have made Boise one of the most desirable places to live in the United States. Whether you're catching a Boise State Broncos game, exploring the vibrant arts district, or hitting the trails after work, Boise offers an exceptional lifestyle that's hard to match.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV
job.description:
KTNV, the ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, NV, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is looking for a creative and driven Multimedia Journalist.


The Multimedia Journalist is responsible for researching, writing, capturing visual content, and editing stories for multiple platforms. You would be joining a strong team of talented journalists with exceptional leadership. This position is ideal for an MMJ with some experience who wants to grow and excel in a dynamic, competitive market. Bring your dedication to solid journalism and your motivation to uncover stories that matter to our community and make viewers want to watch.


Las Vegas is one of the most exciting and fast-growing cities in the country, known for its world-class entertainment, thriving sports scene, diverse communities, and vibrant economy. From major events and tourism to significant local stories that impact Southern Nevada residents every day, Las Vegas offers journalists a unique opportunity to cover meaningful and memorable news. Join a team that's making a difference.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write stories according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live and pre-recorded stories.
  • Work cooperatively with the photographer assigned to the story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producers in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist digital staff in preparing multimedia stories and online content.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems.
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment.
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills.
  • Proficient at posting content to various digital and social media platforms.
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits.

job.title: Master Control Hub Operator
job.description:
Are you ready to be at the heart of television broadcasting? The Scripps Master Control Hub in Indianapolis is seeking a skilled Master Control Hub Operator to manage and monitor multiple programming sources while providing critical master control support. In this essential role, you'll be the technical expert ensuring seamless programming delivery across our television stations, making split-second decisions that keep our content flowing flawlessly to viewers across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Monitor several programming sources simultaneously, manage and switch sources for local television station programming, remotely from the Hub.

  • Monitor various levels and signals from multiple television sites.

  • Manage several live program logs and ensure accuracy.

  • Ensure the correct spots are aired during programming and note any discrepancies.

  • Solve problems and make judgment calls with business implications in mind regarding programming changes, commercials, special reports, and technical difficulties; this includes evaluating clock/timing to consider options with regard to programming as well as deciding when to escalate issues.

  • Make decisions and consult with internal customers regarding local transmitter parameters and operation.

  • Routinely collaborate with media prep technicians and traffic personnel to manage daily operations. Collaborate with other local news personnel as needed during breaking news situations.

  • Interact both verbally and in writing with internal Hub client stations in a manner that ensures all of our internal customers have a consistent experience. This includes sending alerts, responses to inquiries, collaboration on problem-solving, documentation, and/or resolution of issues.

  • Work with networks and live program providers, where required, to problem-solve issues.

  • Maintain current knowledge of and preparedness to execute disaster recovery procedures.

  • Perform quality assurance checks as required.

  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in a related field is preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Ability to problem solve and quickly take corrective action as necessary

  • High sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Composure: Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast, deadline-driven environment, and maintain calmness and accuracy of work

  • Strong organization skills

  • Highly detail-oriented

  • Quick mathematical skills, especially concerning timekeeping

  • Working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment

  • Working knowledge of transmitter parameters and operations

  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written

  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television master control

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:
 

Indianapolis is a thriving Midwestern city that offers the perfect blend of urban amenities and hometown hospitality. Known as the "Crossroads of America," Indianapolis boasts a revitalized downtown featuring world-class museums like the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway, and a vibrant Mass Ave cultural district filled with theaters, galleries, and locally-owned restaurants. The city's Canal Walk provides a scenic escape in the heart of downtown, while neighborhoods like Broad

Ripple and Fountain Square offer eclectic shopping, live music venues, and craft breweries.

Sports enthusiasts will love cheering on the Colts at Lucas Oil Stadium and the Pacers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, while the city's extensive greenway system and Eagle Creek Park offer abundant outdoor recreation opportunities. Indianapolis combines big-city career opportunities with an affordable cost of living, no traffic nightmares, and genuine Hoosier hospitality. With a growing tech sector, excellent healthcare systems, and a thriving food scene that goes far beyond racing day traditions, Indianapolis offers an exceptional quality of life where you can truly make an impact in your community.

job.description:

  • Experience blending graphics with natural sound and video for enhanced storytelling.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Regional Sales Assistant
job.description:
WBFF/WNUV has an exciting opportunity for a Regional National Sales Assistant. If you would like to work in the exciting business of television sales, this could be the job for you!

Responsibilities include:

  • Primary function is data entry of national sales orders from national advertisers
  • Daily entry of National Sales orders into the traffic system with accuracy and complying to order contract, inventory, and scheduling constraints.
  • Daily maintenance and research on national sales orders to troubleshoot and resolve order-related issues and discrepancies
  • Regular communication and collaboration with both internal and external contacts to ensure campaign success.
  • Develop a strong understanding and adherence to the National sales process and nuances, systems, and SOPs
  • Consistent independent prioritizing and organizing of workload with a sense of urgency and balance.
  • Completion of assigned tasks within the given deadline.
  • Regular generation, manipulation, and maintenance of reports both from internal systems and Excel spreadsheets.
  • Daily use of Windows PC including Office programs such as Outlook, Teams, Excel, and Word.

  • Other duties as assigned

     

Skills and Qualifications:

  • At least 1-2 years’ experience of administrative support preferred
  • A high level of organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and multi-task
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple tasks under a deadline
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Consistently comply with organizational directives and national standard operating procedures.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for effective interaction with internal and external team members
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
  • Broadcast Sales, media buying, or agency experience is a plus
  • Maintain a positive demeanor and customer service focus

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

The base hourly compensation range for this role is $18.00 to $19.23 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: News Assignment Editor and Producer-Temp
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented Assignment Editor/Producer to support the News team. This position is responsible for monitoring breaking news, developing story ideas, coordinating field coverage, and managing the logistics of live crews and daily news assignments.

The Assignment Editor/Producer works closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom managers to identify and prioritize stories, gather information and video elements, and ensure timely and accurate coverage of developing and scheduled news events.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Monitor local, national, and international news for developing and breaking news stories.
  • Research, develop, and pitch daily story ideas for news broadcasts.
  • Assign stories and provide reporters and field crews with the necessary information and resources.
  • Coordinate interviews, live shots, and field coverage for breaking news and planned events.
  • Maintain constant communication with reporters, producers, photographers, field crews, and external news agencies.
  • Verify information from multiple sources and assist in gathering video, feeds, and other elements needed for coverage.
  • Monitor social media and other digital platforms for potential news stories and breaking developments.
  • Work with reporters and producers to develop story concepts and coordinate the execution of news packages.
  • Assist with troubleshooting video feeds and other field-production needs.
  • Collaborate with other Assignment Editors and newsroom managers to prioritize coverage and allocate resources.
  • Support special news coverage and live programming as needed.

YOU HAVE

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working in an Assignment Desk, newsroom, or similar news environment.
  • Strong knowledge of current events, local news, and breaking news coverage.
  • Proven experience sourcing and sharing news content through social media and digital platforms.
  • Strong communication, organization, and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Fluency in Spanish, including reading and writing.
  • Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, and sit for extended periods, up to 8 hours.
              

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Manager, Payments
job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision es la compañía líder de medios en español a nivel mundial! Estamos invirtiendo en nuestro contenido, nuestra gente y nuestras plataformas digitales, de streaming, sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos impulsando el crecimiento de nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, ofrecer experiencias de pago confiables y sin fricciones es fundamental para respaldar nuestro negocio de suscripciones y la experiencia de nuestros usuarios.

 

El equipo de ViX está buscando un Gerente de Pagos responsable de gestionar las relaciones con proveedores de pago, monitorear el desempeño de pagos y apoyar la optimización continua de nuestro ecosistema de pagos digitales.

 

Esta posición trabajará de manera cercana con los equipos de Producto, Customer Care, Finanzas/Administración, Legal y otras áreas para apoyar integraciones de pago, prevención de fraude, optimización de flujos transaccionales y las operaciones diarias relacionadas con pagos. El Gerente de Pagos monitoreará indicadores clave de desempeño, identificará problemas y oportunidades, y trabajará con equipos internos y socios externos para incrementar las tasas de aprobación y reducir la fricción en la experiencia del usuario.

 

TU DÍA A DÍA: (Responsabilidades)

·      Gestionar y mantener relaciones sólidas con proveedores de servicios de pago, adquirentes, procesadores y otros socios de pago.

·      Monitorear el desempeño de pagos, incluyendo tasas de aprobación, disponibilidad, fraude, costos, contracargos y otros KPIs relevantes.

·      Identificar proactivamente problemas y oportunidades relacionados con el desempeño de pagos y coordinar las acciones correctivas correspondientes.

·      Escalar y resolver incidencias operativas con proveedores de pago, minimizando el impacto para los usuarios y el negocio.

·      Participar en la evaluación de nuevos proveedores, tecnologías y soluciones de pago de acuerdo con las necesidades del negocio.

·      Supervisar disputas y contracargos, coordinando con proveedores de pago y equipos internos para minimizar su impacto.

·      Preparar y presentar reportes periódicos sobre el desempeño de pagos e información relevante a stakeholders internos.

·      Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producto y Tecnología para apoyar integraciones e iniciativas de pago.

·      Revisar las reglas de prevención de fraude junto con Producto y realizar los ajustes correspondientes cuando sea necesario.

·      Apoyar la optimización continua de los flujos transaccionales, incluyendo checkout, reintentos de pago y enrutamiento de transacciones, para maximizar las tasas de aprobación y minimizar la fricción para el usuario.

·      Colaborar con Customer Care, Finanzas/Administración, Legal y otras áreas para apoyar los requerimientos operativos relacionados con pagos.

·      Asegurar que los contratos con proveedores de pago y las certificaciones regulatorias aplicables se mantengan actualizados.

·      Identificar oportunidades para mejorar procesos, herramientas y flujos operativos relacionados con pagos.

·      Desarrollar y apoyar iniciativas enfocadas en incrementar las tasas de aprobación y mejorar la experiencia de pago del usuario.

·      Mantener actualizada la documentación de los principales procesos y procedimientos relacionados con pagos.

 

TÚ TIENES: (Habilidades, Calificaciones y Experiencia Requeridas)

·      Más de 8 años de experiencia en pagos, fintech, e-commerce, medios digitales, streaming o áreas relacionadas, idealmente incluyendo al menos 2 años en posiciones de liderazgo.

·      Experiencia comprobada gestionando relaciones con proveedores de servicios de pago (PSPs), adquirentes y procesadores.

·      Experiencia trabajando estrechamente con equipos de Producto y Tecnología en integraciones de pago e iniciativas de prevención de fraude.

·      Sólido conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos digitales, incluyendo tarjetas, métodos alternativos de pago, wallets digitales y métodos de pago locales en Latinoamérica.

·      Conocimiento sólido de métricas clave de pagos, incluyendo tasa de aprobación, tasa de contracargos, tasa de fraude y costo por transacción.

·      Fuertes habilidades analíticas y capacidad para interpretar datos, identificar tendencias y problemas, y traducir los hallazgos en acciones concretas.

·      Fuertes habilidades de negociación y gestión de relaciones con terceros.

·      Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para presentar resultados y recomendaciones a diferentes niveles de la organización.

·      Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, asumir responsabilidad y adaptarse rápidamente a procesos y sistemas existentes.

·      Experiencia en streaming, servicios de suscripción o modelos de pagos recurrentes es deseable.

·      Inglés avanzado requerido.

 

REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

·      Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México.

·      Se verificará la experiencia laboral y educación.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Camera Operator, Jib
job.description:
Production Operations at Televisa Univision is looking for a Camera Operator, Jib to join our team!


Responsible for the building, operations and general maintenance of the Jib Cameras. Operator must provide creative, fluid movement of the camera on multi-camera productions for News, Sports and Entertainment studio shows. The Camera Operator, Jib will report to the Production Manager.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Create smooth fluid movements of the camera to enhance the production value of each program. Must be able to pan and tilt camera as well as swing the crane through spaces.
  • Maintain stable framing without extraneous movement on all axis.
  • Setup, balance, troubleshoot, and maintain crane and associated equipment.
  • Operator controls zoom and focus of lens. Good sense of visual composition.
  • Take direction well and work as a team player.
  • Operate in a safe and controlled manner to minimize injury to self or others as well as any damage to equipment or property.
  • Ability to follow a rundown.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree in television production or equivalent work experience.
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with Windows operating systems.
  • 3-5 years of experience in control room broadcast facility.
  • Physical ability to swing and stop camera boom of up to 40 feet while carrying a camera load of up to 50 pounds as well as the crane itself and the associated counterweights.
  • Perform well under pressure and breaking news situations.
  • Agility to move at a rapid pace as production needs may require.
  • Provide creative input, e.g., assists the Director/ Producer in creating the look of a show, including set design; suggests alternate shots; etc.
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish) preferred.
  • As this position supports 24x7 operation, candidate must, in addition to being able to work regular hours, have on-call availability, and flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed and without advance notice.  Additionally, candidate may be required to work on site for extended periods of time to provide coverage in special circumstances, such as, during tropical storm/hurricane.

OUR BENEFITS:

TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Role and What You’ll Do:

TKO Global Partnerships is looking for a driven, relationship-first sales executive to join one of the most dynamic commercial teams in sports and entertainment. As a Director of Sales, you will own new business development across UFC and/or WWE — two of the most recognized and emotionally powerful properties on the planet — delivering partnership and sponsorship solutions that create genuine value for brands, their agencies, and their customers.

This is a role for a closer who thrives in a consultative environment, builds trust quickly at the executive level, and knows how to turn a first conversation into a multi-year, seven-figure partnership. You will be on the front lines of revenue generation for TKO, prospecting aggressively, presenting compellingly, and delivering results that consistently exceed targets.

  • Explore creative packaging and upsell opportunities, including co-sell structures with TKO's media distribution partners
  • Accurately forecast revenue, proactively identify risks, and bring solutions — not just problems

You Have These:

  • Proven track record closing six- and seven-figure deals with Fortune 500 brands and/or senior agency decision makers
  • Deep understanding of the sports sponsorship and media landscape — the players, the trends, the terminology, and the deals that matter
  • A hunter's mentality paired with a relationship-builder's instincts — you're equally comfortable cold-opening a C-suite conversation and deepening a decade-long partnership

  • Champion best practices and strategic thinking in the design and delivery of systems and platforms, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and aligned with a Guest and Crew experience culture.

Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Program Management, and Business leaders to ensure technology solutions are architecturally sound, practical to implement, and aligned with long-term strategic goals. Lead architecture reviews, technology assessments, proof-of-concept initiatives, and modernization efforts to continuously improve platform capabilities, engineering effectiveness, and operational performance.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with vendors and third-party technology providers, ensuring solutions meet Disney standards for quality, security, performance, reliability, and integration.
  • Continuously assess emerging technologies and evolving industry trends to influence strategic direction, improve engineering capabilities, and identify opportunities for business growth and innovation.
  • Oversee financial planning and portfolio budgeting processes, ensuring fiscal accuracy, strategic alignment, and reliable forecasting across product and technology investments.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • 2+ Years of Experience of People Management, leading software engineers, architects, technical leads, vendors, and cross-functional technology partners.
  • Strong technical expertise across modern cloud platforms, distributed systems, integration patterns, enterprise applications, web and mobile technologies, and modern software development frameworks.
  • Proven ability to establish and implement architectural standards that enable scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
  • Experience delivering products and platforms utilizing Agile, DevOps, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, strategic planning, and organizational leadership capabilities.
  • Proven ability to lead in highly matrixed environments, influence without authority, and align technology strategy with business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience supporting travel, hospitality, cruise, commerce, reservation, fulfillment, or Guest experience platforms.
  • Experience leading large-scale digital transformation and platform modernization efforts.
  • Expertise in cloud-native architectures and platforms including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

job.description:
Department Description

Disney isn't just another job; it's a career. We are a global leader in entertainment and experiences, committed to delivering exceptional Guest and Cast experiences through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. As a Senior Product Manager at Disney, you can combine your passion for technology and Guest experience to create compelling and delightful experiences for our valued Guests and Cast. 


Team Description:

The Senior Product Manager – Point of Sale Platform is a senior individual contributor role on the Retail and Restaurant Technology team, responsible for owning and delivering large, multi-quarter product initiatives for Disney's Point of Sale (POS) platform across Retail and Food & Beverage businesses — including POS modernization, international deployments, and enterprise platform replacement programs. Working in close collaboration with key stakeholders and partners, this role develops an understanding of business and technical capabilities, identifies gaps, and executes product roadmaps for assigned initiative threads. 


A successful candidate is highly collaborative, works effectively in a matrixed organization while wearing multiple hats, is comfortable working autonomously on complex programs, and is adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple products and applications. Serving as a product leader for assigned large programs, the Senior PM acts as a liaison to development, implementation, and support teams, and drives enhancements, backlog ownership, and the prioritization of features and capabilities. This role brings a working understanding of how POS systems connect to the broader technology ecosystem — including supply chain, mobile platforms, data warehousing, and payments — and ensures cross-system dependencies are surfaced, understood, and reflected in product decisions. 


What You’ll Do:


Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Owns product direction and execution for assigned large POS initiatives, contributing to the development of product strategy and feature vision that enhances Guest and Cast experiences across Retail and Food & Beverage programs. 
  • Develops and maintains a prioritized, outcomes-driven product roadmap for assigned initiative threads, prioritizing initiatives relative to business needs and aligning to strategic and tactical business objectives. 
  • Works with the business to determine the real issue that needs to be solved or the opportunity to do things differently, translating ambiguous needs into clear, actionable product direction. 
  • Supports business cases and business, technical, and financial feasibility assessments to ensure benefits align to enterprise priorities. 
  • Identifies product improvement opportunities by staying involved in initiative delivery and stakeholder feedback, and recommends process and technology improvements that increase product effectiveness. 
  • Provides advice and recommendations on emerging trends and technologies useful to both the business and Technology in the delivery of POS initiatives. 

POS Domain Expertise & Industry Knowledge 

  • Develops subject matter expertise in Point of Sale, with knowledge spanning hardware (terminals, handhelds, kiosks, peripherals), software, payment processing, menu/catalog management, reporting, and offline resilience across both retail and restaurant environments. 
  • Understands the distinct requirements of retail POS (item lookup, inventory integration, returns, loyalty, associate-facing workflows) versus restaurant POS (order sequencing, kitchen display systems, modifier management, table management, and speed of service). 
  • Applies operational knowledge of Food & Beverage and Merchandise environments — including Quick Service, Table Service, kiosk, grab-and-go, and specialty retail — to inform product decisions. 
  • Stays current on the broader POS industry, including leading vendors (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Toast, Lightspeed, Square, Stripe) and emerging trends in unified commerce, mobile payment, and AI-enabled ordering, and applies relevant insights to Disney's platform direction. 

Feature Definition & Product Lifecycle Execution 

  • Owns and manages key phases of the product lifecycle — including requirements gathering, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking — from problem definition through feature delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement. 
  • Leads the creation of technical specifications and user stories to enable system modification or development, refined to a sufficient level of detail to allow Architects and Software Engineers to design, develop, and implement appropriate solutions. 
  • Defines and refines product features by synthesizing inputs from end users (e.g., surveys, analytics), business stakeholders (e.g., pricing, marketing), and industry trends. 
  • Combines business requirements into a prioritized backlog grouped into project iterations, and manages the scope and traceability of requirements throughout the project lifecycle. 
  • Reviews and signs off on solution designs, ensuring business requirements are verified, validated, and delivered, and participates in functional design, construction, and testing. 
  • Establishes performance metrics and KPIs to evaluate feature effectiveness, draws inferences, and drives iterative enhancements and prioritization decisions. 
  • Drives Agile standups, backlog grooming, and planning, and ensures required outcomes are built, tested, communicated, and delivered on time and within budget. 

Cross-System Dependencies & Platform Integrations 

  • Maintains a working understanding of the systems the POS platform depends on and integrates with — including supply chain and inventory, loyalty and guest identity, mobile ordering and payments, kitchen display and production systems, and data warehousing and analytics. 
  • Identifies and surfaces cross-system dependencies early in the product lifecycle, ensuring feature design accounts for integration complexity, data contracts, and downstream impacts before Engineering begins solution design. 
  • Partners with product teams and architects across adjacent platforms to align on integration standards, API contracts, and shared data definitions. 
  • Manages project interdependencies in support of business strategies, roadmaps, and financial commitments, and assists in identifying and managing risks, issues, and dependencies. 

AI, Data & Workflow Enablement 

  • Applies AI-enabled tools and data insights to improve product and operational team workflows, planning efficiency, and decision quality across POS capabilities. 
  • Identifies opportunities to apply automation and analytics to reduce manual effort in Cast and operational workflows and improve speed to value. 
  • Leads or supports proof-of-concepts (POCs) that align with the product vision to validate technical viability and business assumptions. 
  • Partners with Technology and Data teams to ensure responsible, secure, and effective integration of AI capabilities into the POS platform and product development processes. 

Collaboration, Communication & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Collaborates with fellow Product Managers and cross-functional teams, contributing to team effectiveness by sharing product management best practices and lessons learned. 
  • Develops and maintains relationships with business, vendor, and technology stakeholders, and manages engagement, expectations, scope, and budget discussions for large or complex initiatives. 
  • Provides thought leadership and asserts influence by driving complex projects to completion effectively and efficiently, escalating issues and recommending appropriate solutions. 
  • Communicates effectively through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates across various levels of the organization, providing updates to leadership as needed. 
  • Supports go-to-market efforts in coordination with marketing, content, training, consumer insights, and operations, and participates in change control processes to ensure alignment with business and technology expectations. 

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

  • 5+ years (3+ years with a Master's degree) of product management or equivalent experience driving product strategy and execution, ideally in digital or technology roles within the retail or hospitality industry. 
  • Strong technical product knowledge in the Point of Sale space, with functional understanding of retail and restaurant POS environments, payment processing, and reporting. 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, understand, and drive resolution of complex, critical issues, and to think strategically and drive ideas into action with a positive outlook and willingness to take personal initiative. 
  • Understanding of Agile technical practices, DevOps, and testing concepts (CI/CD, TDD), and strong command of agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar). 
  • Basic knowledge of public cloud technologies (e.g., AWS) and an understanding of the nuances of data pipeline issues and solutions. 
  • Experience working in a collaborative, matrixed environment with cross-functional Technology teams and operational departments. 
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex or diverse project data and information and articulate a compelling vision for complex and seemingly disparate concepts. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience with Disney theme park or resort operations, or equivalent large-scale, multi-site hospitality or retail operations. 
  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise POS platforms (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Toast, Lightspeed, NCR, or equivalent) in a retail or restaurant context. 
  • Experience delivering enterprise POS platforms across multi-location environments with high transaction volume and complex operational requirements. 
  • Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation to platform capabilities or operational workflows to improve Guest or Cast outcomes. 
  • Familiarity with various funding models and driving products through the stages of the product funding lifecycle. 

Required Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.
