**This position must sit onsite in our Woodlands, TX technology office**


**Please note the hours on this position are Monday-Friday, 3PM-12AM**


Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology


Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.


The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. 


Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

1. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

2. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 

3. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.


Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.


Job Summary:


Disney Media Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency.


Disney Media Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware and software based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more.


The Lead Media Systems Engineer is an expert engineer in several disciplines related to the acquisition, production, or distribution of media content. They are well-versed in multiple technical standards and have hands-on experience in both the sustainment and design/build of production systems.

The Lead Media Systems Engineer is part of a tiered sustainment model where incidents are escalated from a shared Operations team (tier 1) to the Media Engineer I’s, II’s and Sr. Media Engineer (tier 2), Lead Media Engineer (tier 3) and beyond. They are the heart of the sustainment efforts in the technology they lead. The Lead Media Engineer will interface with both external and internal partners to ensure their technical areas are operating with peak efficiency and reliability. Lead Media Engineers are also focused heavily on the design/build of their areas of expertise, often advancing innovative technology to maintain Disney’s competitive technical edge. Lead Media Engineers perform beyond the technical to truly understand the businesses that benefit from our technology and make decisions and recommendations based on the complete business, operational and technical outlook, and requirements.


Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

  • Respond to and resolve issues that affect acquisition, production, and content distribution across multiple DEE networks including system outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems, and conduct diagnostic testing, repair, and replacement activities necessary to solve routine, specialized, and complex problems.
  • Utilize system health and performance monitoring software and platforms; troubleshoot and participate in repairing system problems and failures, participates in maintenance of systems, installs software patches, updates etc., to resolve and avoid service problems, and troubleshoots system problems as they relate to these services.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot streaming audio/video signals in traditional SDI and IP 2110 essence flow routing environments.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot cloud platforms as necessary
  • Support third-party service providers by enforcing the agreed upon scope of services within the various signed service agreements (i.e., full time, freelance, union agencies, maintenance providers, contractors, service providers, etc.).
  • Select, train, motivate and evaluate technical staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline procedures.
  • Support the procurement of equipment, supplies and materials for Media technology systems within budget guidelines; receive and maintain equipment and supplies.
  • Support long range planning for future media technology needs, including capital improvements, to enhance production and distribution capabilities.
  • Lead the development and implementation of policies and procedures regarding technology facilities with a focus on maximizing the integration of all systems to meet business, marketing, and entertainment goals.
  • Lead operational support of all activities related to operating, maintaining, and programming the audio and video production/distribution systems across the enterprise and other connected properties. When required perform preventative maintenance on all broadcast systems and equipment, such as distribution systems, switchers, consoles, playout servers, cameras, robotics, electromechanical equipment, automation systems and radio facilities to ensure optimum broadcast performance.
  • Participates in engineering projects at the direction of more experienced engineers.
  • Reviews and contributes to system/workflow documentation.
  • Participates in regular training and development objectives.
  • Extraordinary influencer who is skilled at connecting the dots at the organization, strategy, program, project, and event levels.  Able to persuade and change the thinking of others without damaging relationships.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth environment with minimal direction, delivering under tight deadlines while multitasking, prioritizing projects, and communicating priority updates to team members.
  • Able to operate with limited resources, exhibit objective critical-thinking, and creatively solve problems. Motivated and inventive, always finds a way forward—eternal optimist with a committed drive for contributing and making a difference.
  • Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7 + years of previous and relevant experience in leading others, developing technical strategies ensuring efficient sustainment, uptime, and overall stability of the technical environments of Media Engineering and live media production and distribution environments.
  • Expert level knowledge and experience with integrating, implementing, or refreshing broadcast control room equipment, including familiarity with modern broadcast cabling infrastructure used in broadcast environments.
  • Proficient with technologies like microservices, DevOps tools, design principles, practices, standards and guidelines
  • Scripting proficiency will be an advantage (Python, NodeJS, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Proficient in SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments with a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022-7, SCTE-104, etc.
  • Advanced level knowledge and experience with on-prem and cloud-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. At least one foundational cloud certification required, including but not limited to Microsoft Certified: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA Cloud+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
  • Advanced level knowledge and experience with compression techniques such as MPEG2/4, HEVC, JPEG 2000, and JPEG XS
  • Expert level knowledge and experience with Evertz software control systems such as frame control via VistaLink or Magnum, EQX/EXE routers, and their monitoring software VLPRO, SDVN, VIP, VUE, MVP.
  • Advanced level knowledge and experience with major media systems and the vendors that supply them in areas such as asset management systems, file-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies.
  • Expert level knowledge and experience with Nielsen (NACAT), VANC equipment, Linear Acoustics, and other related systems.
  • Expert level knowledge and experience with coordinated receiver decoders IRDs, core devices, edge devices, timing of video and audio systems, audio and video media file formats are a plus.
  • Ability to create, read and interpret AutoCAD and other technical drawing/documentation tools.
  • Demonstrated expert troubleshooting and sustaining in one or more of the following:
    • IP-based broadcast equipment including routers, switchers, audio boards, signal processers, encoder/decoder, video scalers, playback systems, etc.
    • Studio technology includes video walls, cameras, VR set technology, image processing systems, touch screens, lighting, etc.
    • File-based workflows like enterprise Media Asset Management systems (Cloud-based Cloud Compute or Local Network-based) including storage, compute, encode and distribution.
    • Production control systems such as Imagine Communications or Grass Valley automation systems, Avid, Adobe, Viz, Dalet, Riedel trunking, Lawo, Calrec, Evertz, Ross and others.
    • Transmission systems such as RF (Radio Frequency), Satellite Distribution, Fiber Distribution, etc.
    • Proven track record for troubleshooting and sustainment knowledge of AWS Infrastructures and other cloud-based technologies including S3/Glacier storage and cloud compute (EC2) services.
  • Physical requirements and work environment: Ability to climb ladders, work on raised structures and building roofs, operate areal lift platforms and have valid driver’s license.

Required Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience

Gather, write, and edit news material and assemble show rundowns. This includes generating story ideas, writing and/or producing packages for air.  Work closely with News Managers, Assignment Desk, news reporters and other newsroom employees on story conception and development and execution of story. 

Participate in editorial meetings, contributing ideas and discussing show content. Producers will also be assigned to produce or oversee special projects, productions, or live coverage of station-sponsored events. 
  

Ability to operate various broadcast production equipment and other communication equipment (intercom systems, microphones, newsroom computer system, video screening computers, cellular telephones, laptop computers or tablet devices, etc.)

The producer must be able to write news copy clearly, in broadcast style, for on-air, online, and other digital platforms. Ability to contribute ideas on a daily basis and to recognize what types of stories would make for interesting and compelling television. The ability to adapt to a fast paced quickly changing environment and to react in live situations to cover breaking news, etc. Ability to establish and maintain harmonious relationships with piers and superiors and to develop contacts outside the building to aid in 
newsgathering.

job.title: Acquisition Marketing Manager
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.

Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Acquisition Marketing Manager to own acquisition marketing operations across FOX One’s paid and owned & operated channels. This role will serve as the central point of organization and communication across campaigns and placements, ensuring creative, timelines, approvals, and execution remain aligned back to the FOX One strategy.

You will manage the day-to-day workflow with our agency partner, keeping paid acquisition campaigns on track from creative specifications through launch. You will also own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements, partnering closely with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi. Across these efforts, you will ensure messaging, assets, and placements are coordinated and consistent while serving as a key resource for campaign status, troubleshooting, and execution.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support media plan development and execution across paid and owned & operated channels to drive subscriber acquisition, keeping multiple concurrent campaigns, creative assets, placements, and deadlines organized and on track
  • Manage the relationship and daily workflow with our outside agency, as well as other vendors and platforms, coordinating campaign specifications, creative assets, timelines, approvals, and deliverables
  • Own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements in partnership with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi
  • Partner with the brand and creative team to request, approve, and traffic assets, and steward creative alignment strategy across campaigns to ensure the right message reaches the right placement and audience
  • Coordinate with agencies, platforms, and vendors on campaign execution and optimization, and serve as a central point of contact providing clear status updates and proactively identifying and resolving execution issues
  • Build and maintain processes and tracking systems, including campaign documentation and trackers, that create visibility across campaigns, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines
  • Conduct competitive and audience research to inform campaign strategy
  • Partner closely with business units and creative teams to ensure assets meet campaign requirements and are delivered on schedule
  • Proactively flag risks, troubleshoot issues, and hold internal and external partners accountable to campaign timelines

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 7+ years of experience in media, ad operations, marketing, or a related area, with demonstrated ownership of campaign strategy or asset creative processes
  • Demonstrated experience stewarding creative alignment, ensuring messaging and assets are seamlessly tailored to and optimized for the right placements and audience touchpoints
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, deliverables, and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail
  • Impeccable organizational skills and the ability to build and maintain processes that keep creative and campaigns aligned across teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across internal business units, creative teams, and external agency partners
  • Ability to proactively identify and communicate issues, troubleshoot campaign execution challenges, and hold partners accountable to deadlines
  • Occasional flexibility to work evenings and weekends in support of live programming, breaking news, launches, and marquee events.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience working in paid social, CTV, or programmatic campaigns
  • Familiarity with Excel, Airtable, and Figma for campaign tracking, reporting, and workflow management
  • Experience working within a lean team or marketing organization and successfully managing responsibilities across multiple areas

You'll work closely with the Production Manager, bringing projects and productions to life for the creative team from initial concept through to completion, helping ensure budget, schedule, and creative requirements are met while delivering on creative excellence. Your work will range from booking voiceovers to supporting high-profile campaigns, so strong multi-tasking skills will serve you well. What you will be doing?

Finance:

  • You'll liaise with the creative team to maintain accurate budgets for each project.

Department:

  • You'll maintain departmental edit schedules and calendars.

  • You'll monitor and help ensure all promos and designs are delivered as requested.

Administrative and Organizational Skills:

  • Strong administration and organizational abilities.

  • Experience in shoot preparation and admin tasks.

  • Ability to build project schedules and maintain departmental edit schedules.

Financial Management:

Legal and Compliance:

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

CBS News is looking for a Senior Digital Producer. The ideal candidate is a skilled writer and content creator comfortable developing and editing videos for YouTube and other platforms, creating original, repeatable concepts, maintaining content calendars and drafting news alerts.   This is a creative, hands-on role for someone who can take an idea from concept to finished product—developing the story, writing the script, shooting/packaging the content and editing the final video. The ideal candidate can manage multiple projects and deadlines while also pivoting to respond to breaking news when needed. This position is covered by the WGA East and is onsite Monday through Friday 10 am - 6 pm ET.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Creates and publishes original videos – news-of-day videos, long-form thematic content, marathons, archive content and short-form slips, and other content as requested. 
  • Clips and publishes video segments, writes SEO-friendly and compelling headlines/descriptions, chooses and crops thumbnails.  
  • Ensures all necessary video content gets uploaded to CBSNews.com, YouTube and Paramount+ (& other partners) and follows guidelines by Rights & Clearance, Standards and Law; helps facilitate fixes, replacements and other changes as required. 
  • Publishes original video content, including thematic episodes and marathons, made for CBSNews.com and YouTube and maintains a content calendar with future ideas – ensures all original content is cleared by the show(s), Rights & Clearances and any other necessary parties.  
  • Maintains, curates and updates assigned CBS News brand YouTube channels. 
  • Requests and sets up YouTube live streams as needed, managing slates and OTT presence.
  • Coordinate with talent, correspondents and producers, etc. on booking, shooting and producing longform content that can be repurposed for YouTube (such as podcast shoots, on-set shoots, etc.).
  • Draft and send breaking news and segmented push alerts across platforms, including app, desktop, OTT, email, text and instant messages and for partner platforms. 
  • Helps coordinate detailed rollout plans across departments for specials, documentaries and other major news events, creating and executing a promotional plan (crafting push copy, prewriting articles and video heds/deks, etc.).  
  • Helps maintain a content calendar and contributes to planning meetings, working with the SEO team on coverage plans as needed.

  • 5+ years of experience producing content in a fast-paced digital media environment.

  • Strong interest in breaking news and current events, with an eye for compelling stories and trends.

Job Title

Director, Executive Compensation

Job Description

The Director, Executive Compensation serves as the leader and subject matter expert for the company’s equity and executive compensation programs. This hands-on role is responsible for administering and optimizing the equity compensation program at People Incorporated and ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.  Reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, this role interacts with Finance, Legal, and HR. The ideal candidate will balance technical excellence in equity governance with the executive presence required to design, communicate, and execute competitive reward strategies across the company.

The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.

Equity Program Administration

  • Manage and process the full lifecycle of global equity awards: grant setup, vesting, releases, cancellations, terminations/retirement, and quarterly dividends across multiple jurisdictions and equity structures.

  • Manage and optimize the employee equity database. Maintain flawless data integrity, update employee records, and generate routine and ad-hoc reports.

  • Act as a trusted, accessible stock plan expert to all levels of the organization, including executives and board members, providing support and addressing inquiries with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness.

  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance regarding equity vests and reporting. Provide guidance to HRBPs and Subsidiary companies as needed. 

  • Review, interpret, and optimize stock plan data. Track and report on critical equity metrics including share utilization, burn rate, overhang, and dilution to inform long-term budgeting and forecasting. Prepare projections and provide recommendations on budgets.

  • Exercise sound judgment to resolve complex stock plan participant matters and address evolving stock plan provisions, balancing business needs and employee experience considerations.

  • Proactively educate employees on their equity plans and grants. Prepare and review stock plan participant communications, statements, and educational materials, ensuring clarity and comprehension across diverse participant groups.

  • Own the strategic relationship and service level agreements (SLAs) with external stock plan administrators (e.g., Morgan Stanley), ensuring seamless platform optimization and flawless database data integrity.

  • Act as the technical advisor on the equity and compensation implications of corporate restructurings, subsidiary management, and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).

  • Oversee equity plan compliance, monitoring insider trading policies, managing pre-clearance lists, and enforcing corporate blackout periods in partnership with Legal.

Executive Compensation, Proxy & Governance

  • Partner directly with the VP of Total Rewards to strategize, draft, and deliver high-impact, Board-level materials and data visualizations for the quarterly Compensation Committee meetings.

  • Contribute to executive compensation-related regulatory filings and disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion & Analysis (CD&A) and related proxy statement content.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving investor expectations and proxy advisor perspectives, regulatory developments, firm strategy and market practices and translate these into practical implications for Total Rewards program design and disclosure.

  • Lead executive benchmarking, peer group selection, and competitive pay analysis for senior leadership.

  • Ensure regulatory compliance for Section 16 executive and Board members and assist in the preparation of SEC Form filings.

General Compensation & Projects

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management by providing strategic guidance and execution support for Total Rewards programs, especially compensation programs impacting senior leadership.

  • Serve as a trusted partner to HR and  Finance with Compensation initiatives throughout the year.

  • Support the Compensation team by collaborating on Compensation philosophy and with the year-end compensation cycle.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CCP certification is a plus.

Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in compensation in a publicly traded, mid-to-large-sized company with specific experience in hands-on equity administration including stock options, restricted stock, and performance-based stock awards.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on detail and data accuracy.

  • Advanced Sheets/Excel Capabilities: Mastery of advanced spreadsheet functions (lookups, index/match, pivot tables, complex data modeling) to manipulate and interpret large datasets.

  • Discretion & Judgment: A proven problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically, exercise good judgment, and handle highly confidential executive data with total discretion.

  • Agility & Time Management: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines seamlessly.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex equity and compensation topics clearly to both entry-level employees and executives.

  • Autonomy: A proactive, self-starter mentality who takes initiative and works independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player.

  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: A forward-thinking mindset with a willingness to explore AI tools, automated workflows, and emerging technologies to streamline compensation processes and maximize efficiency.

job.title: Huron Daily Tribune News Reporter
job.description:
News Reporter

The Huron Daily Tribune is a daily newspaper in Bad Axe, Michigan, seeks a digital-minded reporter to write for online and print publication with several deadlines throughout the day. As a reporter, you discover innovative ways to deliver quality and engaging content, collaborate with a diverse team and build authentic relationships with the community.

The position demands strong writing and reporting skills and good news judgment. A reporter needs to be able to self-assign, re-prioritize in real time and keep digital production first.

A reporter must strive to present an accurate, well-balanced explanation of the stories they cover, build an arsenal of contacts and make themselves known in the community for both breaking news items and more in-depth, enterprise stories.

The reporter submits stories daily and enriches stories with multimedia assets.

A reporter creates content to attract digital subscribers and to optimize content for digital audiences across web and social media platforms. A reporter is also responsible for finding news leads and further developing professional skills through company training.

Extensive knowledge of AP style writing is necessary in addition to trending style changes. Time management and basic knowledge of photography are a plus to the success of the position.

A reporter should have knowledge of social media platforms and ongoing events in addition to working in content management systems. Training available.

Staff meetings and communication for content planning purposes will occur.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Write a minimum of 10-15 bylines a week, at least one a day, enriched with multimedia assets.
  • Write a variety of stories, including content for newspaper subscribers and non-subscribers.
  • Write a minimum of one, well-researched enterprise story a quarter.
  • Attend at least one staff meeting or equivalent discussion a day for content planning purposes.
  • Shoot or attain photos or create other multimedia assets. Prepare and package content for online and print publication.
  • Ability to learn content management systems quickly and effectively with appropriate internal training and external knowledge.

What are the measures of success for this position?

  • Gather information, write and deliver news stories for print and online publication by seeking out leads, capitalizing on external knowledge and accepting assignments from the editor or associate editor.
  • Build a loyal digital subscriber base by engaging with readership online and in the community.
  • Explore alternate publishing strategies to enrich content and presentation (i.e., images, slideshows, specialized web templates, embedded content, timelines, hyperlinks, SEO writing and other multimedia assets).
  • Write effective digital headlines that help attract audiences. Write engaging social posts that attract audiences and encourage readers to interact with social content.
  • Revise work to meet editorial approval for publication-readiness, including clarity, fairness, legality, spelling, grammar, punctuation and style.
  • Participate in internally offered training and other development opportunities.
  • Use metrics to monitor real-time traffic, identify patterns and make informed content decisions.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest current events and trends.
  • Communicate effectively with the newsroom and leadership both in-office and in the field.
  • Manage workflow to meet deadlines and work collaboratively with team to find solutions.

Qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s in communications, journalism or equivalent in experience and/or education.
  • Strong news judgment, knowledge of AP style and SEO best practices.
  • Understand written sentences, paragraphs and headline writing in work related documents to communicate effectively as appropriate for the needs of the audience.
  • Follow the law, especially regarding the confidentiality and privacy of the people they interview or write about.

About Hearst Midwest Media Group

 

By joining the Manistee News Advocate, a publication of Hearst Midwest, a multimedia reporterbecomes a family member of a media group that produces news with a hyper-local purpose.

With one of the oldest news gathering media in Michigan and Illinois – Hearst Midwest Community Group – and our corresponding news websites, we have a serious journalistic commitment to provide local, watchdog and investigative reporting that impacts the areas we serve.

Hearst is one of the nation’s largest diversified media, information and services companies with more than 360 businesses. At Hearst, we offer all the industry’s leading benefits you need to both feel and be your best. From financial wellbeing to personal care, our programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on the whole person. We want our employees to have a healthy, rewarding, balanced and meaningful experience — both at work and in life.

job.title: Audience Intern
job.description:
Audience Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for a curious and versatile student journalist to join its Audience team for the summer 2027 internship program.

Audience journalists help determine how journalism reaches people — and what makes them want to come back. You’ll work alongside editors, reporters and audience strategists to help shape coverage, craft compelling headlines and social posts, engage readers across platforms and use data to understand what matters to our audience.

You’ll gain experience at the intersection of journalism, storytelling and digital strategy while helping the Chronicle reach hundreds of thousands of readers across Houston and beyond. You may help package breaking news, promote enterprise reporting, build newsletters, identify search opportunities, analyze reader behavior and develop new ways to connect with audiences. 

This position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in audience journalism and gain hands-on experience in a major newsroom. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor real-time analytics and identify patterns in what readers are viewing, sharing and returning to

  • Help editors and reporters frame stories for maximum clarity, relevance and impact
  • Write and refine headlines, social copy, push alerts and other promotional language with attention to SEO and news value
  • Create social posts and contribute to strategies for platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and more
  • Assist with newsletter planning, writing and audience-focused story selection
  • Help package stories for the homepage and other digital platforms
  • Research search trends, audience interests and emerging platforms
  • Pitch ideas for reaching new audiences and deepening connections with existing readers

  • Collaborate across the newsroom to translate Chronicle journalism into useful, compelling digital experiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • A personal laptop and Wi-Fi or hotspot access.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

 

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June and to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour. 
  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands. 
  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

 

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 audience-related clips (social media posts, newsletters, alerts, etc.), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

Recognizing the diverse needs of our candidates, if you are interested in applying for employment and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or regarding the application process, please contact us by email at hnpemployment@hearst.com.  Please do not use this email address to inquire about the status of applications. We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address.

job.title: Sports Account Executive, Ad Sales
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the Best Sports in Town.

From the voices fans know and trust to the stories you won’t find anywhere else, the New York Post brings sports to life with insider access both on and off the field. And we’re just getting started. Our sports business continues to grow across Post Sports, Post Action, Post Sports+ and original sports video, creating new and exciting ways for brands to connect with passionate, highly engaged audiences.


We’re looking for an Account Executive, Sports Ad Sales who knows how to sell, loves the thrill of the pitch and closing a deal, and genuinely lives and breathes sports. This is a great opportunity for a relationship driven, strategic seller who wants to build meaningful partnerships around some of the biggest sports stories, personalities and moments in New York.


You’ll bring a strong network across agencies and direct clients, a proven track record of opening doors and growing business, and the confidence to take a partnership from first conversation to close.


The ideal candidate has approximately 4 to 6 years of omni channel media sales experience in a major market, with experience working directly with clients and media agencies. Most importantly, you’re a smart, energetic seller who understands where sports, culture, media and brands intersect and knows how to turn that intersection into revenue.


This New York based role reports to the NYP Sports Ad Sales Director and will play a key role across the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching to closing, growing and retaining client partnerships.


What You’ll Do


  • Identify, prospect and develop new business opportunities across agencies and direct clients, turning conversations into meaningful, long term partnerships.
  • Leverage our sports content, audience, talent, platforms and premium opportunities to create compelling solutions for advertisers.
  • Manage opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through pitch, negotiation, close and ongoing partnership management.
  • Work closely with internal teams to develop creative, strategic and integrated solutions that help clients achieve their business goals.
  • Deliver compelling sales presentations and confidently communicate why the New York Post is the right partner for a brand.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients and agency partners, providing responsive, thoughtful communication and an exceptional buyer experience.
  • Preserve and expand the existing customer base while consistently identifying opportunities for upsell, cross sell and deeper partnerships.
  • Consistently work toward and exceed established revenue goals with a proactive, results oriented approach.
  • Stay close to competitors, category trends, advertiser activity and the evolving sports and media landscape to uncover new opportunities.
  • Use research, prospecting tools and your own network to consistently build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

What We’re Looking For


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in media sales, digital advertising or a similar client facing sales environment, preferably in a major market.
  • A proven track record of prospecting, winning new business and growing client relationships.
  • Strong agency and/or direct client relationships within the digital media and advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience selling omni channel or integrated media solutions across multiple platforms.
  • A genuine passion for sports and an understanding of the sports media landscape. You don’t have to be able to name every backup quarterback in the league, but you should be excited by sports, know what fans care about and understand why brands want to be part of the conversation.
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial sales mentality. You enjoy the chase, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone and get energized by opening new doors.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently pitch ideas and build relationships at all levels.
  • Familiarity with market research and prospecting tools such as MediaRadar, WINMO and similar platforms.
  • Highly organized, self motivated and accountable, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities at once.
  • A fast learner who can adapt to a constantly evolving media, sports and advertising landscape.
  • Results driven, enthusiastic and collaborative, with the confidence and personality to represent the New York Post in the marketplace.

The Bottom Line

If you love sports, love selling and love the idea of building partnerships around some of the biggest moments in sports, we want to hear from you.


Note: This role will adhere to a hybrid work model (4 days per week in our NYC office), subject to change as business needs evolve.


Compensation: Base salary of $80,000–$100,000, plus a sales bonus/commission plan. On-target earnings (OTE) of $140,000–$175,000 are based on achieving 100% of sales goals.


Note: Our sales compensation plan rewards strong performance, with incentive multipliers for exceeding sales targets and additional earning potential for top performers.


Pay-for-performance is a key element in our strategy to attract, engage, and motivate talented people to do their best work. Accordingly, offers extended for this role will include an annual bonus target typically expressed as percentage of salary. Similarly to salary, set annual incentive bonus targets are based on a variety of factors including competitive market practice, experience, tenure, and essential skills.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

Base Pay Range: $140,000 - $175,000 OTE

We’re committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation to attract top talent. This pay range reflects our good faith estimate for the role and may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors.

For bonus-eligible roles, targets are determined based on multiple considerations, including market benchmarks and individual contributions.

For benefits-eligible roles, we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package covering health, retirement, wellbeing, and more, along with optional benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees.

job.title: Senior Mobile Software Architect
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Multi-Team System Architecture: 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Native Mobile Engineering Expertise: Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Scalable Platform & API Design: Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Media Delivery & Infrastructure: Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Data Privacy & Cost Optimization: Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • CI/CD & Quality Automation: Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Polyglot Backend Systems: Familiarity with modern backend languages such as Go or PHP in event-driven or microservice architectures.
  • Advanced Caching & Open Source: Experience optimizing edge media caches, working with relational databases/SQL, or contributing to open-source software initiatives.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Technical Governance: Ability to translate complex business and product requirements into clear, practical architectural designs accepted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality Advocacy: Strong commitment to promoting engineering best practices, conducting empathetic code reviews, and elevating overall code quality.
  • Operational Resilience & Diagnostic Vision: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve production incidents under high-urgency conditions during on-call rotation.
  • Structured Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to present software architecture proposals, trade-offs, and technical roadmaps to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Passion for leveraging modern technology to advance public media, accessibility, and audience engagement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical architecture capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $184,758.33 -  $205,933.12 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Senior Vice President, NPR Content Strategy & Business Development
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

We are seeking a strategic, deal-driven SVP of Content Strategy & Business Development to lead the strategic expansion of our editorial reach and enterprise distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer, this executive will serve as the primary architect and operator of our external partnership strategy. You will bridge the gap between our content production and revenue growth—identifying, negotiating, and executing strategic alliances with digital platforms, streaming networks, audio networks, and mission-aligned distribution partners.

In addition to structuring external partnerships, you will collaborate closely with enterprise stakeholders across the organization to standardize operational frameworks, direct the division’s OKR planning, and align resource allocation directly with Content’s overarching strategic objectives.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development & Monetization

  • Drive Partnership Revenue: Pitch, negotiate, and close high-value content distribution, co-production, and IP licensing deals for network content across platforms.
  • Expand Distribution Channels: Identify and secure deal structures with major digital news aggregators, streaming platforms, newsletter networks, and public media systems to scale audience reach and maximize revenue.
  • Innovate Business Models: Work alongside the CCO to design business models (e.g., enterprise member subscriptions, content licensing, revenue-share frameworks) that bring financial sustainability to NPR and the Network.

Partner Management & Strategic Alliances

  • Co-Production & Joint Ventures: Structure operational agreements for collaborative, multi-newsroom reporting initiatives to ensure partner alignment while protecting editorial standards.
  • Cross-Sector Alignment: Collaborate with executive leadership to identify grant-funded or corporate-sponsored distribution initiatives that support the organization's broader mission.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • CCO & Newsroom Partnership: Partner with the Chief Content Officer and network editorial leads to ensure business development strategies protect editorial standards and elevate network priorities.
  • Deal Structuring & IP Oversight: Manage the contract lifecycle, intellectual property rights, licensing terms, and revenue-sharing mechanisms in collaboration with legal counsel.
  • Metrics & Strategy Iteration: Track partnership performance, audience expansion, and net revenue to regularly present actionable pipeline insights to the CCO and executive team.  

  Business Operations

  • Operational Excellence: Refine cross-departmental Content workflows to streamline project delivery and execution.
  • Financial Oversight & Governance: Partner with Finance to direct divisional budgets, track CapEx, and forecast resource needs to maintain fiscal discipline.
  • Workforce Strategy & Resource Allocation: Collaborate with People Team and Content leaders to drive organizational design, headcount planning and resource optimization.
  • Strategy Stewardship: Lead the definition, tracking, and execution of divisional OKRs to align daily operations with overarching company goals.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media business development, content licensing, distribution, or syndication within news or digital publishing.
  • Proven history of initiating, negotiating, and closing complex, revenue-generating content distribution and licensing partnerships.
  • An active network of media executives, syndicators, platform leads, and distribution decision-makers across digital and legacy media.
  • Deep appreciation for independent journalism and a strong understanding of how to balance revenue goals with editorial integrity.
  • Direct experience structuring IP licensing, copyright agreements, syndication contracts, and revenue-share models.
  • Deep familiarity with IP licensing, copyright frameworks, syndication contracts, and revenue-sharing mechanisms for collective/networked content.
  • Strong negotiation skills, analytical capability, and clear communication style when representing the organization externally.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with senior journalists, newsroom leadership, and legal teams to construct commercial partnerships that rigorously protect editorial independence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Substantive understanding of the public media system, member-supported networks, or federated non-profit distribution models.
  • Direct commercial deal-making experience in episodic audio, podcast network syndication, or connected-car/smart-device audio ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with public media sponsorship rules, non-profit business parameters, and related FCC regulatory environments.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Commercial Deal Structuring & IP Acumen: Master-level ability to structure complex licensing agreements, distribution terms, and multi-party revenue allocations.
  • Strategic Negotiation & Executive Presence: Proven ability to represent NPR persuasively in high-stakes negotiations with global technology platforms and major media conglomerates.
  • Editorial & Commercial Boundary Stewardship: Unwavering ethical judgment to ensure commercial initiatives maintain an uncompromised firewall around newsroom decision-making.
  • Cross-Functional Coalition Building: Demonstrated capability to align diverse cross-functional teams—including legal, product, editorial, finance, and station relations—around complex enterprise transactions.
  • Financial Modeling & Market Analytics: Sophisticated acumen in analyzing audience consumption data, modeling revenue scenarios, and forecasting emerging market distribution opportunities.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the Washington, D.C. office at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in the D.C. Metropolitan Area, which includes Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia.

job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.


SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


How you’ll make an impact:

The Senior Staff Portfolio Manager is a senior individual contributor on the Planning & Portfolio team, responsible for the operational integrity and strategic governance of SiriusXM's technology portfolio. This role owns executive reporting, financial data governance, program tooling, and cross-functional coordination across Lisa Garnett-Willis's engineering and technology organization. The role requires strong financial acumen, deep familiarity with portfolio tooling and data infrastructure, and the ability to partner directly with Finance, Engineering leadership, and senior TPM leads. In addition, this role defines and continuously improves portfolio governance standards (cadences, controls, and success metrics) that drive portfolio transparency, audit readiness, and delivery accountability across the organization.


What you’ll do:

  • Own quarterly capitalization and FP&A coordination, ensuring timesheet data and project classifications are accurate and audit-ready at the organizational level. This includes establishing classification standards, resolving ambiguous cases with Finance and Engineering leadership, and proactively surfacing capitalization risk and remediation actions.
  • Maintain and evolve the Team Resource Manager (TRM), EOS, and related portfolio data infrastructure by improving data models, integrations, and controls to ensure a trusted, scalable single source of truth for portfolio and financial reporting.
  • Drive executive reporting cycles including WBR inputs, OK2 gate review documentation, and exec dashboard maintenance and translate insights into clear decision-ready narratives, recommendations, and follow-through on actions.
  • Partner with TPM and Engineering leads on SDLC governance, initiative tracking, and Jira hierarchy compliance by defining standards, enabling adoption, and running periodic compliance/quality checks to ensure portfolio health is visible and actionable.
  • Manage 3P vendor SOWs and Jira Cloud migration deliverables in coordination with Legal and Engineering including scope governance, milestone tracking, vendor performance management, and risk/issue escalation.
  • Own portfolio documentation and process standards; ensure team knowledge is captured and scalable through playbooks, templates, and training that increase consistency and reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.
  • Provide senior portfolio management support for complex, cross-functional programs including escalation tracking and stakeholder reporting by driving alignment on scope, milestones, dependencies, and executive communications across multiple teams.
  • Help define and mature portfolio governance practices across the organization including the operating model for portfolio reviews, gates, and metrics, and the continuous improvement roadmap based on stakeholder feedback and data.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 7 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Strong financial acumen; direct experience with capitalization, CapEx tracking, or FP&A processes required
  • Vendor Management experience including SOW governance and delivery/financial performance management.
  • Proficiency with Jira, EOS or similar enterprise portfolio tooling, and Google Workspace with ability to define standards and improve data quality at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment in ambiguous environments with competing priorities.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and high bar for data quality and process rigor (controls, auditability, and repeatable operating cadences).
  • Experience shaping or maturing governance practices at the organizational level preferred
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $156,200 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

2026-09-30 11:59 PM

This is a nine (9) month contract position.


Working alongside the Promotion and Digital Entertainment teams, you will gather requirements, and define and lead Radio-Canada’s French-language digital strategy for the Eurovision Song Contest. 


Working in alignment with Digital Entertainment initiatives, you will co-ordinate the rollout of marketing and content plans across digital and social media platforms. You will leverage data, promotional opportunities and strategic content partnerships to achieve two primary objectives: 

  • Maximize live viewership among French-speaking Canadians.
  • Maximize audience engagement and participation during the national voting phase to select Canada’s representative, while mobilizing domestic and international support for Canada’s artist during the main competition. 

This role serves as the primary liaison between teams across Radio-Canada, CBC and the European Broadcasting Union (EBU).


Key Responsibilities:


Digital Marketing Strategy:

  • Liaise with the CRM and strategy teams to ensure co-ordinated and aligned messaging. 
  • Design audience journeys that convert awareness into engagement, engagement into votes and votes into live viewership.
  • Tailor strategies across each project phase: call for submissions, artist selection, public voting, winner announcement, competition preparation and the live broadcast.
  • Maintain consistent messaging, content, calls to action and timelines across all touchpoints.

Website and Voting Platform:

  • Define the content and engagement strategy for Radio-Canada’s Eurovision website.
  • Plan required content and features for the public voting window (October 8-18).
  • Help draft the request for proposals (RFP) for the digital voting solution.
  • Collaborate on selecting, implementing, testing and launching the voting platform.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams spanning editorial, marketing, product, technology, data, security and legal.
  • Maintain a fast, reliable flow of information regarding submissions, artists, announcements and results.
  • Manage tracking and conversion requirements to activate website and platform audience data.
  • Oversee data synchronization between collection platforms and audience activation systems in collaboration with technical specialists.

Data and Relationship Marketing:

  • Work with the CRM team to engage and re-engage audiences via newsletters, push notifications and targeted communications aligned with the project’s relationship marketing strategy. 

Social Media and Content:

  • Develop the overarching French-language social media strategy for the project.

job.title: Manager, Technical Projects & Innovation
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Sports Remote Engineering & Operations runs a standing portfolio of technical initiatives — private 5G at venues, in-helmet point-of-view cameras, camera tracking and augmented reality, connected-ball and player tracking, volumetric capture, and automated content moderation. Most of them are technically sound and short of hands. This role exists to move them.


This is a hands-on job. You will spend a real share of your week doing the work yourself — on-site testing, integration, writing specifications, chasing vendors to a decision. You will also be the person who makes sure the rest of it happens: that every project has a next milestone and a date, that equipment was specified early enough to actually be ordered, and that the people who needed to know were told before it affected them.


If you're looking for a role that sets technology strategy from a distance, this isn't it. If you want to ship things that end up on air across NFL, MLB, College Football, NASCAR, UFL, and International Soccer, it is.


Stated plainly so expectations are clear from the start: this role executes, recommends, and escalates. Cross-sport technical architecture and vendor strategy sit with our Director of Engineering; remote integration and the plant interface sit with our Remote Integration Engineering lead; capital authority sits with the SVP. You'll work as a peer to both — they set the technical direction, you carry it to completion. That division is deliberate, and it means you can be excellent at this job without having to be the deepest engineer in the department.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive our active technical initiatives to their next milestones — on-site tests and evaluations, vendor and partner coordination, and a live date on every card

job.title: Senior Engineer, Commerce
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Sobre Fox Tech


Fox Tech desarrolla los productos digitales detrás de las marcas de deportes y entretenimiento de FOX. Nuestras aplicaciones funcionan en web, móvil y dispositivos de sala de estar, y millones de personas las usan, generalmente todas al mismo tiempo cuando comienza un partido. Esos picos de tráfico determinan cómo construimos todo.

Estamos contratando ingenieros para construir la próxima generación de nuestros productos de streaming.


Sobre el puesto


Te unirás al equipo de Comercio, que es responsable de los sistemas que manejan el dinero: pagos, impuestos, facturación y suscripciones en todos nuestros productos directos al consumidor. Un error aquí cuesta dólares reales, y un checkout lento cuesta un suscriptor, por lo que el estándar de corrección y disponibilidad es más alto que en casi cualquier otra parte de la infraestructura.


La mayor parte del trabajo ocurre detrás de la interfaz de checkout: autorización y captura de pagos; reembolsos, disputas y reconciliación; el ciclo de vida de las suscripciones, incluyendo renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades, cancelaciones y todos los estados intermedios; idempotencia y procesamiento de webhooks contra APIs de proveedores que reintentan, llegan fuera de orden y a veces “mienten”; cálculo de impuestos a través de proveedores externos; y el alcance de PCI DSS, manteniendo los datos sensibles de los clientes donde deben estar.


Trabajarás con stakeholders de distintas áreas de negocio de FOX, que no todas venden de la misma forma ni al mismo público. Parte del trabajo consiste en construir capacidades de comercio que puedan reutilizarse entre ellas sin homogeneizar la experiencia de cada una.


Cómo trabajamos


El ecosistema de desarrollo ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos dos años, y nosotros hemos cambiado con él. Nuestros ingenieros usan agentes de código y herramientas de IA generativa como parte de su flujo de trabajo normal, no como un experimento ocasional. Esperamos que llegues con fluidez real: que sepas en qué casos estas herramientas son confiables y en cuáles no lo son, y que ya tengas tus propios hábitos para revisar, probar y proteger lo que producen.


Las herramientas en sí seguirán cambiando. Lo que funcionaba hace seis meses ya está desactualizado, y lo que estandaricemos este trimestre probablemente no será lo que usemos el próximo año. Buscamos ingenieros que vean esto como algo normal y que estén dispuestos a seguir replanteando su propio flujo de trabajo.


Para ser claros sobre el estándar: las herramientas de IA elevan lo que esperamos de ti, no lo reducen. Tú eres responsable del código, de las decisiones de diseño y del comportamiento en producción, sin importar quién (o qué) escribió el primer borrador.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar la dirección técnica de las principales capacidades de comercio, desde el diseño hasta la operación en producción.
  • Liderar discusiones de arquitectura y tomar las decisiones de compromiso entre confiabilidad, costo, seguridad y velocidad de entrega.
  • Escribir código de alta calidad con cobertura de pruebas significativa y automatización.
  • Asumir la responsabilidad de producción: respuesta a incidentes, análisis de causa raíz y el trabajo de seguimiento que evita que el mismo incidente vuelva a ocurrir.
  • Mentorear a otros ingenieros y elevar el estándar de ingeniería del equipo.
  • Evaluar tecnologías emergentes de pagos y comercio, y argumentar a favor de cambios que mejoren de forma medible la conversión, la confiabilidad o el costo operativo.

Cómo se ve el éxito

  • Comercio se mantiene estable durante los grandes eventos en vivo, cuando el tráfico llega todo de una vez.
  • Los cambios de pagos y suscripciones se lanzan de forma segura, y puedes señalar la métrica que se movió.
  • Otras áreas de negocio de FOX pueden construir sobre tu trabajo sin heredar el flujo de checkout de otro equipo.

Calificaciones

  • Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, o experiencia equivalente.
  • 5+ años de experiencia en ingeniería de software, con enfoque en APIs escalables y seguras, y sistemas basados en eventos.
  • Sólido dominio de Go. Nuestros servicios de comercio están escritos casi en su totalidad en Go, y necesitamos que empieces a escribir código de producción en este lenguaje desde el inicio.
  • Experiencia demostrable usando herramientas de IA generativa en desarrollo de software profesional. Puedes explicar dónde mejoraron tu flujo de trabajo, dónde introdujeron riesgos, y cómo revisas, pruebas y proteges el código asistido por IA.
  • Experiencia en el dominio de comercio. Has trabajado con Stripe, Adyen, Braintree o similares, y entiendes cómo se conectan las piezas entre sí.
  • Bases sólidas de ciencias de la computación e instintos fuertes de resolución de problemas.
  • Experiencia con decisiones de diseño y arquitectura de software a gran escala.
  • Sólida experiencia con SQL y NoSQL, idealmente DynamoDB y Redis.
  • Experiencia profesional con AWS u otro proveedor de nube.
  • Experiencia práctica con contenedores y Kubernetes.
  • Nuestros sistemas dan soporte a eventos en vivo y nuestro equipo está distribuido globalmente, por lo que el puesto implica algo de trabajo fuera del horario habitual: llamadas programadas entre regiones, además de respuesta a incidentes durante eventos importantes.

Deseable

  • Aplicaciones de streaming, especialmente aquellas que manejan eventos en vivo a gran escala.
  • Comercio electrónico, particularmente tráfico de alta disponibilidad en eventos como Black Friday.
  • Gestión del ciclo de vida de suscripciones: renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades y cancelaciones.
  • Idempotencia, procesamiento de webhooks, reintentos y consistencia eventual.
  • Comercio integrado directamente en una experiencia de streaming de video. Si has explorado esto, nos gustaría saberlo.
